## .env

```dotenv
# PROJECT VOICE — environment template
# Copy to `.env` and adjust. Never commit a real `.env` (it is git-ignored).
#
#   cp .env.example .env
#   python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"      # → PV_SECRET_KEY
#   # or:  openssl rand -hex 32
#
# Sections: backend (PV_*, read by the API and worker — same names in docker-compose and the
# local scripts), docker compose (Postgres/Caddy/MinIO), frontend (API_INTERNAL_URL,
# NEXT_PUBLIC_*), and test / E2E helpers. Values shown are development defaults; production notes
# are inline. In production PV_ENV=production refuses the development secret and marks cookies
# Secure, so the stack must be served over HTTPS (Caddy).

# ───────────────────────────── Application ─────────────────────────────
PV_ENV=development                      # development | test | production (production enforces secrets + Secure cookies)
PV_APP_NAME="PROJECT VOICE"
PV_APP_VERSION=0.1.0
PV_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=                     # e.g. https://voice.example.com — absolute origin for shareable media URLs (empty = relative paths)
PV_LOG_LEVEL=INFO
PV_LOG_JSON=true                        # false → coloured console logs for local development

# ───────────────────────────── Database / Redis ─────────────────────────
PV_DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://projectvoice:projectvoice@localhost:5432/projectvoice
PV_DATABASE_POOL_SIZE=10
PV_DATABASE_MAX_OVERFLOW=10
PV_DATABASE_ECHO=false
PV_REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/0

# ───────────────────────────── Security ─────────────────────────────────
PV_SECRET_KEY=change-me-generate-with-openssl-rand-hex-32   # REQUIRED in production, >= 32 random chars (signs JWTs + media tokens). Generate: openssl rand -hex 32
PV_JWT_ALGORITHM=HS256
PV_JWT_ISSUER=project-voice
PV_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS=900          # 15 min access JWT (pv_access cookie)
PV_REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS=2592000     # 30 days rotating refresh token (pv_refresh cookie)
PV_CSRF_COOKIE_TTL_SECONDS=2592000
PV_COOKIE_DOMAIN=                       # leave empty for host-only cookies (recommended behind the Next.js proxy)
PV_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH=10
PV_PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH=128
PV_API_KEY_LAST_USED_WRITE_INTERVAL_SECONDS=60
PV_CORS_ORIGINS=["http://localhost:3000"]

# ───────────────────────────── Rate limits (per minute) ─────────────────
PV_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=true
PV_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS=60
PV_RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_PER_WINDOW=10        # per IP: register / login / refresh
PV_RATE_LIMIT_UPLOAD_PER_WINDOW=20      # per user: POST /voices
PV_RATE_LIMIT_GENERATE_PER_WINDOW=30    # per user: POST /generations, /voices/{id}/preview
PV_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT_PER_WINDOW=300

# ───────────────────────────── Storage ──────────────────────────────────
PV_STORAGE_BACKEND=local                # local | s3
PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR=./storage          # private directory, never served statically
PV_S3_BUCKET=                           # required when PV_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3
PV_S3_REGION=us-east-1
PV_S3_ENDPOINT_URL=                     # e.g. http://minio:9000 for MinIO / any S3-compatible service
PV_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=
PV_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=
PV_S3_USE_PATH_STYLE=true               # true for MinIO; false for AWS virtual-hosted style
PV_S3_PRESIGN_TTL_SECONDS=3600
PV_MAX_UPLOAD_MB=25                     # reference upload cap; keep CADDY_MAX_BODY above it
PV_MEDIA_URL_TTL_SECONDS=3600           # lifetime of /generations/{id}/audio-url links
PV_RETENTION_DELETE_DELAY_HOURS=0       # 0 = delete storage objects immediately; >0 = hide now, purge after N hours (cleanup job)
PV_IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_HOURS=24
PV_FFPROBE_BIN=ffprobe
PV_FFMPEG_BIN=ffmpeg

# ───────────────────────────── Jobs / worker ────────────────────────────
PV_JOB_TIMEOUT_VOICE_SECONDS=900        # 15 min
PV_JOB_TIMEOUT_GENERATION_SECONDS=1800  # 30 min
PV_JOB_RESULT_TTL_SECONDS=86400
PV_WORKER_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS=30
PV_WORKER_HEARTBEAT_TTL_SECONDS=90
PV_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MINUTES=60          # heartbeat thread enqueues cleanup_job this often (distributed lock)
PV_TMP_RETENTION_HOURS=6                # scratch dirs older than this are removed by cleanup
PV_PROGRESS_WRITE_INTERVAL_MS=250

# ───────────────────────────── Conversation mode ────────────────────────
PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_BASE_URL=           # OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama). Empty → only the `mirror` engine
PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_MODEL=              # e.g. llama3.1:8b
PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_API_KEY=            # optional bearer token for the LLM endpoint
PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT="You are a friendly voice assistant. Reply in one or two short sentences, in the same language the user spoke. Never use markdown, lists or emojis."
PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=20
PV_CONVERSATION_TURN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=30     # transcription + response budget per turn (close code 4008 on breach)
PV_CONVERSATION_SYNTH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=60    # wait for the front-of-queue synthesis job
PV_CONVERSATION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=300    # no frames at all → close 4008
PV_CONVERSATION_MAX_TURN_CHARS=600

# ───────────────────────────── AI engine (INTERNAL_CONTRACTS §A; read by both API Settings and EngineSettings) ──
PV_MODELS_DIR=./models                  # root for all downloaded weights
PV_ENGINE_DEVICE=auto                   # auto | cpu | cuda
PV_ENGINE_MAX_RESIDENT_MODELS=1         # models kept loaded in a worker
PV_ENGINE_ALLOW_CPU_FALLBACK=true       # retry on CPU after CUDA OOM
PV_ENGINE_NUM_THREADS=0                 # 0 = os.cpu_count()
PV_ENGINE_ENABLED=zipvoice_distill,f5tts,indicf5   # ordered preference list
PV_ZIPVOICE_DIR=                        # default {MODELS_DIR}/zipvoice-distill (tokens.txt, encoder/decoder int8|fp32, lexicon.txt, vocos_24khz.onnx, lexicon-en-us.txt)
PV_F5TTS_CKPT=                          # F5-TTS checkpoint (.safetensors/.pt) — weights are on Hugging Face, see docs/MODEL_SETUP.md
PV_F5TTS_VOCAB=                         # vocab.txt for the checkpoint
PV_F5TTS_MODEL_CFG=                     # model config name or yaml
PV_F5TTS_VOCODER_DIR=                   # local Vocos dir (optional; else f5-tts downloads from HF)
PV_F5TTS_WEIGHT_LICENCE=unknown         # recorded in ModelInfo, e.g. "Apache-2.0 (OpenF5)"
PV_F5TTS_LANGUAGES=en                   # languages the configured checkpoint speaks, comma list
PV_INDICF5_MODEL=ai4bharat/IndicF5      # HF id (gated: accept terms + PV_HF_TOKEN) or local dir
PV_HF_TOKEN=                            # token for gated Hugging Face downloads
PV_WHISPER_DIR=                         # default {MODELS_DIR}/whisper-base (sherpa-onnx encoder/decoder/tokens)
PV_WHISPER_BACKEND=sherpa               # sherpa | faster_whisper
PV_VAD_MODEL=                           # default {MODELS_DIR}/silero_vad.onnx
PV_REFERENCE_MIN_SECONDS=3              # decoded upload duration bounds
PV_REFERENCE_MAX_SECONDS=120
PV_REFERENCE_TARGET_SECONDS=12          # preferred speech window
PV_MAX_TEXT_CHARS=5000
PV_TMP_DIR=./tmp                        # worker scratch

# ───────────────────────────── Docker compose (not read by the app) ─────
POSTGRES_USER=projectvoice              # compose Postgres role; PV_DATABASE_URL inside compose is derived from these three
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=projectvoice          # CHANGE in production (compose builds PV_DATABASE_URL from it)
POSTGRES_DB=projectvoice
PV_IMAGE_TAG=dev                        # tag for the locally built images
PV_API_WORKERS=1                        # uvicorn worker processes in the api container (prod default 2)
PV_WORKER_QUEUES=voice,generation       # queues one worker container consumes (split per GPU/host if needed)
CADDY_HTTP_PORT=80                      # dev: host port Caddy listens on
CADDY_MAX_BODY=32MB                     # proxy request-body limit; must exceed PV_MAX_UPLOAD_MB (+ multipart overhead)
DOMAIN=                                 # prod: public host name (automatic HTTPS); e.g. voice.example.com
ACME_EMAIL=                             # prod: contact e-mail for the ACME certificate account
# Resource limits used by docker-compose.prod.yml (optional overrides)
# POSTGRES_CPUS=1.0  POSTGRES_MEMORY=1g  REDIS_MAXMEMORY=256mb  REDIS_MEMORY=384m
# API_CPUS=1.0  API_MEMORY=768m  API_REPLICAS=1  WORKER_CPUS=2.0  WORKER_MEMORY=6g  WORKER_MEMORY_RESERVE=2g
# NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all            # docker-compose.gpu.yml: pin a GPU (e.g. 0)

# ───────────────────────────── MinIO (docker compose --profile s3) ───────
MINIO_ROOT_USER=                        # >= 3 chars; set together with PV_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3 and the PV_S3_* block above
MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=                    # >= 8 chars, random; generate: openssl rand -base64 24
# With the s3 profile use: PV_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3  PV_S3_ENDPOINT_URL=http://minio:9000  PV_S3_BUCKET=project-voice
#                          PV_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$MINIO_ROOT_USER  PV_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD  PV_S3_USE_PATH_STYLE=true

# ───────────────────────────── Frontend (Next.js) ───────────────────────
API_INTERNAL_URL=http://localhost:8000  # server-side rewrite target for /api/* (compose sets http://api:8000); never exposed to the browser
NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_BASE=                    # leave EMPTY: the browser derives ws(s)://<same origin>/api/v1/conversation/ws. Only set (e.g. ws://localhost:8000)
                                        # when the WebSocket is NOT proxied by the same origin (dev without Caddy and without the Next.js proxy)

# ───────────────────────────── Tests / E2E helpers ───────────────────────
PV_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://projectvoice:projectvoice@localhost:5432/projectvoice_test   # pytest integration DB (schema is dropped/recreated!)
PV_TEST_REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/1                                                             # pytest Redis (db 1 is flushed)
PV_E2E_BASE=http://localhost:8000       # scripts/e2e_api.py / e2e_ws.py target
PV_E2E_RESTART_CMD=                     # optional shell command e2e_api.py runs to restart the API for the persistence check
# Backups (infra/scripts/backup.sh): BACKUP_ROOT=./backups  RETENTION=7  PG_CONTAINER=postgres (to pg_dump inside compose)

```

## Makefile

```makefile
# PROJECT VOICE — developer entry points. `make help` lists them.
# Everything here is a thin wrapper; the real commands are documented in docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md.

SHELL := /bin/bash
.DEFAULT_GOAL := help

VENV        ?= .venv
PY          := $(abspath $(VENV))/bin/python
PIP         := $(abspath $(VENV))/bin/pip
BACKEND     := backend
COMPOSE     ?= docker compose
COMPOSE_PROD:= $(COMPOSE) -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml
MODELS_DIR  ?= $(abspath models)
API_PORT    ?= 8000

# Environment every local backend process needs (overridable: make api PV_LOG_JSON=true).
export PV_ENV              ?= development
export PV_MODELS_DIR       ?= $(MODELS_DIR)
export PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR?= $(abspath storage)
export PV_TMP_DIR          ?= $(abspath tmp)
export PV_LOG_JSON         ?= false

.PHONY: help venv dev-up dev-down dev-logs migrate api worker frontend start stop \
        test test-unit test-model e2e e2e-ws e2e-browser lint fmt typecheck backup restore \
        download-models logs prod-up prod-down build psql

help: ## Show this help
	@grep -E '^[a-zA-Z_-]+:.*?## ' $(MAKEFILE_LIST) | awk 'BEGIN {FS = ":.*?## "}; {printf "  \033[36m%-16s\033[0m %s\n", $$1, $$2}'

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- local (no Docker)
venv: ## Create .venv and install the backend with dev + engine extras
	test -d $(VENV) || python3 -m venv $(VENV)
	$(PIP) install --upgrade pip
	cd $(BACKEND) && $(PIP) install -e ".[dev,engine]"

migrate: ## Apply database migrations (alembic upgrade head)
	cd $(BACKEND) && $(PY) -m alembic upgrade head

api: ## Run the API with reload on :$(API_PORT)
	cd $(BACKEND) && $(PY) -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port $(API_PORT)

worker: ## Run the RQ worker (queues voice,generation)
	cd $(BACKEND) && $(PY) -m app.jobs.worker

frontend: ## Run the Next.js dev server on :3000 (proxies /api to the local API)
	cd frontend && API_INTERNAL_URL=http://localhost:$(API_PORT) pnpm dev

start: ## Start postgres/redis if down, migrate, launch api + worker + frontend in the background (.run/)
	scripts/start-local.sh

stop: ## Stop the processes started by `make start`
	scripts/stop-local.sh

download-models: ## Download ZipVoice, Whisper and Silero weights into $(MODELS_DIR)
	$(PY) scripts/download-models.py --models-dir $(MODELS_DIR)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- quality
test: ## Backend test suite (unit + integration + engine + audio; model tests skip without weights)
	cd $(BACKEND) && $(PY) -m pytest -q

test-unit: ## Fast tests only (no model inference)
	cd $(BACKEND) && $(PY) -m pytest -q -m "not model"

test-model: ## Real-inference tests (ZipVoice / Whisper / VAD; needs weights, ~2-3 min on CPU)
	cd $(BACKEND) && $(PY) -m pytest -q tests/model -m model

e2e: ## Full HTTP workflow against the running stack (scripts/e2e_api.py → evidence/)
	$(PY) scripts/e2e_api.py --base http://localhost:$(API_PORT) --skip-restart

e2e-ws: ## Conversation WebSocket turn against the running stack (scripts/e2e_ws.py → evidence/)
	$(PY) scripts/e2e_ws.py --base http://localhost:$(API_PORT)

e2e-browser: ## 22-step acceptance workflow in Chromium with a fake microphone (needs frontend on :3000)
	node scripts/e2e_browser.mjs --base http://localhost:3000

lint: ## ruff check + ruff format --check + frontend eslint (when installed)
	cd $(BACKEND) && $(PY) -m ruff check app tests alembic
	cd $(BACKEND) && $(PY) -m ruff format --check app tests
	@if [ -d frontend/node_modules ]; then cd frontend && pnpm lint; else echo "frontend deps not installed; skipping eslint"; fi

fmt: ## ruff format + ruff --fix
	cd $(BACKEND) && $(PY) -m ruff format app tests && $(PY) -m ruff check --fix app tests

typecheck: ## mypy (backend) + tsc (frontend when installed)
	cd $(BACKEND) && $(PY) -m mypy app --ignore-missing-imports
	@if [ -d frontend/node_modules ]; then cd frontend && pnpm typecheck; fi

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- docker
dev-up: ## docker compose up (dev stack: postgres, redis, api, worker, frontend, caddy on :80)
	$(COMPOSE) up -d --build

dev-down: ## docker compose down (volumes kept; add -v manually to wipe data)
	$(COMPOSE) down

build: ## Build all images without starting
	$(COMPOSE) build

logs: ## Follow logs of the compose stack (SERVICE=api to filter)
	$(COMPOSE) logs -f --tail=200 $(SERVICE)

prod-up: ## Production stack (docker-compose.prod.yml); add PROFILES="--profile s3" for MinIO
	$(COMPOSE_PROD) $(PROFILES) up -d --build

prod-down: ## Stop the production stack
	$(COMPOSE_PROD) down

psql: ## psql into the compose Postgres
	$(COMPOSE) exec postgres psql -U $${POSTGRES_USER:-projectvoice} -d $${POSTGRES_DB:-projectvoice}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- data
backup: ## pg_dump + storage tarball → backups/<timestamp> (RETENTION=7)
	infra/scripts/backup.sh

restore: ## Restore SNAPSHOT=backups/<timestamp> (destructive; requires --yes which this target passes)
	@test -n "$(SNAPSHOT)" || (echo "usage: make restore SNAPSHOT=backups/<timestamp>"; exit 1)
	infra/scripts/restore.sh $(SNAPSHOT) --yes --verify

```

## README.md

````markdown
# PROJECT VOICE

**Your voice. Your words.**

Record or upload a short sample of your voice once, create a reusable AI voice, then type
anything and hear it spoken in that voice. A personal voice-cloning and speech-synthesis platform
built as a complete product: premium Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL, Redis-backed
AI worker, modular speech-engine layer with real reference-conditioned synthesis, consent and
ownership enforcement, Docker deployment, and an executable test suite that proves the workflow
end to end.

```
CREATE VOICE → RECORD OR UPLOAD → NAME IT → CONFIRM CONSENT → VOICE IS READY
SELECT VOICE → TYPE ANYTHING → RUN → HEAR IT → PLAY OR DOWNLOAD
```

## Status at a glance

| Gate | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Product — create and manage multiple voices | **Pass** | `evidence/e2e_browser_log.txt`, `evidence/e2e_api_log.txt` |
| AI — real reference-conditioned cloning | **Pass** (ZipVoice engine, CPU) | `backend/tests/model`, `docs/AI_ENGINE.md` benchmark |
| Generation — select voice, type, run, hear | **Pass** | browser E2E steps 10–17 |
| Persistence — survives restart | **Pass** | API E2E "persistence after API restart" |
| Security — no cross-user access | **Pass** | API E2E isolation + CSRF + consent steps, 48 integration tests |
| Multilingual | **English and Chinese verified**; Telugu/Hindi/Kannada/Tamil/Malayalam implemented via IndicF5 adapter but **unavailable until gated weights are installed** | `docs/LANGUAGE_MATRIX.md` |
| Hardware — reliable within limits | **Pass on 2-vCPU CPU host**; CUDA path implemented, not executed here | `docs/GPU_SETUP.md` |
| Interface — simple and polished | **Pass** | `frontend/screenshots/`, `evidence/browser/` |
| Deployment — reproducible | **Compose/Dockerfiles/Caddy written and `docker compose config`-validated; images not built here (Docker Hub blocked)** | `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` §8 |
| Verification — real execution | **212 backend tests, 42 frontend tests, 55-step API E2E, 22-step browser E2E, WebSocket turn test — all passing** | `docs/VERIFICATION_REPORT.md` |

## Quick start (local, no Docker)

Requirements: Python 3.11+, Node 22 + pnpm, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, FFmpeg.

```bash
git clone <this repo> project-voice && cd project-voice
python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e "backend[engine,realtime,dev]"   # API + worker + engine dependencies
python scripts/download-models.py               # ZipVoice, Vocos, Whisper, Silero VAD (GitHub releases)
cp .env.example .env                            # set PV_SECRET_KEY, database/redis URLs
(cd backend && alembic upgrade head)
scripts/start-local.sh                          # API :8000, worker, frontend :3000
```

Open <http://localhost:3000>. Full instructions, including Docker (`docker compose up`), are in
`docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md` and `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`.

## Repository

```
backend/    FastAPI API + RQ worker (app/core, db, api/v1, services, storage, jobs, engine, audio), Alembic, tests
frontend/   Next.js 15 + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 app (Simple / Advanced / Developer / Conversation modes)
infra/      Caddy reverse proxy, backup & restore scripts
scripts/    model download, benchmark, local start/stop, E2E scripts (API, WebSocket, browser)
docs/       architecture, API, AI engine, model setup, audio pipeline, database, security, deployment, testing …
evidence/   logs, JSON summaries, generated WAVs and screenshots from the real verification runs
```

· `docs/SECURITY.md` · `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` · `docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md` · `docs/GPU_SETUP.md` ·

## Engines and licences

| Engine | Role | Code | Weights | Verified here |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ZipVoice-Distill via sherpa-onnx | default, CPU-friendly zero-shot cloning (en, zh) | Apache-2.0 | GitHub releases; trained on Emilia (CC-BY-NC-4.0 dataset terms apply — check for your use) | yes |
| F5-TTS | high-quality cloning; OpenF5 (Apache-2.0, en), v1 Base (CC-BY-NC, en+zh), SPRINGLab Hindi (CC-BY-4.0) | MIT | Hugging Face | adapter only |
| IndicF5 | Telugu, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Malayalam and more | MIT | Hugging Face, gated | adapter only |

XTTS-v2 was evaluated and excluded (non-commercial Coqui licence). Details in `docs/AI_ENGINE.md`.

## Responsible use

Voices may only be cloned with the explicit consent of their owner. The product records a consent
event for every voice, blocks generation when consent is revoked, keeps all audio private behind
authenticated, owner-bound access, and stamps generated files with provenance metadata. See
`docs/SECURITY.md`.
````

## docker-compose.gpu.yml

```yaml
# PROJECT VOICE — GPU worker override (NVIDIA). Requires the NVIDIA Container Toolkit.
#
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml -f docker-compose.gpu.yml up -d --build
#
# Only the worker changes: it is built from Dockerfile.worker.cuda (CUDA 12.4 runtime + cu124
# torch wheels) and reserves one GPU. The API, frontend, Postgres, Redis and Caddy are
# unchanged and may equally run on another host (see docs/DEPLOYMENT.md, split topology).
#
# Not verified in the authoring environment (no GPU, download.pytorch.org blocked).

name: project-voice

services:
  worker:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.worker.cuda
    image: project-voice/worker-cuda:${PV_IMAGE_TAG:-dev}
    environment:
      PV_ENGINE_DEVICE: cuda
      PV_ENGINE_ALLOW_CPU_FALLBACK: ${PV_ENGINE_ALLOW_CPU_FALLBACK:-true}
      # With several GPUs run one worker per GPU: scale and pin with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.
      NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: ${NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-all}
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: ${WORKER_MEMORY:-12g}
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              count: 1
              capabilities: [gpu]
    # Larger start_period: CUDA init + first model load on a cold GPU.
    healthcheck:
      start_period: 180s

```

## docker-compose.prod.yml

```yaml
# PROJECT VOICE — production overrides. Always combine with the base file:
#
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build
#   docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile s3 up -d   # + MinIO
#
# Required in .env: PV_ENV=production, PV_SECRET_KEY (>= 32 random chars), POSTGRES_PASSWORD,
# DOMAIN, ACME_EMAIL. With --profile s3 also PV_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3, PV_S3_* and MINIO_ROOT_*.
# PV_ENV=production makes the API refuse the development secret and sets Secure cookies, which
# is why Caddy must terminate HTTPS (Caddyfile.prod).

name: project-voice

services:
  postgres:
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      - postgres
      - -c
      - shared_buffers=${POSTGRES_SHARED_BUFFERS:-256MB}
      - -c
      - max_connections=${POSTGRES_MAX_CONNECTIONS:-100}
      - -c
      - log_min_duration_statement=1000
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: "${POSTGRES_CPUS:-1.0}"
          memory: ${POSTGRES_MEMORY:-1g}
    logging: &logging
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "20m"
        max-file: "5"

  redis:
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      - redis-server
      - --appendonly
      - "yes"
      - --maxmemory
      - ${REDIS_MAXMEMORY:-256mb}
      - --maxmemory-policy
      - noeviction     # queue + rate-limit state must never be evicted
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: "0.5"
          memory: ${REDIS_MEMORY:-384m}
    logging: *logging

  api:
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PV_ENV: production
      PV_LOG_JSON: "true"
      PV_API_WORKERS: ${PV_API_WORKERS:-2}
      PV_PUBLIC_BASE_URL: https://${DOMAIN:?set DOMAIN in .env}
      PV_CORS_ORIGINS: https://${DOMAIN}
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: "${API_CPUS:-1.0}"
          memory: ${API_MEMORY:-768m}
      replicas: ${API_REPLICAS:-1}
    logging: *logging

  worker:
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PV_ENV: production
      PV_LOG_JSON: "true"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: "${WORKER_CPUS:-2.0}"
          memory: ${WORKER_MEMORY:-6g}      # ZipVoice int8+fp32 + Whisper fit in ~3 GB; F5-TTS needs more
        reservations:
          memory: ${WORKER_MEMORY_RESERVE:-2g}
    logging: *logging

  frontend:
    restart: unless-stopped
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: "0.5"
          memory: 512m
    logging: *logging

  caddy:
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
      - "443:443/udp"     # HTTP/3
    environment:
      DOMAIN: ${DOMAIN:?set DOMAIN in .env}
      ACME_EMAIL: ${ACME_EMAIL:?set ACME_EMAIL in .env}
      CADDY_MAX_BODY: ${CADDY_MAX_BODY:-32MB}
    volumes:
      - ./infra/caddy/Caddyfile.prod:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro
      - ./infra/caddy/snippets.caddy:/etc/caddy/snippets.caddy:ro
      - caddy_data:/data
      - caddy_config:/config
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "--no-check-certificate", "https://127.0.0.1/api/v1/system/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: "0.5"
          memory: 256m
    logging: *logging

  # ---- optional S3-compatible object storage (docker compose --profile s3) -----------------
  # Set PV_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3, PV_S3_ENDPOINT_URL=http://minio:9000, PV_S3_BUCKET=project-voice,
  # PV_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID/PV_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (= MINIO_ROOT_USER/PASSWORD or a dedicated key)
  # and PV_S3_USE_PATH_STYLE=true in .env. minio-init creates the bucket once and exits.
  minio:
    image: minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-04-22T22-12-26Z
    profiles: ["s3"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["server", "/data", "--console-address", ":9001"]
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${MINIO_ROOT_USER:-}          # required with --profile s3 (MinIO refuses to start when empty)
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD:-}  # >= 8 chars
    volumes:
      - miniodata:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mc", "ready", "local"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 15s
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: "1.0"
          memory: 1g
    logging: *logging
    # Console on 9001 is not published; use `docker compose exec minio mc …` or an SSH tunnel.

  minio-init:
    image: minio/mc:RELEASE.2025-04-16T18-13-26Z
    profiles: ["s3"]
    restart: "no"
    depends_on:
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${MINIO_ROOT_USER:-}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD:-}
      PV_S3_BUCKET: ${PV_S3_BUCKET:-project-voice}
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
    command:
      - |
        set -eu
        mc alias set local http://minio:9000 "$$MINIO_ROOT_USER" "$$MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD"
        mc mb --ignore-existing "local/$$PV_S3_BUCKET"
        # Objects are private; the API hands out pre-signed GET URLs (PV_S3_PRESIGN_TTL_SECONDS).
        mc anonymous set none "local/$$PV_S3_BUCKET"
        echo "bucket $$PV_S3_BUCKET ready"

volumes:
  miniodata:

```

## docker-compose.yml

```yaml
# PROJECT VOICE — development stack (CPU).
#
#   cp .env.example .env            # then edit at least PV_SECRET_KEY
#   python scripts/download-models.py   # weights → ./models (mounted read-only into the worker)
#   docker compose up -d --build
#   open http://localhost            # Caddy → frontend (/) and api (/api/*)
#
# Production: add -f docker-compose.prod.yml (and -f docker-compose.gpu.yml on a GPU host).
# No secrets are stored here: everything comes from .env (git-ignored) via ${VAR:-default}.

name: project-voice

x-backend-env: &backend-env
  PV_ENV: ${PV_ENV:-development}
  PV_LOG_LEVEL: ${PV_LOG_LEVEL:-INFO}
  PV_LOG_JSON: ${PV_LOG_JSON:-true}
  PV_SECRET_KEY: ${PV_SECRET_KEY:-development-only-secret-key-change-me-before-deploying-0000}
  PV_DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-projectvoice}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-projectvoice}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-projectvoice}
  PV_REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
  PV_PUBLIC_BASE_URL: ${PV_PUBLIC_BASE_URL:-}
  PV_CORS_ORIGINS: ${PV_CORS_ORIGINS:-http://localhost}
  PV_COOKIE_DOMAIN: ${PV_COOKIE_DOMAIN:-}
  PV_STORAGE_BACKEND: ${PV_STORAGE_BACKEND:-local}
  PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR: /data/storage
  PV_TMP_DIR: /data/tmp
  PV_S3_BUCKET: ${PV_S3_BUCKET:-}
  PV_S3_REGION: ${PV_S3_REGION:-us-east-1}
  PV_S3_ENDPOINT_URL: ${PV_S3_ENDPOINT_URL:-}
  PV_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${PV_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-}
  PV_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${PV_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:-}
  PV_S3_USE_PATH_STYLE: ${PV_S3_USE_PATH_STYLE:-true}
  PV_MAX_UPLOAD_MB: ${PV_MAX_UPLOAD_MB:-25}
  PV_RETENTION_DELETE_DELAY_HOURS: ${PV_RETENTION_DELETE_DELAY_HOURS:-0}
  PV_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED: ${PV_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED:-true}
  PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_BASE_URL: ${PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_BASE_URL:-}
  PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_MODEL: ${PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_MODEL:-}
  PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_API_KEY: ${PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_API_KEY:-}
  PV_MODELS_DIR: /models
  PV_ENGINE_ENABLED: ${PV_ENGINE_ENABLED:-zipvoice_distill,f5tts,indicf5}
  PV_ENGINE_NUM_THREADS: ${PV_ENGINE_NUM_THREADS:-0}
  PV_F5TTS_CKPT: ${PV_F5TTS_CKPT:-}
  PV_F5TTS_VOCAB: ${PV_F5TTS_VOCAB:-}
  PV_F5TTS_MODEL_CFG: ${PV_F5TTS_MODEL_CFG:-}
  PV_F5TTS_VOCODER_DIR: ${PV_F5TTS_VOCODER_DIR:-}
  PV_F5TTS_WEIGHT_LICENCE: ${PV_F5TTS_WEIGHT_LICENCE:-unknown}
  PV_F5TTS_LANGUAGES: ${PV_F5TTS_LANGUAGES:-en}
  PV_INDICF5_MODEL: ${PV_INDICF5_MODEL:-ai4bharat/IndicF5}
  PV_HF_TOKEN: ${PV_HF_TOKEN:-}

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-projectvoice}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-projectvoice}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-projectvoice}
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: "--encoding=UTF8 --locale=C"
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 10s
    # Not published: only reachable from the compose network. Uncomment for host tooling.
    # ports: ["127.0.0.1:5432:5432"]

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes", "--maxmemory-policy", "noeviction"]
    volumes:
      - redisdata:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 12

  api:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: project-voice/api:${PV_IMAGE_TAG:-dev}
    restart: unless-stopped
    # entrypoint-api.sh: wait for postgres → alembic upgrade head → uvicorn
    environment:
      <<: *backend-env
      PV_API_WORKERS: ${PV_API_WORKERS:-1}
      PV_FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS: "*"
    volumes:
      - storage:/data
      # Conversation mode runs Silero VAD + Whisper-base inside the API process (ONNX only).
      - ./models:/models:ro
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/system/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    # Not published: Caddy fronts it. For direct API access during development:
    # ports: ["127.0.0.1:8000:8000"]

  worker:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.worker
    image: project-voice/worker:${PV_IMAGE_TAG:-dev}
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      <<: *backend-env
      PV_ENGINE_DEVICE: ${PV_ENGINE_DEVICE:-cpu}
      PV_ENGINE_MAX_RESIDENT_MODELS: ${PV_ENGINE_MAX_RESIDENT_MODELS:-1}
      PV_ENGINE_ALLOW_CPU_FALLBACK: ${PV_ENGINE_ALLOW_CPU_FALLBACK:-true}
      PV_WORKER_QUEUES: ${PV_WORKER_QUEUES:-voice,generation}
    command: ["sh", "-c", "exec python -m app.jobs.worker --queues \"$${PV_WORKER_QUEUES}\""]
    volumes:
      - ./models:/models:ro
      - storage:/data
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      api:
        condition: service_healthy   # migrations have been applied by then
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - python
        - -c
        - "import socket,sys,redis;from app.core.config import get_settings;r=redis.Redis.from_url(get_settings().REDIS_URL);sys.exit(0 if any(r.scan_iter('pv:worker:'+socket.gethostname()+':*')) else 1)"
      interval: 60s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 120s

  frontend:
    build:
      context: ./frontend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: project-voice/frontend:${PV_IMAGE_TAG:-dev}
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: "3000"
      HOSTNAME: "0.0.0.0"
      # Next.js rewrites /api/* to the API over the compose network (server side only).
      API_INTERNAL_URL: http://api:8000
      # NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_BASE is intentionally unset: Caddy proxies the WebSocket on the same
      # origin, so the browser derives ws(s)://<host>/api/v1/conversation/ws itself.
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:3000/ >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ >/dev/null"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  caddy:
    image: caddy:2-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${CADDY_HTTP_PORT:-80}:80"
    environment:
      CADDY_MAX_BODY: ${CADDY_MAX_BODY:-32MB}
    volumes:
      - ./infra/caddy/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro
      - ./infra/caddy/snippets.caddy:/etc/caddy/snippets.caddy:ro
      - caddy_data:/data
      - caddy_config:/config
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
      frontend:
        condition: service_started
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://127.0.0.1/api/v1/system/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s

volumes:
  pgdata:
  redisdata:
  storage:
  caddy_data:
  caddy_config:

```

## backend/.env.example

```dotenv
# PROJECT VOICE — environment template
# Copy to `.env` and adjust. Never commit a real `.env` (it is git-ignored).
#
#   cp .env.example .env
#   python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"      # → PV_SECRET_KEY
#   # or:  openssl rand -hex 32
#
# Sections: backend (PV_*, read by the API and worker — same names in docker-compose and the
# local scripts), docker compose (Postgres/Caddy/MinIO), frontend (API_INTERNAL_URL,
# NEXT_PUBLIC_*), and test / E2E helpers. Values shown are development defaults; production notes
# are inline. In production PV_ENV=production refuses the development secret and marks cookies
# Secure, so the stack must be served over HTTPS (Caddy).

# ───────────────────────────── Application ─────────────────────────────
PV_ENV=development                      # development | test | production (production enforces secrets + Secure cookies)
PV_APP_NAME="PROJECT VOICE"
PV_APP_VERSION=0.1.0
PV_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=                     # e.g. https://voice.example.com — absolute origin for shareable media URLs (empty = relative paths)
PV_LOG_LEVEL=INFO
PV_LOG_JSON=true                        # false → coloured console logs for local development

# ───────────────────────────── Database / Redis ─────────────────────────
PV_DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://projectvoice:projectvoice@localhost:5432/projectvoice
PV_DATABASE_POOL_SIZE=10
PV_DATABASE_MAX_OVERFLOW=10
PV_DATABASE_ECHO=false
PV_REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/0

# ───────────────────────────── Security ─────────────────────────────────
PV_SECRET_KEY=change-me-generate-with-openssl-rand-hex-32   # REQUIRED in production, >= 32 random chars (signs JWTs + media tokens). Generate: openssl rand -hex 32
PV_JWT_ALGORITHM=HS256
PV_JWT_ISSUER=project-voice
PV_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS=900          # 15 min access JWT (pv_access cookie)
PV_REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS=2592000     # 30 days rotating refresh token (pv_refresh cookie)
PV_CSRF_COOKIE_TTL_SECONDS=2592000
PV_COOKIE_DOMAIN=                       # leave empty for host-only cookies (recommended behind the Next.js proxy)
PV_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH=10
PV_PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH=128
PV_API_KEY_LAST_USED_WRITE_INTERVAL_SECONDS=60
PV_CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000   # comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API directly (compose: http://localhost; prod: https://$DOMAIN)

# ───────────────────────────── Rate limits (per minute) ─────────────────
PV_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=true
PV_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS=60
PV_RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_PER_WINDOW=10        # per IP: register / login / refresh
PV_RATE_LIMIT_UPLOAD_PER_WINDOW=20      # per user: POST /voices
PV_RATE_LIMIT_GENERATE_PER_WINDOW=30    # per user: POST /generations, /voices/{id}/preview
PV_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT_PER_WINDOW=300

# ───────────────────────────── Storage ──────────────────────────────────
PV_STORAGE_BACKEND=local                # local | s3
PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR=./storage          # private directory, never served statically
PV_S3_BUCKET=                           # required when PV_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3
PV_S3_REGION=us-east-1
PV_S3_ENDPOINT_URL=                     # e.g. http://minio:9000 for MinIO / any S3-compatible service
PV_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=
PV_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=
PV_S3_USE_PATH_STYLE=true               # true for MinIO; false for AWS virtual-hosted style
PV_S3_PRESIGN_TTL_SECONDS=3600
PV_MAX_UPLOAD_MB=25                     # reference upload cap; keep CADDY_MAX_BODY above it
PV_MEDIA_URL_TTL_SECONDS=3600           # lifetime of /generations/{id}/audio-url links
PV_RETENTION_DELETE_DELAY_HOURS=0       # 0 = delete storage objects immediately; >0 = hide now, purge after N hours (cleanup job)
PV_IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_HOURS=24
PV_FFPROBE_BIN=ffprobe
PV_FFMPEG_BIN=ffmpeg

# ───────────────────────────── Jobs / worker ────────────────────────────
PV_JOB_TIMEOUT_VOICE_SECONDS=900        # 15 min
PV_JOB_TIMEOUT_GENERATION_SECONDS=1800  # 30 min
PV_JOB_RESULT_TTL_SECONDS=86400
PV_WORKER_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS=30
PV_WORKER_HEARTBEAT_TTL_SECONDS=90
PV_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MINUTES=60          # heartbeat thread enqueues cleanup_job this often (distributed lock)
PV_TMP_RETENTION_HOURS=6                # scratch dirs older than this are removed by cleanup
PV_PROGRESS_WRITE_INTERVAL_MS=250

# ───────────────────────────── Conversation mode ────────────────────────
PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_BASE_URL=           # OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama). Empty → only the `mirror` engine
PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_MODEL=              # e.g. llama3.1:8b
PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_API_KEY=            # optional bearer token for the LLM endpoint
PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT="You are a friendly voice assistant. Reply in one or two short sentences, in the same language the user spoke. Never use markdown, lists or emojis."
PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=20
PV_CONVERSATION_TURN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=30     # transcription + response budget per turn (close code 4008 on breach)
PV_CONVERSATION_SYNTH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=60    # wait for the front-of-queue synthesis job
PV_CONVERSATION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=300    # no frames at all → close 4008
PV_CONVERSATION_MAX_TURN_CHARS=600

# ───────────────────────────── AI engine (INTERNAL_CONTRACTS §A; read by both API Settings and EngineSettings) ──
PV_MODELS_DIR=./models                  # root for all downloaded weights
PV_ENGINE_DEVICE=auto                   # auto | cpu | cuda
PV_ENGINE_MAX_RESIDENT_MODELS=1         # models kept loaded in a worker
PV_ENGINE_ALLOW_CPU_FALLBACK=true       # retry on CPU after CUDA OOM
PV_ENGINE_NUM_THREADS=0                 # 0 = os.cpu_count()
PV_ENGINE_ENABLED=zipvoice_distill,f5tts,indicf5   # ordered preference list
PV_ZIPVOICE_DIR=                        # default {MODELS_DIR}/zipvoice-distill (tokens.txt, encoder/decoder int8|fp32, lexicon.txt, vocos_24khz.onnx, lexicon-en-us.txt)
PV_F5TTS_CKPT=                          # F5-TTS checkpoint (.safetensors/.pt) — weights are on Hugging Face, see docs/MODEL_SETUP.md
PV_F5TTS_VOCAB=                         # vocab.txt for the checkpoint
PV_F5TTS_MODEL_CFG=                     # model config name or yaml
PV_F5TTS_VOCODER_DIR=                   # local Vocos dir (optional; else f5-tts downloads from HF)
PV_F5TTS_WEIGHT_LICENCE=unknown         # recorded in ModelInfo, e.g. "Apache-2.0 (OpenF5)"
PV_F5TTS_LANGUAGES=en                   # languages the configured checkpoint speaks, comma list
PV_INDICF5_MODEL=ai4bharat/IndicF5      # HF id (gated: accept terms + PV_HF_TOKEN) or local dir
PV_HF_TOKEN=                            # token for gated Hugging Face downloads
PV_WHISPER_DIR=                         # default {MODELS_DIR}/whisper-base (sherpa-onnx encoder/decoder/tokens)
PV_WHISPER_BACKEND=sherpa               # sherpa | faster_whisper
PV_VAD_MODEL=                           # default {MODELS_DIR}/silero_vad.onnx
PV_REFERENCE_MIN_SECONDS=3              # decoded upload duration bounds
PV_REFERENCE_MAX_SECONDS=120
PV_REFERENCE_TARGET_SECONDS=12          # preferred speech window
PV_MAX_TEXT_CHARS=5000
PV_TMP_DIR=./tmp                        # worker scratch

# ───────────────────────────── Docker compose (not read by the app) ─────
POSTGRES_USER=projectvoice              # compose Postgres role; PV_DATABASE_URL inside compose is derived from these three
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=projectvoice          # CHANGE in production (compose builds PV_DATABASE_URL from it)
POSTGRES_DB=projectvoice
PV_IMAGE_TAG=dev                        # tag for the locally built images
PV_API_WORKERS=1                        # uvicorn worker processes in the api container (prod default 2)
PV_WORKER_QUEUES=voice,generation       # queues one worker container consumes (split per GPU/host if needed)
CADDY_HTTP_PORT=80                      # dev: host port Caddy listens on
CADDY_MAX_BODY=32MB                     # proxy request-body limit; must exceed PV_MAX_UPLOAD_MB (+ multipart overhead)
DOMAIN=                                 # prod: public host name (automatic HTTPS); e.g. voice.example.com
ACME_EMAIL=                             # prod: contact e-mail for the ACME certificate account
# Resource limits used by docker-compose.prod.yml (optional overrides)
# POSTGRES_CPUS=1.0  POSTGRES_MEMORY=1g  REDIS_MAXMEMORY=256mb  REDIS_MEMORY=384m
# API_CPUS=1.0  API_MEMORY=768m  API_REPLICAS=1  WORKER_CPUS=2.0  WORKER_MEMORY=6g  WORKER_MEMORY_RESERVE=2g
# NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all            # docker-compose.gpu.yml: pin a GPU (e.g. 0)

# ───────────────────────────── MinIO (docker compose --profile s3) ───────
MINIO_ROOT_USER=                        # >= 3 chars; set together with PV_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3 and the PV_S3_* block above
MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=                    # >= 8 chars, random; generate: openssl rand -base64 24
# With the s3 profile use: PV_STORAGE_BACKEND=s3  PV_S3_ENDPOINT_URL=http://minio:9000  PV_S3_BUCKET=project-voice
#                          PV_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$MINIO_ROOT_USER  PV_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD  PV_S3_USE_PATH_STYLE=true

# ───────────────────────────── Frontend (Next.js) ───────────────────────
API_INTERNAL_URL=http://localhost:8000  # server-side rewrite target for /api/* (compose sets http://api:8000); never exposed to the browser
NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_BASE=                    # leave EMPTY: the browser derives ws(s)://<same origin>/api/v1/conversation/ws. Only set (e.g. ws://localhost:8000)
                                        # when the WebSocket is NOT proxied by the same origin (dev without Caddy and without the Next.js proxy)

# ───────────────────────────── Tests / E2E helpers ───────────────────────
PV_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://projectvoice:projectvoice@localhost:5432/projectvoice_test   # pytest integration DB (schema is dropped/recreated!)
PV_TEST_REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379/1                                                             # pytest Redis (db 1 is flushed)
PV_E2E_BASE=http://localhost:8000       # scripts/e2e_api.py / e2e_ws.py target
PV_E2E_RESTART_CMD=                     # optional shell command e2e_api.py runs to restart the API for the persistence check
# Backups (infra/scripts/backup.sh): BACKUP_ROOT=./backups  RETENTION=7  PG_CONTAINER=postgres (to pg_dump inside compose)
```

## backend/Dockerfile

```dockerfile
# PROJECT VOICE — API image (FastAPI + uvicorn). No speech models: see Dockerfile.worker.
#
# Multi-stage: dependencies are resolved in a builder stage into a self-contained virtualenv
# which is copied into a slim runtime stage that has no compiler toolchain.
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7

ARG PYTHON_IMAGE=python:3.11.10-slim-bookworm

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ builder
FROM ${PYTHON_IMAGE} AS builder

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
    PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1 \
    VIRTUAL_ENV=/opt/venv
ENV PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && python -m venv "$VIRTUAL_ENV" \
    && pip install --upgrade pip wheel

WORKDIR /src
COPY pyproject.toml README.md ./
COPY app ./app
COPY alembic ./alembic
COPY alembic.ini ./
# `realtime` adds sherpa-onnx (ONNX Runtime only, no torch) so Conversation mode's server-side
# VAD + Whisper can run inside the API. Build with --build-arg API_EXTRAS="" to leave it out.
ARG API_EXTRAS=realtime
RUN if [ -n "$API_EXTRAS" ]; then pip install ".[${API_EXTRAS}]"; else pip install .; fi

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ runtime
FROM ${PYTHON_IMAGE} AS runtime

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    VIRTUAL_ENV=/opt/venv
ENV PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"

# ffprobe validates uploads; libsndfile backs `soundfile` (conversation PCM decoding); curl → healthcheck.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ffmpeg libsndfile1 curl tini \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && groupadd --system --gid 10001 app \
    && useradd --system --uid 10001 --gid app --home /app --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app

WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /opt/venv /opt/venv
COPY --chown=app:app pyproject.toml README.md alembic.ini ./
COPY --chown=app:app app ./app
COPY --chown=app:app alembic ./alembic
COPY --chown=app:app docker/entrypoint-api.sh /usr/local/bin/entrypoint-api.sh
RUN chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/entrypoint-api.sh \
    && mkdir -p /data/storage /data/tmp /models \
    && chown -R app:app /app /data /models

ENV PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR=/data/storage \
    PV_TMP_DIR=/data/tmp \
    PV_MODELS_DIR=/models

USER app
EXPOSE 8000
VOLUME ["/data"]

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=30s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/system/health || exit 1

# The entrypoint waits for PostgreSQL, runs `alembic upgrade head` (PV_SKIP_MIGRATIONS=1 to
# disable) and then execs uvicorn behind tini so signals reach the server.
ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/usr/local/bin/entrypoint-api.sh"]
CMD []

```

## backend/Dockerfile.worker

```
# PROJECT VOICE — CPU worker image (RQ worker + AI engine, no GPU).
#
# Multi-stage: the heavy Python dependencies (CPU-only torch wheels, sherpa-onnx, librosa,
# faster-whisper) are installed into a virtualenv in the builder and copied into a slim runtime.
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7

ARG PYTHON_IMAGE=python:3.11.10-slim-bookworm
ARG TORCH_INDEX_URL=https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
ARG TORCH_SPEC="torch>=2.2"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ builder
FROM ${PYTHON_IMAGE} AS builder
ARG TORCH_INDEX_URL
ARG TORCH_SPEC

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
    PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1 \
    VIRTUAL_ENV=/opt/venv
ENV PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && python -m venv "$VIRTUAL_ENV" \
    && pip install --upgrade pip wheel

WORKDIR /src
COPY pyproject.toml README.md ./
COPY app ./app
COPY alembic ./alembic
COPY alembic.ini ./
# CPU-only torch first so the `engine` extra does not drag the CUDA build in.
RUN pip install --index-url "${TORCH_INDEX_URL}" "${TORCH_SPEC}" \
    && pip install ".[engine]"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ runtime
FROM ${PYTHON_IMAGE} AS runtime

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 \
    VIRTUAL_ENV=/opt/venv
ENV PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"

# ffmpeg/ffprobe decode and encode every file; libsndfile → soundfile; libgomp → onnxruntime/torch.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ffmpeg libsndfile1 libgomp1 tini \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && groupadd --system --gid 10001 app \
    && useradd --system --uid 10001 --gid app --home /app --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app

WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /opt/venv /opt/venv
COPY --chown=app:app pyproject.toml README.md alembic.ini ./
COPY --chown=app:app app ./app
COPY --chown=app:app alembic ./alembic
RUN mkdir -p /data/storage /data/tmp /models && chown -R app:app /app /data /models

ENV PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR=/data/storage \
    PV_TMP_DIR=/data/tmp \
    PV_MODELS_DIR=/models \
    PV_ENGINE_DEVICE=cpu

USER app
VOLUME ["/models", "/data"]

# Liveness: the heartbeat thread refreshes pv:worker:<host>:<pid> in Redis every 30 s (TTL 90 s).
HEALTHCHECK --interval=60s --timeout=10s --start-period=120s --retries=3 \
    CMD python -c "import socket,sys,redis;from app.core.config import get_settings;r=redis.Redis.from_url(get_settings().REDIS_URL);sys.exit(0 if any(r.scan_iter('pv:worker:'+socket.gethostname()+':*')) else 1)"

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--"]
CMD ["python", "-m", "app.jobs.worker", "--queues", "voice,generation"]

```

## backend/Dockerfile.worker.cuda

```
# PROJECT VOICE — CUDA worker image (RQ worker + AI engine on an NVIDIA GPU).
#
# Run with `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.gpu.yml up`, or
# `docker run --gpus all …`. Requires the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the host.
#
# NOT built in the authoring environment: download.pytorch.org (torch cu12x wheels) was blocked
# there. The layout mirrors Dockerfile.worker; only the base image, the torch index and the
# device default differ.
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7

ARG CUDA_IMAGE=nvidia/cuda:12.4.1-cudnn-runtime-ubuntu22.04
ARG TORCH_INDEX_URL=https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124
ARG TORCH_SPEC="torch>=2.2"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ builder
FROM ${CUDA_IMAGE} AS builder
ARG TORCH_INDEX_URL
ARG TORCH_SPEC

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
    PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1 \
    VIRTUAL_ENV=/opt/venv
ENV PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"

# Ubuntu 22.04 ships Python 3.10; install 3.11 from deadsnakes so the worker matches the API image.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends software-properties-common ca-certificates curl gnupg \
    && add-apt-repository -y ppa:deadsnakes/ppa \
    && apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        python3.11 python3.11-venv python3.11-dev build-essential \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && python3.11 -m venv "$VIRTUAL_ENV" \
    && pip install --upgrade pip wheel

WORKDIR /src
COPY pyproject.toml README.md ./
COPY app ./app
COPY alembic ./alembic
COPY alembic.ini ./
# CUDA 12.4 torch wheels from the official PyTorch index, then the engine extras.
# sherpa-onnx's CUDA provider is a separate wheel; the default wheel runs ONNX on CPU, which is
# fine (ZipVoice/Whisper/VAD are light), while F5-TTS / IndicF5 use torch on the GPU.
RUN pip install --index-url "${TORCH_INDEX_URL}" "${TORCH_SPEC}" \
    && pip install ".[engine]"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ runtime
FROM ${CUDA_IMAGE} AS runtime

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    VIRTUAL_ENV=/opt/venv \
    NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all \
    NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,utility
ENV PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends software-properties-common ca-certificates \
    && add-apt-repository -y ppa:deadsnakes/ppa \
    && apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        python3.11 libpython3.11 ffmpeg libsndfile1 libgomp1 tini \
    && apt-get purge -y --auto-remove software-properties-common \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && groupadd --system --gid 10001 app \
    && useradd --system --uid 10001 --gid app --home /app --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app

WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /opt/venv /opt/venv
COPY --chown=app:app pyproject.toml README.md alembic.ini ./
COPY --chown=app:app app ./app
COPY --chown=app:app alembic ./alembic
RUN mkdir -p /data/storage /data/tmp /models && chown -R app:app /app /data /models

ENV PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR=/data/storage \
    PV_TMP_DIR=/data/tmp \
    PV_MODELS_DIR=/models \
    PV_ENGINE_DEVICE=cuda \
    PV_ENGINE_ALLOW_CPU_FALLBACK=true

USER app
VOLUME ["/models", "/data"]

HEALTHCHECK --interval=60s --timeout=10s --start-period=180s --retries=3 \
    CMD python -c "import socket,sys,redis;from app.core.config import get_settings;r=redis.Redis.from_url(get_settings().REDIS_URL);sys.exit(0 if any(r.scan_iter('pv:worker:'+socket.gethostname()+':*')) else 1)"

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--"]
CMD ["python", "-m", "app.jobs.worker", "--queues", "voice,generation"]

```

## backend/README.md

````markdown
# PROJECT VOICE — backend

FastAPI API + RQ worker sharing one package (`app/`). The API never loads a speech model; the
worker (`python -m app.jobs.worker`) is the only process that touches the engine
(`app/engine`, owned by the engine team) and is reached through the `VoicePipeline` facade.

```
app/
├── main.py            app factory, middleware (request id, security headers, CORS), lifespan
├── cli.py             python -m app.cli create-user | reset-password | cleanup
├── core/              config (PV_*), security, logging, errors, ratelimit, deps, cookies, ids
├── db/                async + sync sessions, declarative base, models/ (one file per aggregate)
├── storage/           StorageBackend protocol, LocalStorage, S3Storage, key layout
├── schemas/           Pydantic request/response models (the public contract)
├── services/          business logic — ownership checks live here, never only in routers
├── api/v1/            routers: auth users voices generations jobs system api_keys audit media conversation
├── jobs/              queues, voice_jobs, generation_jobs, progress, maintenance, worker
├── engine/            AI engine (engine team) — imported lazily, only inside jobs / handlers
└── audio/             audio pipeline (engine team)
alembic/               migrations (0001_initial_schema, 0002_widen_model_registry_text)
docker/                entrypoint-api.sh (wait for DB → alembic upgrade head → uvicorn)
tests/                 unit + integration (real PostgreSQL + Redis)
```

## Local development

Prerequisites: Python 3.11+, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, FFmpeg (`ffprobe` on PATH).

```bash
cd backend
python -m venv ../.venv && source ../.venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"            # add ".[engine]" on the worker host

# databases (first time)
sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE ROLE projectvoice LOGIN PASSWORD 'projectvoice';"
sudo -u postgres createdb -O projectvoice projectvoice
sudo -u postgres createdb -O projectvoice projectvoice_test
redis-server --daemonize yes

cp ../.env.example ../.env         # edit PV_SECRET_KEY etc.; the API reads ./.env from its CWD
alembic upgrade head               # apply migrations
uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000        # API → http://localhost:8000/api/docs
python -m app.jobs.worker                        # worker (queues: voice, generation)
python -m app.cli create-user you@example.com    # operator CLI
```

`.env` is read from the current working directory; every variable is documented in
`../.env.example` (also copied here as `.env.example`; keep the two in sync).

### Tests and quality gates

```bash
pytest -q                               # 202 tests (~150 s incl. real-inference model tests; -m "not model" ≈ 30 s), uses projectvoice_test + redis db 1
ruff check app tests alembic && ruff format --check app tests
mypy app --ignore-missing-imports
alembic check                           # models vs. migrations drift
```

Integration tests create the schema from the migrations once per session, truncate every table
between tests and wipe the temp storage directory. Set `PV_TEST_DATABASE_URL` /
`PV_TEST_REDIS_URL` to point elsewhere.

The job layer is tested with a small fake pipeline injected through the `pipeline=` keyword of
`create_voice_job` / `generation_job` (the production path calls `VoicePipeline.get()`); the fake
returns the real dataclasses from `app/engine/types.py`, including `EngineError` subclasses so the
error-code mapping is exercised.

## Docker

| Image | Base | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Dockerfile` | `python:3.11.10-slim-bookworm` (multi-stage, non-root) + ffmpeg + libsndfile + `.[realtime]` (sherpa-onnx for Conversation mode) | API (`uvicorn`, port 8000) |
| `Dockerfile.worker` | same base + CPU torch (`download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu`) + `.[engine]` | RQ worker, CPU |
| `Dockerfile.worker.cuda` | `nvidia/cuda:12.4.1-cudnn-runtime-ubuntu22.04` + Python 3.11 + cu124 torch + `.[engine]` | RQ worker, GPU |

Volumes: `/models` (weights, `PV_MODELS_DIR`, read-only) and `/data` (`PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR`,
`PV_TMP_DIR` for the local storage backend). The API image's entrypoint
(`docker/entrypoint-api.sh`) waits for PostgreSQL, runs `alembic upgrade head` (skip with
`PV_SKIP_MIGRATIONS=1` when CI migrates) and then execs uvicorn; Alembic's version-table lock
makes concurrent replicas safe. Compose files live in the repo root (`docker-compose.yml`,
`docker-compose.prod.yml`, `docker-compose.gpu.yml`); see `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`.

## How the pieces fit

* **Auth** — Argon2id passwords; 15-min HS256 access JWT (`pv_access`, carries `sid`/`jti`) and a
  30-day rotating refresh token (`pv_refresh`, SHA-256 stored in `user_sessions`, path-scoped to
  `/api/v1/auth`). Replaying a rotated refresh token revokes the session. Cookie-authenticated
  `POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE` must send `X-CSRF-Token` = `pv_csrf`; `Authorization: Bearer pv_live_…`
  API keys are exempt. Every request with a cookie also checks the session row, so logout is
  immediate.
* **Voices** — multipart upload → extension allow-list → size cap while streaming → magic bytes →
  `ffprobe` (audio stream, 3–120 s) → original stored at
  `users/{u}/voices/{v}/reference/original.{ext}` → `voice_profiles` (processing) + `voice_consents`
  + `voice_reference_files` + `processing_jobs` → RQ `create_voice_job` on queue `voice`.
  `consent_confirmed` must be true (`422 consent_required`). `Idempotency-Key` replays return the
  original voice with `200`.
* **Generations** — NFC + whitespace normalisation, 1–`PV_MAX_TEXT_CHARS`; voice must be `ready`
  with an active consent (`422 voice_not_ready` / `403 consent_required`); the language/engine is
  checked against `model_registry` (`422 language_unsupported` with `details.supported_engines`,
  `503 no_engine_available`); job enqueued on `generation`. Audio streams with `Range` support;
  `?download=1` adds `Content-Disposition: attachment`; `/audio-url` returns an HMAC-signed
  `/api/v1/media/{token}` link (or a pre-signed S3 URL).
* **Worker** — `python -m app.jobs.worker` probes `VoicePipeline.get()`, starts the heartbeat
  thread (`pv:worker:{host}:{pid}`, TTL 90 s, every 30 s; upserts `model_registry`; caches
  `pv:language_matrix`; enqueues `cleanup_job` every `PV_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MINUTES` under a Redis
  lock) and then runs an RQ worker. Job functions use the sync psycopg session; progress is
  written through a throttled (≥250 ms) autocommit connection so the API sees it live.
  `EngineError.code` is copied to `processing_jobs.error` and the resource's `error`; anything else
  becomes `internal_error` with a sanitised message.
* **Deletion** — real: DB rows + storage objects. With `PV_RETENTION_DELETE_DELAY_HOURS > 0`
  rows are hidden immediately and purged by the cleanup job after the delay.
* **Conversation** — `WS /api/v1/conversation/ws?voice_id=&engine=mirror|llm[&language=]`
  (cookie auth). Server-side VAD (`UtteranceDetector`) and Whisper (`Transcriber`) from
  `app.engine.realtime`; the reply is spoken through a front-of-queue `generation` job
  (`kind=conversation_turn`) polled every 250 ms; PCM16 is streamed back in 200 ms frames.
  Close codes: `4001` unauthenticated, `4004` voice unavailable, `4008` timeout.

## Contract notes for the frontend (API_DOCUMENTATION.md)

The implementation follows the document; the small clarifications below are the only places
where behaviour had to be pinned down beyond what the doc states.

1. `Voice.reference.speech_seconds` is `null` while the voice is `processing` (the value comes
   from VAD in the worker and is never estimated). The rest of `reference` is populated at upload.
2. `Generation.language` is `null` only when `language: "auto"` was requested *and* the voice has
   no known language yet; otherwise it holds the voice's language until the worker replaces it with
   the detected one.
3. `Job.kind` additionally allows `conversation_turn` (INTERNAL_CONTRACTS §F).
4. Fetching `/generations/{id}/audio` or `/audio-url` before completion returns
   `409 generation_not_completed`.
5. Reusing an `Idempotency-Key` with a different body returns `409 idempotency_conflict` instead of
   silently returning an unrelated resource.
6. `POST /auth/refresh` and `/auth/logout` require the `X-CSRF-Token` header like every other
   cookie-authenticated mutation; `/auth/register` and `/auth/login` do not (no ambient credential).
7. `GET /system/metrics` returns global queue depths/workers and **per-user** `generations_24h` /
   `voices_total`.
8. `GET /system/languages` serves the worker's cached matrix from Redis (`pv:language_matrix`); if no
   worker has reported yet it builds it from `VoicePipeline` when the engine package is installed,
   else `503 engine_unavailable`. `GET /system/hardware` is `503 engine_unavailable` in an API image
   without the engine package.
9. Conversation timeouts: the 30 s turn budget covers transcription + response (breach → `4008`);
   synthesis waits up to `PV_CONVERSATION_SYNTH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` (60 s) and on breach sends
   `{"type":"error","code":"synthesis_timeout"}` and returns to `listening`.
10. `GET /generations` also accepts `limit`/`offset`; `voice_id` and `status` filter as documented.

## Limitations of the build environment

* `huggingface.co` and `download.pytorch.org` are blocked here, so the engine package's F5-TTS /
  IndicF5 weights cannot be fetched; the API and worker treat a missing engine package or missing
  weights as a reported condition (`model_registry.available=false`, `503 engine_unavailable`),
  never as a crash. The Dockerfiles install torch from `download.pytorch.org` and must be built
  where that host is reachable.
* Docker images were written and the compose files validated (`docker compose config`) but the
  images were **not built** here: Docker Hub returned HTTP 403 through the egress proxy. They
  follow the same layout as the local venv install.
* S3Storage is implemented with boto3 (MinIO `endpoint_url`, path-style, pre-signed GET) and unit
  tests cover the LocalStorage backend; no S3 endpoint was available here to run it against.
* The conversation WebSocket was exercised end to end with real audio (`scripts/e2e_ws.py`,
  `evidence/e2e_ws_log.txt`). Without `app.engine.realtime`'s dependencies (sherpa-onnx, the
  `realtime` extra) the socket answers `engine_unavailable` and closes with `1011`. When Whisper
  auto-detects a language no engine speaks the turn is rejected with `language_unsupported`
  instead of synthesising it; clients pin the language with `?language=`.

````

## backend/alembic/env.py

```python
"""Alembic environment.

Runs online migrations through the synchronous psycopg driver (the same one the worker uses) so
``alembic upgrade head`` works from any container without an event loop.  When the configured URL
is an asyncpg URL it is translated automatically.  Offline mode emits SQL.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from logging.config import fileConfig
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy import engine_from_config, pool

from alembic import context

BACKEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(BACKEND_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND_DIR))

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.db import models  # noqa: F401  (registers every table)
from app.db.base import Base

config = context.config
if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

target_metadata = Base.metadata


def _database_url() -> str:
    override = os.environ.get("ALEMBIC_DATABASE_URL")
    if override:
        return override
    return get_settings().sync_database_url


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    context.configure(
        url=_database_url(),
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
        compare_type=True,
        compare_server_default=True,
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    section = config.get_section(config.config_ini_section) or {}
    section["sqlalchemy.url"] = _database_url()
    connectable = engine_from_config(section, prefix="sqlalchemy.", poolclass=pool.NullPool)
    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(
            connection=connection,
            target_metadata=target_metadata,
            compare_type=True,
            compare_server_default=True,
        )
        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()
    connectable.dispose()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

```

```python
"""initial schema

Revision ID: 0001
Revises: —
Create Date: 2026-11-09 10:59:40.757309+00:00
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence

import sqlalchemy as sa
from alembic import op
from sqlalchemy.dialects import postgresql

revision: str = '0001'
down_revision: str | None = None
branch_labels: str | Sequence[str] | None = None
depends_on: str | Sequence[str] | None = None


def upgrade() -> None:
    op.create_table('model_registry',
    sa.Column('engine_id', sa.String(length=64), nullable=False),
    sa.Column('name', sa.String(length=128), nullable=False),
    sa.Column('version', sa.String(length=64), nullable=False),
    sa.Column('licence', sa.String(length=128), nullable=False),
    sa.Column('weight_licence', sa.String(length=128), nullable=False),
    sa.Column('available', sa.Boolean(), nullable=False),
    sa.Column('unavailable_reason', sa.Text(), nullable=True),
    sa.Column('loaded', sa.Boolean(), nullable=False),
    sa.Column('device', sa.String(length=8), nullable=True),
    sa.Column('tts_languages', postgresql.JSONB(astext_type=sa.Text()), nullable=False),
    sa.Column('cloning_languages', postgresql.JSONB(astext_type=sa.Text()), nullable=False),
    sa.Column('cross_lingual', sa.Boolean(), nullable=False),
```

```python
"""widen model_registry licence/version columns

Revision ID: 0002
Revises: 0001
Create Date: 2026-11-09 12:25:00+00:00

The engine registry reports full licence notes (e.g. the ZipVoice weight licence explains the
Emilia dataset terms in ~190 characters) and composite version strings; the original
``VARCHAR(128)``/``VARCHAR(64)`` columns truncated the worker's upsert and the registry was never
written.  Text columns remove the limit.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence

import sqlalchemy as sa
from alembic import op

revision: str = "0002"
down_revision: str | None = "0001"
branch_labels: str | Sequence[str] | None = None
depends_on: str | Sequence[str] | None = None


def upgrade() -> None:
    op.alter_column(
        "model_registry", "name", type_=sa.Text(), existing_type=sa.String(length=128)
    )
    op.alter_column(
        "model_registry", "version", type_=sa.Text(), existing_type=sa.String(length=64)
    )
    op.alter_column(
        "model_registry", "licence", type_=sa.Text(), existing_type=sa.String(length=128)
    )
    op.alter_column(
        "model_registry",
        "weight_licence",
        type_=sa.Text(),
        existing_type=sa.String(length=128),
    )


def downgrade() -> None:
    # Values longer than the old limits are truncated on downgrade.
    op.execute("UPDATE model_registry SET weight_licence = LEFT(weight_licence, 128)")
    op.execute("UPDATE model_registry SET licence = LEFT(licence, 128)")
    op.execute("UPDATE model_registry SET version = LEFT(version, 64)")
    op.execute("UPDATE model_registry SET name = LEFT(name, 128)")
    op.alter_column(
        "model_registry", "weight_licence", type_=sa.String(length=128), existing_type=sa.Text()
    )
    op.alter_column(
        "model_registry", "licence", type_=sa.String(length=128), existing_type=sa.Text()
    )
    op.alter_column(
        "model_registry", "version", type_=sa.String(length=64), existing_type=sa.Text()
    )
    op.alter_column(
        "model_registry", "name", type_=sa.String(length=128), existing_type=sa.Text()
    )
```

```python
"""Operator CLI: ``python -m app.cli <command>``.

Commands: ``create-user``, ``reset-password``, ``cleanup``.  Uses the synchronous session so it
works anywhere the worker works (no event loop, no asyncpg).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import getpass
import sys

from sqlalchemy import select

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.logging import configure_logging
from app.core.security import hash_password
from app.db.models import User
from app.db.models.user import default_preferences
from app.db.sync_session import sync_session_scope
from app.services.auth_service import normalise_email


def _read_password(provided: str | None) -> str:
    settings = get_settings()
    password = provided or getpass.getpass("Password: ")
    if not settings.PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH <= len(password) <= settings.PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH:
        raise SystemExit(
            "password must be between "
            f"{settings.PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH} and {settings.PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH} characters"
        )
    return password


def cmd_create_user(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    email = normalise_email(args.email)
    password = _read_password(args.password)
    with sync_session_scope() as session:
        if session.scalar(select(User.id).where(User.email == email)) is not None:
            print(f"error: a user with email {email} already exists", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        user = User(
            email=email,
            password_hash=hash_password(password),
            display_name=args.display_name or email.split("@")[0],
            preferences=default_preferences(),
        )
        session.add(user)
        session.flush()
        print(f"created user {user.id} <{email}>")
    return 0


def cmd_reset_password(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    email = normalise_email(args.email)
    password = _read_password(args.password)
    with sync_session_scope() as session:
        user = session.scalar(select(User).where(User.email == email))
        if user is None:
            print(f"error: no user with email {email}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        user.password_hash = hash_password(password)
        if args.revoke_sessions:
            from datetime import UTC, datetime

            for user_session in user.sessions:
                if user_session.revoked_at is None:
                    user_session.revoked_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        print(
            f"password updated for {email}"
            + (" (sessions revoked)" if args.revoke_sessions else "")
        )
    return 0


def cmd_cleanup(_: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    from app.jobs.maintenance import cleanup_job

    stats = cleanup_job()
    for key, value in stats.items():
        print(f"{key}: {value}")
    return 0


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="pv", description="PROJECT VOICE operator CLI")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    create = sub.add_parser("create-user", help="create a user account")
    create.add_argument("email")
    create.add_argument("--password", help="password (prompted when omitted)")
    create.add_argument("--display-name", dest="display_name", default=None)
    create.set_defaults(func=cmd_create_user)

    reset = sub.add_parser("reset-password", help="set a new password for a user")
    reset.add_argument("email")
    reset.add_argument("--password", help="new password (prompted when omitted)")
    reset.add_argument(
        "--revoke-sessions", action="store_true", help="also sign the user out everywhere"
    )
    reset.set_defaults(func=cmd_reset_password)

    cleanup = sub.add_parser("cleanup", help="run the maintenance cleanup job now")
    cleanup.set_defaults(func=cmd_cleanup)
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    configure_logging(get_settings())
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    return int(args.func(args))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
"""FastAPI application factory.

Run with ``uvicorn app.main:app``.  The API never loads a speech model; everything heavy is in
the worker (``python -m app.jobs.worker``).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from sqlalchemy import text
from starlette.types import ASGIApp, Message, Receive, Scope, Send

from app import __version__
from app.api.v1.router import api_router
from app.core.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.core.errors import register_exception_handlers
from app.core.logging import RequestIdMiddleware, configure_logging, get_logger
from app.core.redis import close_async_redis, get_async_redis
from app.db.session import dispose_engine, get_engine
from app.storage import get_storage

log = get_logger(__name__)


class SecurityHeadersMiddleware:
    """Conservative defaults for an API that only serves JSON and private audio."""

    HEADERS = (
        (b"x-content-type-options", b"nosniff"),
        (b"x-frame-options", b"DENY"),
        (b"referrer-policy", b"no-referrer"),
        (b"cross-origin-resource-policy", b"same-site"),
        (b"permissions-policy", b"camera=(), geolocation=()"),
    )

    def __init__(self, app: ASGIApp, *, hsts: bool) -> None:
        self.app = app
        self.hsts = hsts

    async def __call__(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
        if scope["type"] != "http":
            await self.app(scope, receive, send)
            return

        async def send_with_headers(message: Message) -> None:
            if message["type"] == "http.response.start":
                headers = list(message.get("headers", []))
                present = {name for name, _ in headers}
                for name, value in self.HEADERS:
                    if name not in present:
                        headers.append((name, value))
                if self.hsts and b"strict-transport-security" not in present:
                    headers.append(
                        (b"strict-transport-security", b"max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains")
                    )
                message["headers"] = headers
            await send(message)

        await self.app(scope, receive, send_with_headers)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
    settings: Settings = app.state.settings
    async with get_engine().connect() as conn:
        await conn.execute(text("SELECT 1"))
    log.info("database_connected")
    try:
        await get_async_redis().ping()
        log.info("redis_connected")
    except Exception as exc:
        log.warning("redis_unavailable_at_startup", error=str(exc))
    get_storage()  # fail fast on misconfiguration (e.g. unwritable directory)
    log.info("api_started", env=settings.ENV, version=__version__, storage=settings.STORAGE_BACKEND)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        await close_async_redis()
        await dispose_engine()
        log.info("api_stopped")


def create_app(settings: Settings | None = None) -> FastAPI:
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    configure_logging(settings)

    app = FastAPI(
        title=settings.APP_NAME,
        version=__version__,
        description="Your voice. Your words. — personal voice cloning and speech synthesis.",
        docs_url="/api/docs",
        redoc_url=None,
        openapi_url="/api/openapi.json",
        lifespan=lifespan,
    )
    app.state.settings = settings

    # Middleware order: outermost first. Request id wraps everything so error responses carry it.
    app.add_middleware(SecurityHeadersMiddleware, hsts=settings.ENV == "production")
    app.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=settings.CORS_ORIGINS,
        allow_credentials=True,
        allow_methods=["GET", "POST", "PATCH", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS", "HEAD"],
        allow_headers=[
            "Authorization",
            "Content-Type",
            "X-CSRF-Token",
            "Idempotency-Key",
            "Range",
            "X-Request-ID",
        ],
        expose_headers=[
            "X-Request-ID",
            "Retry-After",
            "Content-Range",
            "Accept-Ranges",
            "Content-Disposition",
        ],
        max_age=600,
    )
    app.add_middleware(RequestIdMiddleware)

    register_exception_handlers(app)
    app.include_router(api_router, prefix="/api/v1")
    return app


app = create_app()
```

```python
"""Small helpers shared by routers."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Annotated, Any

from fastapi import Header, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError

from app.core.errors import UnprocessableEntity


def validation_error_from(exc: ValidationError) -> UnprocessableEntity:
    fields: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for err in exc.errors():
        fields.append(
            {
                "loc": ["body", *[str(p) for p in err.get("loc", ())]],
                "msg": str(err.get("msg", "")),
                "type": str(err.get("type", "")),
            }
        )
    return UnprocessableEntity(
        "The request is invalid.", code="validation_error", details={"fields": fields}
    )


def validate_model(model: type[BaseModel], data: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
    try:
        return model.model_validate(data)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        raise validation_error_from(exc) from exc


def parse_bool_field(value: str | bool | None) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if value is None:
        return False
    return value.strip().lower() in {"true", "1", "yes", "on"}


LimitQuery = Annotated[int, Query(ge=1, le=100)]
OffsetQuery = Annotated[int, Query(ge=0)]
IdempotencyKeyHeader = Annotated[str | None, Header(alias="Idempotency-Key")]
```
