## backend/app/api/v1/auth.py

```python
"""Auth endpoints: register, login, refresh, logout, csrf."""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request, Response, status

from app.core.cookies import (
    ACCESS_COOKIE,
    CSRF_COOKIE,
    CSRF_HEADER,
    REFRESH_COOKIE,
    clear_auth_cookies,
    set_auth_cookies,
    set_csrf_cookie,
)
from app.core.deps import DbSession, RateLimitByIp, RequestCtx, SettingsDep
from app.core.errors import Forbidden, Unauthenticated
from app.core.security import (
    InvalidToken,
    constant_time_equals,
    decode_access_token,
    generate_csrf_token,
)
from app.schemas.auth import AuthResponse, CsrfResponse, LoginRequest, RegisterRequest
from app.services import audit_service, auth_service
from app.services.audit_service import AuditAction
from app.services.serializers import user_to_out

router = APIRouter(prefix="/auth", tags=["auth"])

auth_rate_limit = RateLimitByIp("auth")


def _require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:
    """Double-submit check for cookie-based mutating auth routes (refresh / logout)."""
    cookie_value = request.cookies.get(CSRF_COOKIE)
    header_value = request.headers.get(CSRF_HEADER)
    if not cookie_value or not constant_time_equals(cookie_value, header_value):
        raise Forbidden("Missing or invalid CSRF token.", code="csrf_invalid")


@router.post(
    "/register",
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    response_model=AuthResponse,
    dependencies=[Depends(auth_rate_limit)],
)
async def register(
    body: RegisterRequest,
    response: Response,
    session: DbSession,
    settings: SettingsDep,
    ctx: RequestCtx,
) -> AuthResponse:
    user = await auth_service.register(
        session, email=body.email, password=body.password, display_name=body.display_name, ctx=ctx
    )
    tokens = await auth_service.start_session(session, user, ctx=ctx, settings=settings)
    audit_service.record(session, user_id=user.id, action=AuditAction.AUTH_LOGIN, ctx=ctx)
    await session.commit()
    set_auth_cookies(
        response,
        access_token=tokens.access_token,
        refresh_token=tokens.refresh_token,
        csrf_token=generate_csrf_token(),
        settings=settings,
    )
    return AuthResponse(user=user_to_out(user))


@router.post("/login", response_model=AuthResponse, dependencies=[Depends(auth_rate_limit)])
async def login(
    body: LoginRequest,
    response: Response,
    session: DbSession,
    settings: SettingsDep,
    ctx: RequestCtx,
) -> AuthResponse:
    try:
        user = await auth_service.authenticate(
            session, email=body.email, password=body.password, ctx=ctx
        )
    except Unauthenticated:
        await session.commit()  # persist the failed-login audit row
        raise
    tokens = await auth_service.start_session(session, user, ctx=ctx, settings=settings)
    await session.commit()
    set_auth_cookies(
        response,
        access_token=tokens.access_token,
        refresh_token=tokens.refresh_token,
        csrf_token=generate_csrf_token(),
        settings=settings,
    )
    return AuthResponse(user=user_to_out(user))


@router.post("/refresh", response_model=AuthResponse, dependencies=[Depends(auth_rate_limit)])
async def refresh(
    request: Request, response: Response, session: DbSession, settings: SettingsDep, ctx: RequestCtx
) -> AuthResponse:
    raw = request.cookies.get(REFRESH_COOKIE)
    if not raw:
        raise Unauthenticated("No refresh token.", code="invalid_refresh_token")
    _require_csrf(request)
    try:
        user, tokens = await auth_service.rotate_session(session, raw, ctx=ctx, settings=settings)
    except Unauthenticated:
        await session.commit()  # persist replay-detection revocation, if any
        clear_auth_cookies(response, settings=settings)
        raise
    await session.commit()
    set_auth_cookies(
        response,
        access_token=tokens.access_token,
        refresh_token=tokens.refresh_token,
        csrf_token=generate_csrf_token(),
        settings=settings,
    )
    return AuthResponse(user=user_to_out(user))


@router.post("/logout", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT, response_class=Response)
async def logout(
    request: Request, session: DbSession, settings: SettingsDep, ctx: RequestCtx
) -> Response:
    """Revoke the current session (found via the refresh or the access cookie) and clear cookies.

    Idempotent: an already-expired or missing session still yields ``204`` with cleared cookies.
    """
    has_cookie = bool(request.cookies.get(REFRESH_COOKIE) or request.cookies.get(ACCESS_COOKIE))
    if has_cookie:
        _require_csrf(request)
    revoked_user_id = None
    raw_refresh = request.cookies.get(REFRESH_COOKIE)
    if raw_refresh:
        revoked = await auth_service.revoke_session_by_refresh(session, raw_refresh)
        if revoked is not None:
            revoked_user_id = revoked.user_id
    access = request.cookies.get(ACCESS_COOKIE)
    if access and revoked_user_id is None:
        try:
            claims = decode_access_token(access, settings=settings)
        except InvalidToken:
            claims = None
        if claims is not None:
            revoked = await auth_service.revoke_session_by_id(session, claims.session_id)
            if revoked is not None:
                revoked_user_id = revoked.user_id
    if revoked_user_id is not None:
        audit_service.record(
            session, user_id=revoked_user_id, action=AuditAction.AUTH_LOGOUT, ctx=ctx
        )
    await session.commit()
    response = Response(status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
    clear_auth_cookies(response, settings=settings)
    return response


@router.get("/csrf", response_model=CsrfResponse)
async def csrf(response: Response, settings: SettingsDep) -> CsrfResponse:
    token = generate_csrf_token()
    set_csrf_cookie(response, token, settings=settings)
    return CsrfResponse(csrf_token=token)

```

## backend/app/api/v1/conversation.py

```python
"""Conversation mode: engine listing and the turn-based WebSocket.

Pipeline per turn (ARCHITECTURE §9): PCM16 frames → server-side VAD (``UtteranceDetector``) →
Whisper (``Transcriber``) → response engine (``mirror`` | ``llm``) → synthesis through a
front-of-queue ``generation`` job → PCM16 streamed back.  Both realtime helpers come from
``app.engine.realtime`` and are imported lazily so the API boots without the engine package.

Close codes: 4001 unauthenticated · 4004 voice not found / not ready · 4008 timeout.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import contextlib
import io
import json
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any, Literal

import httpx
import numpy as np
from fastapi import APIRouter, Query, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.core.cookies import ACCESS_COOKIE
from app.core.deps import CurrentUser, SettingsDep
from app.core.errors import AppError, Unauthenticated
from app.core.logging import get_logger
from app.db.models import Generation, ProcessingJob, User, VoiceProfile, VoiceReferenceFile
from app.db.models.generation import GenerationKind, GenerationStatus
from app.db.session import get_sessionmaker
from app.schemas.conversation import ConversationEngineOut
from app.services import audit_service, auth_service, generation_service, voice_service
from app.services.audit_service import AuditAction, RequestContext
from app.services.generation_service import GenerationRequest
from app.storage import ObjectNotFound, get_storage

log = get_logger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/conversation", tags=["conversation"])

CLOSE_UNAUTHENTICATED = 4001
CLOSE_VOICE_UNAVAILABLE = 4004
CLOSE_TIMEOUT = 4008
CLOSE_SERVER_ERROR = 1011
CLOSE_POLICY = 1008

INPUT_SAMPLE_RATE = 16_000
PCM_CHUNK_SAMPLES = 4_800  # 200 ms at 24 kHz
POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 0.25

State = Literal["idle", "listening", "thinking", "speaking"]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Engines
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def llm_availability(settings: Settings) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
    """Probe the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (``GET /models``) when configured."""
    if not settings.CONVERSATION_LLM_BASE_URL:
        return (
            False,
            "Not configured: set PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_BASE_URL (and PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_MODEL).",
        )
    if not settings.CONVERSATION_LLM_MODEL:
        return False, "Not configured: set PV_CONVERSATION_LLM_MODEL."
    base = settings.CONVERSATION_LLM_BASE_URL.rstrip("/")
    headers = {}
    if settings.CONVERSATION_LLM_API_KEY:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {settings.CONVERSATION_LLM_API_KEY}"
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=3.0, headers=headers) as client:
            response = await client.get(f"{base}/models")
        if response.status_code >= 500:
            return False, f"LLM endpoint returned HTTP {response.status_code}."
        return True, None
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        return False, f"LLM endpoint unreachable: {type(exc).__name__}."


@router.get("/engines", response_model=list[ConversationEngineOut])
async def list_engines(auth: CurrentUser, settings: SettingsDep) -> list[ConversationEngineOut]:
    llm_ok, reason = await llm_availability(settings)
    return [
        ConversationEngineOut(id="mirror", available=True, reason=None),
        ConversationEngineOut(id="llm", available=llm_ok, reason=reason),
    ]


async def llm_reply(settings: Settings, messages: list[dict[str, str]]) -> str:
    base = (settings.CONVERSATION_LLM_BASE_URL or "").rstrip("/")
    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    if settings.CONVERSATION_LLM_API_KEY:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {settings.CONVERSATION_LLM_API_KEY}"
    payload = {
        "model": settings.CONVERSATION_LLM_MODEL,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": settings.CONVERSATION_LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
            *messages,
        ],
        "max_tokens": 200,
        "temperature": 0.7,
        "stream": False,
    }
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(
        timeout=settings.CONVERSATION_LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, headers=headers
    ) as client:
        response = await client.post(f"{base}/chat/completions", json=payload)
    response.raise_for_status()
    data = response.json()
    try:
        content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
    except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("unexpected chat completion payload") from exc
    text = " ".join(str(content).split())
    return text[: settings.CONVERSATION_MAX_TURN_CHARS]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Session
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass
class TurnContext:
    generation_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
    history: list[dict[str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)


class ConversationSession:
    def __init__(
        self,
        websocket: WebSocket,
        *,
        user: User,
        voice: VoiceProfile,
        engine: str,
        language_hint: str | None,
        settings: Settings,
        detector: Any,
        transcriber: Any,
    ) -> None:
        self.ws = websocket
        self.user = user
        self.voice = voice
        self.engine = engine
        self.language_hint = language_hint
        self.settings = settings
        self.detector = detector
        self.transcriber = transcriber
        self.state: State = "idle"
        self.turn_task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
        self.turn = TurnContext()
        self.closed = False
        self.ctx = RequestContext(
            ip=websocket.client.host if websocket.client else None,
            user_agent=websocket.headers.get("user-agent"),
        )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- messaging
    async def send_json(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if not self.closed:
            await self.ws.send_text(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")))

    async def set_state(self, state: State) -> None:
        self.state = state
        await self.send_json({"type": "state", "state": state})

    async def send_error(self, code: str, message: str) -> None:
        await self.send_json({"type": "error", "code": code, "message": message})

    async def close(self, code: int, reason: str = "") -> None:
        if self.closed:
            return
        self.closed = True
        await self._cancel_turn()
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            await self.ws.close(code=code, reason=reason[:120])

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- main loop
    async def run(self) -> None:
        await self.set_state("idle")
        idle_timeout = float(self.settings.CONVERSATION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
        try:
            while not self.closed:
                try:
                    message = await asyncio.wait_for(self.ws.receive(), timeout=idle_timeout)
                except TimeoutError:
                    await self.send_error("timeout", "No activity; closing the conversation.")
                    await self.close(CLOSE_TIMEOUT, "idle timeout")
                    return
                if message.get("type") == "websocket.disconnect":
                    return
                if message.get("bytes") is not None:
                    await self.on_audio(message["bytes"])
                elif message.get("text") is not None:
                    await self.on_text(message["text"])
        except WebSocketDisconnect:
            return
        finally:
            await self._cancel_turn()

    async def on_text(self, raw: str) -> None:
        try:
            payload = json.loads(raw)
            kind = payload.get("type")
        except (ValueError, AttributeError):
            await self.send_error("bad_message", "Text frames must be JSON objects with a 'type'.")
            return
        if kind == "start":
            await self._cancel_turn()
            await asyncio.to_thread(self.detector.flush)  # drop any partial audio
            await self.set_state("listening")
        elif kind == "stop":
            if self.state != "listening":
                return
            utterance = await asyncio.to_thread(self.detector.flush)
            if utterance is not None and len(utterance) > 0:
                self._start_turn(utterance)
        elif kind == "interrupt":
            await self._cancel_turn()
            await asyncio.to_thread(self.detector.flush)
            await self.set_state("listening")
        else:
            await self.send_error("bad_message", f"Unknown message type '{kind}'.")

    async def on_audio(self, data: bytes) -> None:
        if self.state == "idle":
            await self.set_state("listening")
        if self.state != "listening":
            return  # audio while thinking/speaking is ignored until the client interrupts
        utterances = await asyncio.to_thread(self.detector.feed, data)
        if utterances:
            self._start_turn(utterances[0])

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- turn handling
    def _start_turn(self, audio: np.ndarray) -> None:
        if self.turn_task is not None and not self.turn_task.done():
            return
        self.turn = TurnContext(history=self.turn.history)
        self.turn_task = asyncio.create_task(self._run_turn_guarded(audio))

    async def _cancel_turn(self) -> None:
        task = self.turn_task
        if task is not None and not task.done():
            task.cancel()
            with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError, Exception):
                await task
        self.turn_task = None

    async def _run_turn_guarded(self, audio: np.ndarray) -> None:
        try:
            await self._run_turn(audio)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            await self._cancel_pending_generation()
            raise
        except AppError as exc:
            await self.send_error(exc.code, exc.message)
            if not self.closed:
                await self.set_state("listening")
        except Exception as exc:
            log.exception("conversation_turn_failed", error_type=type(exc).__name__)
            await self.send_error("internal_error", "The turn failed unexpectedly.")
            if not self.closed:
                await self.set_state("listening")

    async def _run_turn(self, audio: np.ndarray) -> None:
        settings = self.settings
        await self.set_state("thinking")

        try:
            transcript, detected = await asyncio.wait_for(
                self._think(audio), timeout=float(settings.CONVERSATION_TURN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
            )
        except TimeoutError:
            await self.send_error("timeout", "The turn took too long.")
            await self.close(CLOSE_TIMEOUT, "turn timeout")
            return
        if transcript is None:
            await self.set_state("listening")
            return
        response_text = transcript if self.engine == "mirror" else await self._respond(transcript)
        if response_text is None:
            await self.set_state("listening")
            return
        await self.send_json({"type": "response", "text": response_text})

        generation = await self._enqueue_turn(response_text, detected)
        self.turn.generation_id = generation.id
        outcome = await self._await_generation(generation.id)
        if outcome is None:
            await self.send_error("synthesis_timeout", "Speech synthesis did not finish in time.")
            await self._cancel_pending_generation()
            await self.set_state("listening")
            return
        if outcome.status != GenerationStatus.COMPLETED or outcome.file is None:
            err = outcome.error or {
                "code": "synthesis_failed",
                "message": "Speech synthesis failed.",
            }
            await self.send_error(
                str(err.get("code", "synthesis_failed")), str(err.get("message", ""))
            )
            await self.set_state("listening")
            return
        await self._stream_audio(outcome.file)
        if not self.closed:
            await self.set_state("listening")

    async def _think(self, audio: np.ndarray) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
        language = None
        if self.language_hint:
            from app.engine.types import Language  # lazy

            language = Language(self.language_hint)
        raw_language: str | None = None
        detailed = getattr(self.transcriber, "transcribe_detailed", None)
        if detailed is not None:
            result = await asyncio.to_thread(detailed, audio, language)
            transcript, detected = result.text, result.language
            raw_language = getattr(result, "raw_language", None)
        else:
            transcript, detected = await asyncio.to_thread(
                self.transcriber.transcribe, audio, language
            )
        transcript = " ".join(str(transcript or "").split())
        if not transcript:
            await self.send_error("no_speech", "No speech was recognised in that utterance.")
            return None, None
        if language is None and detected is None and raw_language:
            # Whisper auto-detected a language no engine can speak (e.g. ``ja``).  Synthesising
            # that text with the voice's language would only produce garbage audio, so report it
            # and let the client pin the language (``?language=``) instead.
            await self.send_error(
                "language_unsupported",
                f"Speech was recognised as '{raw_language}', which no engine supports here. "
                "Reconnect with an explicit language to pin transcription.",
            )
            return None, None
        transcript = transcript[: self.settings.CONVERSATION_MAX_TURN_CHARS]
        await self.send_json({"type": "transcript", "text": transcript})
        detected_code = str(getattr(detected, "value", detected)) if detected else None
        return transcript, detected_code

    async def _respond(self, transcript: str) -> str | None:
        history = self.turn.history
        history.append({"role": "user", "content": transcript})
        try:
            reply = await llm_reply(self.settings, history[-10:])
        except (httpx.HTTPError, ValueError) as exc:
            log.warning("conversation_llm_failed", error_type=type(exc).__name__)
            history.pop()
            await self.send_error("llm_error", "The language model did not answer.")
            return None
        if not reply:
            history.pop()
            await self.send_error("llm_error", "The language model returned an empty reply.")
            return None
        history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": reply})
        del history[:-10]
        return reply

    async def _enqueue_turn(self, text: str, detected_language: str | None) -> Generation:
        language = detected_language or self.voice.language or "auto"
        async with get_sessionmaker()() as session:
            user = await session.get(User, self.user.id)
            if user is None:
                raise Unauthenticated()
            return await generation_service.create(
                session,
                user=user,
                request=GenerationRequest(
                    voice_id=self.voice.id,
                    text=text,
                    language=language,
                    engine_id=None,
                    speed=None,
                    output_format="wav",
                    quality="fast",
                    kind=GenerationKind.CONVERSATION_TURN,
                ),
                settings=self.settings,
                ctx=self.ctx,
                at_front=True,
            )

    async def _await_generation(self, generation_id: uuid.UUID) -> Generation | None:
        """Poll ``processing_jobs``/``generations`` until terminal; ``None`` on timeout."""
        deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + float(
            self.settings.CONVERSATION_SYNTH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
        )
        maker = get_sessionmaker()
        while asyncio.get_running_loop().time() < deadline:
            await asyncio.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)
            async with maker() as session:
                gen = await _load_generation(session, generation_id)
                if gen is None:
                    raise AppError(
                        "Generation disappeared.", code="synthesis_failed", status_code=500
                    )
                if gen.status in GenerationStatus.TERMINAL:
                    return gen
                if gen.job_id is not None:
                    job = await session.get(ProcessingJob, gen.job_id)
                    if (
                        job is not None
                        and job.status in ("failed", "cancelled")
                        and gen.status not in GenerationStatus.TERMINAL
                    ):
                        gen.status = (
                            GenerationStatus.FAILED
                            if job.status == "failed"
                            else GenerationStatus.CANCELLED
                        )
                        gen.error = job.error
                        return gen
        return None

    async def _cancel_pending_generation(self) -> None:
        gen_id = self.turn.generation_id
        if gen_id is None:
            return
        async with get_sessionmaker()() as session:
            gen = await session.get(Generation, gen_id)
            if gen is not None and gen.status in (
                GenerationStatus.QUEUED,
                GenerationStatus.PROCESSING,
            ):
                gen.status = GenerationStatus.CANCELLED
                gen.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
                if gen.job_id is not None:
                    job = await session.get(ProcessingJob, gen.job_id)
                    if job is not None and job.status in ("queued", "running"):
                        job.status = "cancelled"
                        job.finished_at = datetime.now(UTC)
                await session.commit()
        self.turn.generation_id = None

    async def _stream_audio(self, file: Any) -> None:
        storage = get_storage()
        try:
            data = await asyncio.to_thread(lambda: b"".join(storage.open(file.storage_key)))
        except ObjectNotFound:
            await self.send_error("synthesis_failed", "The synthesised audio could not be read.")
            return
        pcm, sample_rate = await asyncio.to_thread(_wav_to_pcm16, data)
        await self.set_state("speaking")
        await self.send_json({"type": "audio_start", "sample_rate": sample_rate})
        step = PCM_CHUNK_SAMPLES * 2
        for offset in range(0, len(pcm), step):
            if self.closed:
                return
            await self.ws.send_bytes(pcm[offset : offset + step])
        await self.send_json({"type": "audio_end"})


def _wav_to_pcm16(data: bytes) -> tuple[bytes, int]:
    import soundfile as sf

    samples, sample_rate = sf.read(io.BytesIO(data), dtype="float32", always_2d=True)
    mono = samples.mean(axis=1) if samples.shape[1] > 1 else samples[:, 0]
    clipped = np.clip(mono, -1.0, 1.0)
    return (clipped * 32767.0).astype("<i2").tobytes(), int(sample_rate)


async def _load_generation(session: AsyncSession, generation_id: uuid.UUID) -> Generation | None:
    from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

    return await session.scalar(
        select(Generation)
        .where(Generation.id == generation_id)
        .options(selectinload(Generation.file))
    )


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WebSocket endpoint
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@router.websocket("/ws")
async def conversation_ws(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    voice_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    engine: str = Query(default="mirror"),
    language: str | None = Query(default=None),
) -> None:
    settings = get_settings()
    await websocket.accept()

    token = websocket.cookies.get(ACCESS_COOKIE)
    if not token:
        await websocket.close(code=CLOSE_UNAUTHENTICATED, reason="unauthenticated")
        return

    from app.core.ids import parse_uuid

    maker = get_sessionmaker()
    processed: VoiceReferenceFile
    async with maker() as session:
        try:
            user, _claims = await auth_service.resolve_access_token(
                session, token, settings=settings
            )
        except Unauthenticated:
            await websocket.close(code=CLOSE_UNAUTHENTICATED, reason="unauthenticated")
            return
        try:
            voice = await voice_service.get_owned(
                session, owner_id=user.id, voice_id=parse_uuid(voice_id)
            )
            processed = voice_service.assert_ready_for_generation(voice)
        except AppError as exc:
            await websocket.close(code=CLOSE_VOICE_UNAVAILABLE, reason=exc.code)
            return
        del processed
        if engine not in ("mirror", "llm"):
            await websocket.send_text(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "type": "error",
                        "code": "bad_request",
                        "message": "engine must be 'mirror' or 'llm'",
                    }
                )
            )
            await websocket.close(code=CLOSE_POLICY, reason="bad engine")
            return
        if language is not None and language not in ("en", "te", "hi", "kn", "ta", "ml", "zh"):
            await websocket.send_text(
                json.dumps({"type": "error", "code": "bad_request", "message": "unknown language"})
            )
            await websocket.close(code=CLOSE_POLICY, reason="bad language")
            return
        if engine == "llm":
            ok, reason = await llm_availability(settings)
            if not ok:
                await websocket.send_text(
                    json.dumps({"type": "error", "code": "engine_unavailable", "message": reason})
                )
                await websocket.close(code=CLOSE_POLICY, reason="llm unavailable")
                return
        audit_service.record(
            session,
            user_id=user.id,
            action=AuditAction.CONVERSATION_START,
            resource_type="voice",
            resource_id=voice.id,
            ctx=RequestContext(
                ip=websocket.client.host if websocket.client else None,
                user_agent=websocket.headers.get("user-agent"),
            ),
            metadata={"engine": engine},
        )
        await session.commit()

    try:
        from app.engine.realtime import Transcriber, UtteranceDetector  # lazy, ONNX-only

        detector = await asyncio.to_thread(UtteranceDetector)
        transcriber = await asyncio.to_thread(Transcriber.get)
    except ImportError:
        await websocket.send_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "type": "error",
                    "code": "engine_unavailable",
                    "message": "Realtime speech components are not installed on this server.",
                }
            )
        )
        await websocket.close(code=CLOSE_SERVER_ERROR, reason="engine unavailable")
        return
    except Exception as exc:
        log.exception("conversation_realtime_init_failed", error_type=type(exc).__name__)
        await websocket.send_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "type": "error",
                    "code": "engine_unavailable",
                    "message": "Speech components failed to start.",
                }
            )
        )
        await websocket.close(code=CLOSE_SERVER_ERROR, reason="engine init failed")
        return

    conversation = ConversationSession(
        websocket,
        user=user,
        voice=voice,
        engine=engine,
        language_hint=language,
        settings=settings,
        detector=detector,
        transcriber=transcriber,
    )
    await conversation.run()
```

## backend/app/api/v1/generations.py

```python
"""Generation endpoints."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query, Request, Response, status
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from app.api.v1._helpers import IdempotencyKeyHeader, LimitQuery, OffsetQuery
from app.core.deps import (
    CurrentUser,
    DbSession,
    RateLimitByUser,
    RequestCtx,
    SettingsDep,
    StorageDep,
)
from app.core.errors import Conflict, NotFound, UnprocessableEntity
from app.core.ids import parse_uuid
from app.db.models import Generation, GenerationFile
from app.db.models.generation import GenerationStatus
from app.schemas.common import Page
from app.schemas.generations import GenerationCreate, GenerationOut, MediaUrlOut
from app.services import audit_service, generation_service, idempotency
from app.services.audit_service import AuditAction
from app.services.generation_service import GenerationListFilters, GenerationRequest
from app.services.media_service import build_media_url, stream_object
from app.services.serializers import generation_to_out

router = APIRouter(prefix="/generations", tags=["generations"])

generate_rate_limit = RateLimitByUser("generate")


@router.post(
    "",
    status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED,
    response_model=GenerationOut,
    dependencies=[Depends(generate_rate_limit)],
    responses={200: {"model": GenerationOut, "description": "Replay of an Idempotency-Key"}},
)
async def create_generation(
    body: GenerationCreate,
    auth: CurrentUser,
    session: DbSession,
    settings: SettingsDep,
    ctx: RequestCtx,
    idempotency_key: IdempotencyKeyHeader = None,
) -> Response:
    key = idempotency.validate_key(idempotency_key)
    req_hash = idempotency.request_hash(body.model_dump(mode="json"))
    if key:
        existing = await idempotency.lookup(
            session, user_id=auth.user_id, key=key, request_hash_value=req_hash
        )
        if existing is not None:
            gen = await generation_service.get_owned(
                session, owner_id=auth.user_id, generation_id=existing.resource_id
            )
            return JSONResponse(
                status_code=200, content=generation_to_out(gen).model_dump(mode="json")
            )

    gen = await generation_service.create(
        session,
        user=auth.user,
        request=GenerationRequest(
            voice_id=body.voice_id,
            text=body.text,
            language=body.language,
            engine_id=body.engine_id,
            speed=body.speed,
            output_format=body.output_format,
            quality=body.quality,
        ),
        settings=settings,
        ctx=ctx,
    )
    if key:
        try:
            await idempotency.store(
                session,
                user_id=auth.user_id,
                key=key,
                request_hash_value=req_hash,
                resource_type="generation",
                resource_id=gen.id,
                status_code=202,
                ttl_hours=settings.IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_HOURS,
            )
            await session.commit()
        except Conflict:
            pass
    return JSONResponse(status_code=202, content=generation_to_out(gen).model_dump(mode="json"))


@router.get("", response_model=Page[GenerationOut])
async def list_generations(
    auth: CurrentUser,
    session: DbSession,
    limit: LimitQuery = 20,
    offset: OffsetQuery = 0,
    voice_id: Annotated[str | None, Query()] = None,
    status_filter: Annotated[str | None, Query(alias="status")] = None,
) -> Page[GenerationOut]:
    if status_filter is not None and status_filter not in GenerationStatus.ALL:
        raise UnprocessableEntity(f"Unknown status '{status_filter}'.", code="validation_error")
    filters = GenerationListFilters(status=status_filter)
    if voice_id is not None:
        parsed = parse_uuid(voice_id)
        if parsed is None:
            return Page(items=[], total=0, limit=limit, offset=offset)
        filters = GenerationListFilters(voice_id=parsed, status=status_filter)
    items, total = await generation_service.list_owned(
        session, owner_id=auth.user_id, limit=limit, offset=offset, filters=filters
    )
    return Page(
        items=[generation_to_out(g) for g in items], total=total, limit=limit, offset=offset
    )


@router.get("/{generation_id}", response_model=GenerationOut)
async def get_generation(
    generation_id: str, auth: CurrentUser, session: DbSession
) -> GenerationOut:
    gen = await generation_service.get_owned(
        session, owner_id=auth.user_id, generation_id=parse_uuid(generation_id)
    )
    return generation_to_out(gen)


def _require_completed_file(gen: Generation) -> GenerationFile:
    if gen.status != GenerationStatus.COMPLETED or gen.file is None:
        raise Conflict(
            "This generation has no audio yet."
            if gen.status in ("queued", "processing")
            else "This generation produced no audio.",
            code="generation_not_completed",
            details={"status": gen.status},
        )
    return gen.file


@router.get("/{generation_id}/audio")
@router.head("/{generation_id}/audio", include_in_schema=False)
async def generation_audio(
    generation_id: str,
    request: Request,
    auth: CurrentUser,
    session: DbSession,
    storage: StorageDep,
    ctx: RequestCtx,
    download: Annotated[int, Query(ge=0, le=1)] = 0,
) -> Response:
    gen = await generation_service.get_owned(
        session, owner_id=auth.user_id, generation_id=parse_uuid(generation_id)
    )
    file = _require_completed_file(gen)
    filename = f"project-voice-{gen.id}.{file.format}"
    if download and request.method == "GET":
        audit_service.record(
            session,
            user_id=auth.user_id,
            action=AuditAction.GENERATION_DOWNLOAD,
            resource_type="generation",
            resource_id=gen.id,
            ctx=ctx,
        )
        await session.commit()
    try:
        return stream_object(
            request,
            storage,
            key=file.storage_key,
            content_type=file.content_type,
            filename=filename,
            attachment=bool(download),
        )
    except NotFound:
        raise NotFound("Audio file not found.", code="file_not_found") from None


@router.get("/{generation_id}/audio-url", response_model=MediaUrlOut)
async def generation_audio_url(
    generation_id: str,
    auth: CurrentUser,
    session: DbSession,
    storage: StorageDep,
    settings: SettingsDep,
    ctx: RequestCtx,
) -> MediaUrlOut:
    gen = await generation_service.get_owned(
        session, owner_id=auth.user_id, generation_id=parse_uuid(generation_id)
    )
    file = _require_completed_file(gen)
    url, expires_at = build_media_url(
        storage=storage,
        settings=settings,
        storage_key=file.storage_key,
        owner_id=gen.owner_id,
        resource_type="generation",
        resource_id=gen.id,
        content_type=file.content_type,
        filename=f"project-voice-{gen.id}.{file.format}",
    )
    audit_service.record(
        session,
        user_id=auth.user_id,
        action=AuditAction.GENERATION_SHARE_URL,
        resource_type="generation",
        resource_id=gen.id,
        ctx=ctx,
        metadata={"expires_at": expires_at.isoformat()},
    )
    await session.commit()
    return MediaUrlOut(url=url, expires_at=expires_at)


@router.delete("/{generation_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT, response_class=Response)
async def delete_generation(
    generation_id: str,
    auth: CurrentUser,
    session: DbSession,
    storage: StorageDep,
    settings: SettingsDep,
    ctx: RequestCtx,
) -> Response:
    gen = await generation_service.get_owned(
        session, owner_id=auth.user_id, generation_id=parse_uuid(generation_id)
    )
    await generation_service.delete(session, gen=gen, storage=storage, settings=settings, ctx=ctx)
    await session.commit()
    return Response(status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
```

```python
"""Signed media delivery: ``GET /media/{token}``.

The token is the credential.  Local backend streams the object (Range supported); the S3 backend
redirects to a pre-signed URL.  Expired tokens → ``410``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, Response
from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse

from app.core.deps import SettingsDep, StorageDep
from app.core.errors import Gone, NotFound
from app.core.security import InvalidToken, MediaTokenExpired, verify_media_token
from app.services.media_service import stream_object

router = APIRouter(prefix="/media", tags=["media"])


@router.get("/{token}")
@router.head("/{token}", include_in_schema=False)
async def get_media(
    token: str, request: Request, storage: StorageDep, settings: SettingsDep
) -> Response:
    try:
        claims = verify_media_token(token, settings=settings)
    except MediaTokenExpired as exc:
        raise Gone("This link has expired.", code="media_expired") from exc
    except InvalidToken as exc:
        raise NotFound("Media not found.", code="media_not_found") from exc

    direct = storage.signed_url(
        claims.storage_key,
        settings.MEDIA_URL_TTL_SECONDS,
        filename=claims.filename,
        content_type=claims.content_type,
    )
    if direct:
        return RedirectResponse(direct, status_code=307)
    return stream_object(
        request,
        storage,
        key=claims.storage_key,
        content_type=claims.content_type,
        filename=claims.filename,
        attachment=request.query_params.get("download") == "1",
    )
```

```python
from fastapi import APIRouter

    audit,
    media,
    conversation,
):
    api_router.include_router(module.router)
```

```python
"""Voice endpoints."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, Query, Request, Response, UploadFile, status
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from app.api.v1._helpers import (

    LimitQuery,
    OffsetQuery,
    parse_bool_field,
    validate_model,
)
from app.core.deps import (
    CurrentUser,
    DbSession,
    RateLimitByUser,
    RequestCtx,
    SettingsDep,
    StorageDep,
)
from app.core.errors import Conflict, UnprocessableEntity
from app.core.ids import parse_uuid
from app.db.models.generation import GenerationKind
from app.db.models.voice import ReferenceRole, VoiceStatus
from app.schemas.common import Page
from app.schemas.generations import GenerationOut
from app.schemas.voices import (
    ConsentGrantRequest,
    VoiceCreateFields,
    VoiceOut,
    VoicePatch,
    VoicePreviewRequest,
)
from app.services import consent_service, generation_service, idempotency, voice_service
from app.services.generation_service import GenerationRequest
from app.services.media_service import stream_object
from app.services.serializers import generation_to_out, voice_to_out
from app.services.upload_validation import validate_reference_upload
from app.services.voice_service import VoiceListFilters

router = APIRouter(prefix="/voices", tags=["voices"])

upload_rate_limit = RateLimitByUser("upload")
generate_rate_limit = RateLimitByUser("generate")
default_rate_limit = RateLimitByUser("default")


@router.post(
    "",
    status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED,
    response_model=VoiceOut,
    dependencies=[Depends(upload_rate_limit)],
    responses={200: {"model": VoiceOut, "description": "Replay of an Idempotency-Key"}},
)
async def create_voice(
    request: Request,
    auth: CurrentUser,
    session: DbSession,
    storage: StorageDep,
    settings: SettingsDep,
    ctx: RequestCtx,
    file: Annotated[UploadFile, File()],
    name: Annotated[str, Form()],
    consent_confirmed: Annotated[str, Form()],
    consent_text_version: Annotated[str, Form()],
    language_hint: Annotated[str | None, Form()] = None,
    transcript: Annotated[str | None, Form()] = None,
    idempotency_key: IdempotencyKeyHeader = None,
) -> Response:
    fields: VoiceCreateFields = validate_model(
        VoiceCreateFields,
        {
            "name": name,
            "language_hint": language_hint or "auto",
            "consent_confirmed": parse_bool_field(consent_confirmed),
            "consent_text_version": consent_text_version,
            "transcript": transcript,
        },
    )
    consent_service.require_confirmed(fields.consent_confirmed)

    upload = await validate_reference_upload(file, settings=settings)
    try:
        key = idempotency.validate_key(idempotency_key)
        req_hash = idempotency.request_hash(
            {
                "name": fields.name,
                "language_hint": fields.language_hint,
                "consent_text_version": fields.consent_text_version,
                "transcript": fields.transcript,
                "file_sha256": upload.sha256,
            }
        )
        if key:
            existing = await idempotency.lookup(
                session, user_id=auth.user_id, key=key, request_hash_value=req_hash
            )
            if existing is not None:
                voice = await voice_service.get_owned(
                    session, owner_id=auth.user_id, voice_id=existing.resource_id
                )
                return JSONResponse(
                    status_code=200, content=voice_to_out(voice).model_dump(mode="json")
                )

        voice = await voice_service.create(
            session,
            owner_id=auth.user_id,
            fields=fields,
            upload=upload,
            storage=storage,
            settings=settings,
            ctx=ctx,
        )
        if key:
            try:
                await idempotency.store(
                    session,
                    user_id=auth.user_id,
                    key=key,
                    request_hash_value=req_hash,
                    resource_type="voice",
                    resource_id=voice.id,
                    status_code=202,
                    ttl_hours=settings.IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_HOURS,
                )
                await session.commit()
            except Conflict:
                pass  # concurrent identical request already stored the key
    finally:
        upload.cleanup()
    return JSONResponse(status_code=202, content=voice_to_out(voice).model_dump(mode="json"))


@router.get("", response_model=Page[VoiceOut])
async def list_voices(
    auth: CurrentUser,
    session: DbSession,
    limit: LimitQuery = 20,
    offset: OffsetQuery = 0,
    status_filter: Annotated[str | None, Query(alias="status")] = None,
) -> Page[VoiceOut]:
    if status_filter is not None and status_filter not in VoiceStatus.ALL:
        raise UnprocessableEntity(f"Unknown status '{status_filter}'.", code="validation_error")
    items, total = await voice_service.list_owned(
        session,
        owner_id=auth.user_id,
        limit=limit,
        offset=offset,
        filters=VoiceListFilters(status=status_filter),
    )
    return Page(items=[voice_to_out(v) for v in items], total=total, limit=limit, offset=offset)
```

## backend/app/audio/analysis.py

```python
"""Signal analysis: level, clipping, DC offset, SNR estimate and edge silence.

All figures are computed from the samples; nothing is estimated from metadata.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

from app.engine.types import AudioAnalysis, AudioBuffer

EPS = 1e-12
CLIP_THRESHOLD = 0.99
SILENCE_DBFS = -50.0  # frames quieter than this count as silence for edge detection
FRAME_MS = 20.0


def dbfs(value: float) -> float:
    return float(20.0 * np.log10(max(float(value), EPS)))


def peak_dbfs(samples: np.ndarray) -> float:
    return dbfs(float(np.max(np.abs(samples))) if samples.size else 0.0)


def rms(samples: np.ndarray) -> float:
    return float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(samples.astype(np.float64))))) if samples.size else 0.0


def rms_dbfs(samples: np.ndarray) -> float:
    return dbfs(rms(samples))


def clipping_ratio(samples: np.ndarray, threshold: float = CLIP_THRESHOLD) -> float:
    if samples.size == 0:
        return 0.0
    return float(np.count_nonzero(np.abs(samples) > threshold)) / float(samples.size)


def dc_offset(samples: np.ndarray) -> float:
    return float(np.mean(samples)) if samples.size else 0.0


def frame_rms(samples: np.ndarray, sample_rate: int, frame_ms: float = FRAME_MS) -> np.ndarray:
    frame = max(1, int(sample_rate * frame_ms / 1000.0))
    n_frames = samples.size // frame
    if n_frames == 0:
        return np.array([rms(samples)], dtype=np.float64)
    trimmed = samples[: n_frames * frame].astype(np.float64).reshape(n_frames, frame)
    return np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(trimmed), axis=1))


def estimate_snr_db(samples: np.ndarray, sample_rate: int) -> float | None:
    """Signal-to-noise estimate: loud frames (top 50 %) versus the quietest 10 % of frames.

    Returns ``None`` when there are too few frames to say anything (< 0.5 s of audio).
    """
    frames = frame_rms(samples, sample_rate)
    if frames.size < 25:
        return None
    ordered = np.sort(frames)
    quiet = ordered[: max(1, frames.size // 10)]
    loud = ordered[frames.size // 2 :]
    noise = float(np.mean(quiet))
    signal = float(np.mean(loud))
    if noise <= EPS:
        return 90.0  # digital silence as noise floor; cap rather than report infinity
    return float(np.clip(20.0 * np.log10(signal / noise), -20.0, 90.0))


def edge_silence(
    samples: np.ndarray, sample_rate: int, threshold_dbfs: float = SILENCE_DBFS
) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """``(leading_seconds, trailing_seconds)`` below ``threshold_dbfs`` using 20 ms frames."""
    frames = frame_rms(samples, sample_rate)
    frame_s = FRAME_MS / 1000.0
    threshold = 10.0 ** (threshold_dbfs / 20.0)
    loud = frames > threshold
    if not np.any(loud):
        total = samples.size / float(sample_rate)
        return total, 0.0
    first = int(np.argmax(loud))
    last = int(frames.size - 1 - np.argmax(loud[::-1]))
    return first * frame_s, (frames.size - 1 - last) * frame_s


def analyse(
    buffer: AudioBuffer, *, channels: int = 1, speech_seconds: float | None = None
) -> AudioAnalysis:
    samples = buffer.samples
    duration = buffer.duration
    lead, trail = edge_silence(samples, buffer.sample_rate)
    peak = peak_dbfs(samples)
    level = rms_dbfs(samples)
    clip = clipping_ratio(samples)
    dc = dc_offset(samples)
    snr = estimate_snr_db(samples, buffer.sample_rate)
    warnings: list[str] = []
    if clip > 0.001:
        warnings.append(f"clipping detected on {clip * 100:.2f}% of samples")
    if peak < -20.0:
        warnings.append(f"recording is quiet (peak {peak:.1f} dBFS)")
    if abs(dc) > 0.02:
        warnings.append(f"DC offset of {dc:+.3f}")
    if snr is not None and snr < 15.0:
        warnings.append(f"noisy recording (estimated SNR {snr:.0f} dB)")
    if lead + trail > duration * 0.5:
        warnings.append("more than half of the file is silence")
    return AudioAnalysis(
        duration_seconds=float(duration),
        sample_rate=int(buffer.sample_rate),
        channels=int(channels),
        peak_dbfs=peak,
        rms_dbfs=level,
        clipping_ratio=clip,
        dc_offset=dc,
        snr_db=snr,
        leading_silence_s=float(lead),
        trailing_silence_s=float(trail),
        speech_seconds=float(
            speech_seconds if speech_seconds is not None else max(0.0, duration - lead - trail)
        ),
        warnings=warnings,
    )


__all__ = [
    "analyse",
    "clipping_ratio",
    "dbfs",
    "dc_offset",
    "edge_silence",
    "estimate_snr_db",
    "frame_rms",
    "peak_dbfs",
    "rms",
    "rms_dbfs",
]

```

## backend/app/audio/concat.py

```python
"""Join synthesised chunks with equal-power crossfades and punctuation-derived silences."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence

import numpy as np

from app.engine.types import AudioBuffer

CROSSFADE_MS = 20.0
EDGE_FADE_MS = 5.0


def silence(seconds: float, sample_rate: int) -> np.ndarray:
    return np.zeros(max(0, round(seconds * sample_rate)), dtype=np.float32)


def fade_edges(samples: np.ndarray, sample_rate: int, fade_ms: float = EDGE_FADE_MS) -> np.ndarray:
    """Tiny linear fades so a chunk never starts or ends on a non-zero sample (click removal)."""
    n = min(len(samples) // 2, max(1, int(sample_rate * fade_ms / 1000.0)))
    if n <= 0 or len(samples) == 0:
        return samples
    out = np.array(samples, dtype=np.float32, copy=True)
    ramp = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n, dtype=np.float32)
    out[:n] *= ramp
    out[-n:] *= ramp[::-1]
    return out


def crossfade(
    a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray, sample_rate: int, fade_ms: float = CROSSFADE_MS
) -> np.ndarray:
    """Equal-power (sin/cos) crossfade of the tail of ``a`` into the head of ``b``."""
    n = int(sample_rate * fade_ms / 1000.0)
    n = min(n, len(a), len(b))
    if n <= 0:
        return np.concatenate([a, b]).astype(np.float32)
    t = np.linspace(0.0, np.pi / 2.0, n, dtype=np.float32)
    fade_out = np.cos(t)
    fade_in = np.sin(t)
    mixed = a[-n:] * fade_out + b[:n] * fade_in
    return np.concatenate([a[:-n], mixed, b[n:]]).astype(np.float32)


def join_chunks(
    chunks: Sequence[AudioBuffer],
    pauses_ms: Sequence[int],
    *,
    crossfade_ms: float = CROSSFADE_MS,
) -> AudioBuffer:
    """Concatenate ``chunks``; ``pauses_ms[i]`` is the silence inserted after chunk ``i``.

    When a pause is requested the chunk tails are faded and the silence is inserted (a crossfade
    into silence is pointless); when the pause is zero the two chunks are crossfaded directly.
    """
    if not chunks:
        raise ValueError("join_chunks needs at least one chunk")
    if len(pauses_ms) != len(chunks):
        raise ValueError("pauses_ms must have one entry per chunk")
    sample_rate = chunks[0].sample_rate
    if any(c.sample_rate != sample_rate for c in chunks):
        raise ValueError("all chunks must share one sample rate")
    out = fade_edges(np.asarray(chunks[0].samples, dtype=np.float32), sample_rate)
    for i in range(1, len(chunks)):
        nxt = fade_edges(np.asarray(chunks[i].samples, dtype=np.float32), sample_rate)
        pause = int(pauses_ms[i - 1])
        if pause > 0:
            out = np.concatenate([out, silence(pause / 1000.0, sample_rate), nxt])
        else:
            out = crossfade(out, nxt, sample_rate, crossfade_ms)
    tail = int(pauses_ms[-1])
    if tail > 0:
        out = np.concatenate([out, silence(tail / 1000.0, sample_rate)])
    return AudioBuffer(samples=np.ascontiguousarray(out, dtype=np.float32), sample_rate=sample_rate)


__all__ = ["CROSSFADE_MS", "crossfade", "fade_edges", "join_chunks", "silence"]

```

## backend/app/audio/conditioning.py

```python
"""Gentle conditioning: peak normalisation only.

No denoising, EQ or compression — those change the voice the user is cloning.  Output audio from
the engines goes through the same function so nothing ever leaves the system above -1 dBFS.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

from app.engine.types import AudioBuffer

TARGET_PEAK_DBFS = -1.0


def peak_normalize(
    buffer: AudioBuffer, *, target_dbfs: float = TARGET_PEAK_DBFS, boost: bool = True
) -> AudioBuffer:
    """Scale so the absolute peak sits at ``target_dbfs``.

    ``boost=False`` only attenuates (used for engine output: quiet speech stays quiet, loud or
    over-range speech is brought down to the ceiling).
    """
    samples = np.asarray(buffer.samples, dtype=np.float32)
    if samples.size == 0:
        return AudioBuffer(samples=samples.copy(), sample_rate=buffer.sample_rate)
    peak = float(np.max(np.abs(samples)))
    if peak <= 0.0:
        return AudioBuffer(samples=samples.copy(), sample_rate=buffer.sample_rate)
    target = 10.0 ** (target_dbfs / 20.0)
    gain = target / peak
    if not boost and gain > 1.0:
        return AudioBuffer(samples=samples.copy(), sample_rate=buffer.sample_rate)
    out = (samples.astype(np.float64) * gain).astype(np.float32)
    return AudioBuffer(samples=out, sample_rate=buffer.sample_rate)


def remove_dc(buffer: AudioBuffer) -> AudioBuffer:
    """Subtract the mean; only applied when the measured offset is material (caller decides)."""
    samples = np.asarray(buffer.samples, dtype=np.float32)
    return AudioBuffer(
        samples=(samples - np.float32(samples.mean())).astype(np.float32),
        sample_rate=buffer.sample_rate,
    )


def slice_seconds(buffer: AudioBuffer, start: float, end: float) -> AudioBuffer:
    a = max(0, round(start * buffer.sample_rate))
    b = min(len(buffer.samples), round(end * buffer.sample_rate))
    return AudioBuffer(
        samples=np.ascontiguousarray(buffer.samples[a:b], dtype=np.float32),
        sample_rate=buffer.sample_rate,
    )


__all__ = ["TARGET_PEAK_DBFS", "peak_normalize", "remove_dc", "slice_seconds"]

```

## backend/app/audio/decode.py

```python
"""``ffmpeg`` decode to float32 mono PCM through a pipe — no temporary files."""

from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from app.engine.config import get_engine_settings
from app.engine.types import AudioBuffer, InvalidAudioInput

DECODE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 300


def decode_audio(
    path: Path,
    *,
    sample_rate: int,
    max_seconds: float | None = None,
    ffmpeg_bin: str | None = None,
) -> AudioBuffer:
    """Decode ``path`` to mono float32 at ``sample_rate`` (ffmpeg's soxr-free default resampler).

    ``max_seconds`` caps the decoded duration (``-t``) so a mislabelled multi-hour file cannot
    exhaust memory: callers compare against the probed duration first and reject explicitly.
    """
    path = Path(path)
    if not path.is_file():
        raise InvalidAudioInput(f"Audio file not found: {path.name}")
    binary = ffmpeg_bin or get_engine_settings().FFMPEG_BIN
    cmd = [binary, "-v", "error", "-nostdin", "-i", str(path)]
    if max_seconds is not None:
        cmd += ["-t", f"{float(max_seconds):.3f}"]
    cmd += ["-vn", "-sn", "-dn", "-map", "0:a:0", "-ac", "1", "-ar", str(int(sample_rate))]
    cmd += ["-f", "f32le", "-acodec", "pcm_f32le", "pipe:1"]
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, timeout=DECODE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, check=False)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise InvalidAudioInput(
            f"ffmpeg binary not found ({binary}); install FFmpeg", code="ffmpeg_missing"
        ) from exc
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        raise InvalidAudioInput("ffmpeg timed out while decoding the file") from exc
    if proc.returncode != 0 or not proc.stdout:
        stderr = proc.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip().splitlines()
        detail = stderr[-1] if stderr else "no audio decoded"
        raise InvalidAudioInput(
            f"The audio could not be decoded ({detail[:200]})", details={"ffmpeg": detail[:500]}
        )
    samples = np.frombuffer(proc.stdout, dtype="<f4").astype(np.float32, copy=True)
    if samples.size == 0:
        raise InvalidAudioInput("The audio decoded to zero samples")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(samples)):
        raise InvalidAudioInput("The decoded audio contains non-finite samples")
    return AudioBuffer(samples=samples, sample_rate=int(sample_rate))


def resample(buffer: AudioBuffer, target_rate: int) -> AudioBuffer:
    """High-quality resampling in-process (used for VAD/ASR at 16 kHz from the engine rate)."""
    if buffer.sample_rate == target_rate:
        return buffer
    from math import gcd

    from scipy.signal import resample_poly

    g = gcd(int(buffer.sample_rate), int(target_rate))
    up, down = int(target_rate) // g, int(buffer.sample_rate) // g
    out = resample_poly(buffer.samples.astype(np.float64), up, down).astype(np.float32)
    return AudioBuffer(samples=out, sample_rate=int(target_rate))


__all__ = ["decode_audio", "resample"]

```

## backend/app/audio/encode.py

```python
"""Output encoding.

* WAV: PCM16 written directly as RIFF with a ``LIST/INFO`` chunk carrying ``ICMT`` (comment) and
  ``ISFT`` (software) provenance tags.  This is metadata provenance, not a watermark.
* MP3 / FLAC: ffmpeg over a pipe with the same provenance written as the ``comment`` /
  ``encoder`` tags.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import struct
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from app.engine.config import get_engine_settings
from app.engine.types import AudioBuffer, EngineError, OutputFormat

SOFTWARE_TAG = "PROJECT VOICE"
ENCODE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 300


def provenance_comment(generation_id: str) -> str:
    return f"Synthetic speech generated by PROJECT VOICE generation {generation_id}"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EncodedFile:
    path: Path
    output_format: OutputFormat
    size_bytes: int
    sample_rate: int
    duration_seconds: float


def to_pcm16(samples: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    clipped = np.clip(np.asarray(samples, dtype=np.float32), -1.0, 1.0)
    return (clipped * 32767.0).round().astype("<i2")


def _info_chunk(tags: dict[bytes, str]) -> bytes:
    body = b""
    for key, value in tags.items():
        data = value.encode("utf-8") + b"\x00"
        if len(data) % 2:
            data += b"\x00"
        body += key + struct.pack("<I", len(value.encode("utf-8")) + 1) + data
    return b"LIST" + struct.pack("<I", 4 + len(body)) + b"INFO" + body


def write_wav(
    path: Path, buffer: AudioBuffer, *, comment: str, software: str = SOFTWARE_TAG
) -> EncodedFile:
    """PCM16 mono/stereo WAV with ``LIST/INFO`` ICMT + ISFT placed before ``data``."""
    pcm = to_pcm16(buffer.samples)
    channels = 1 if pcm.ndim == 1 else int(pcm.shape[1])
    data = pcm.tobytes()
    if len(data) % 2:
        data += b"\x00"
    byte_rate = buffer.sample_rate * channels * 2
    fmt = b"fmt " + struct.pack(
        "<IHHIIHH", 16, 1, channels, buffer.sample_rate, byte_rate, channels * 2, 16
    )
    info = _info_chunk({b"ICMT": comment, b"ISFT": software})
    data_chunk = b"data" + struct.pack("<I", len(pcm.tobytes())) + data
    riff_body = b"WAVE" + fmt + info + data_chunk
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(b"RIFF" + struct.pack("<I", len(riff_body)) + riff_body)
    return EncodedFile(
        path=path,
        output_format="wav",
        size_bytes=path.stat().st_size,
        sample_rate=buffer.sample_rate,
        duration_seconds=buffer.duration,
    )


def read_wav_info(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Parse the ``LIST/INFO`` tags of a RIFF WAV (used by tests and provenance checks)."""
    tags: dict[str, str] = {}
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        head = fh.read(12)
        if head[:4] != b"RIFF" or head[8:12] != b"WAVE":
            return tags
        while True:
            header = fh.read(8)
            if len(header) < 8:
                break
            cid, size = header[:4], struct.unpack("<I", header[4:8])[0]
            payload = fh.read(size + (size % 2))
            if cid == b"LIST" and payload[:4] == b"INFO":
                pos = 4
                while pos + 8 <= len(payload):
                    sub, sub_size = (
                        payload[pos : pos + 4],
                        struct.unpack("<I", payload[pos + 4 : pos + 8])[0],
                    )
                    value = (
                        payload[pos + 8 : pos + 8 + sub_size]
                        .rstrip(b"\x00")
                        .decode("utf-8", "replace")
                    )
                    tags[sub.decode("ascii", "replace")] = value
                    pos += 8 + sub_size + (sub_size % 2)
    return tags


def _ffmpeg_encode(
    path: Path, buffer: AudioBuffer, *, codec_args: list[str], comment: str, software: str
) -> None:
    binary = get_engine_settings().FFMPEG_BIN
    cmd = [
        binary, "-v", "error", "-nostdin", "-y",
        "-f", "f32le", "-ar", str(buffer.sample_rate), "-ac", "1", "-i", "pipe:0",
        *codec_args,
        "-metadata", f"comment={comment}",
        "-metadata", f"encoder={software}",
        str(path),
    ]  # fmt: skip
    raw = np.ascontiguousarray(np.clip(buffer.samples, -1.0, 1.0), dtype="<f4").tobytes()
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            cmd, input=raw, capture_output=True, timeout=ENCODE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, check=False
        )
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise EngineError(f"ffmpeg binary not found ({binary})", code="ffmpeg_missing") from exc
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        raise EngineError("ffmpeg timed out while encoding", code="encode_failed") from exc
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        detail = proc.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip().splitlines()
        raise EngineError(
            f"Encoding failed ({(detail[-1] if detail else 'unknown error')[:200]})",
            code="encode_failed",
        )


def encode(
    buffer: AudioBuffer,
    path: Path,
    *,
    output_format: OutputFormat,
    generation_id: str,
    software: str = SOFTWARE_TAG,
) -> EncodedFile:
    comment = provenance_comment(generation_id)
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if output_format == "wav":
        return write_wav(path, buffer, comment=comment, software=software)
    if output_format == "mp3":
        _ffmpeg_encode(
            path,
            buffer,
            codec_args=["-c:a", "libmp3lame", "-q:a", "2", "-id3v2_version", "3"],
            comment=comment,
            software=software,
        )
    elif output_format == "flac":
        _ffmpeg_encode(
            path,
            buffer,
            codec_args=["-c:a", "flac", "-compression_level", "5"],
            comment=comment,
            software=software,
        )
    else:
        raise EngineError(f"Unsupported output format: {output_format}", code="unsupported_format")
    return EncodedFile(
        path=path,
        output_format=output_format,
        size_bytes=path.stat().st_size,
        sample_rate=buffer.sample_rate,
        duration_seconds=buffer.duration,
    )


__all__ = [
    "SOFTWARE_TAG",
    "EncodedFile",
    "encode",
    "provenance_comment",
    "read_wav_info",
    "to_pcm16",
    "write_wav",
]

```

## backend/app/audio/probe.py

```python
"""``ffprobe`` wrapper: container / codec / duration / channels / rate / bitrate."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from app.engine.config import get_engine_settings
from app.engine.types import InvalidAudioInput

PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AudioProbe:
    container: str
    codec: str
    duration_seconds: float
    channels: int
    sample_rate: int
    bitrate_kbps: int | None
    size_bytes: int

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _run_ffprobe(path: Path, binary: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cmd = [
        binary,
        "-v",
        "error",
        "-print_format",
        "json",
        "-show_format",
        "-show_streams",
        "-select_streams",
        "a:0",
        str(path),
    ]
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, timeout=PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, check=False)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise InvalidAudioInput(
            f"ffprobe binary not found ({binary}); install FFmpeg", code="ffprobe_missing"
        ) from exc
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        raise InvalidAudioInput("ffprobe timed out while reading the file") from exc
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        stderr = proc.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip().splitlines()
        detail = stderr[-1] if stderr else "unknown error"
        raise InvalidAudioInput(
            f"The file could not be read as audio ({detail[:200]})",
            details={"ffprobe": detail[:500]},
        )
    try:
        return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise InvalidAudioInput("ffprobe returned unreadable output") from exc


def _ffmpeg_for(ffprobe_bin: str) -> str:
    configured = getattr(get_engine_settings(), "FFMPEG_BIN", None)
    if configured:
        return str(configured)
    return str(Path(ffprobe_bin).with_name("ffmpeg")) if "/" in ffprobe_bin else "ffmpeg"


def measure_duration_by_decoding(path: Path, *, ffmpeg_bin: str = "ffmpeg") -> float | None:
    """Decode to a null sink and return the last ``out_time_us`` ffmpeg reports, in seconds."""
    cmd = [
        ffmpeg_bin,
        "-v",
        "error",
        "-nostdin",
        "-i",
        str(path),
        "-vn",
        "-f",
        "null",
        "-progress",
        "pipe:1",
        "-",
    ]
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            cmd, capture_output=True, timeout=PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS * 4, check=False
        )
    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return None
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return None
    last_us: int | None = None
    for line in proc.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines():
        if line.startswith(("out_time_us=", "out_time_ms=")):
            try:
                last_us = int(line.split("=", 1)[1])
            except ValueError:
                continue
    return last_us / 1_000_000.0 if last_us and last_us > 0 else None


def probe_audio(path: Path, *, ffprobe_bin: str | None = None) -> AudioProbe:
    """Inspect ``path`` and return its audio facts; raise :class:`InvalidAudioInput` otherwise."""
    path = Path(path)
    if not path.is_file():
        raise InvalidAudioInput(f"Audio file not found: {path.name}")
    binary = ffprobe_bin or get_engine_settings().FFPROBE_BIN
    data = _run_ffprobe(path, binary)
    streams = [s for s in data.get("streams", []) if s.get("codec_type") == "audio"]
    if not streams:
        raise InvalidAudioInput("The file contains no audio stream")
    stream = streams[0]
    fmt = data.get("format", {})

    def _float(value: Any) -> float | None:
        try:
            return float(value) if value is not None else None
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return None

    duration = _float(stream.get("duration")) or _float(fmt.get("duration")) or 0.0
    sample_rate = int(_float(stream.get("sample_rate")) or 0)
    channels = int(stream.get("channels") or 0)
    if duration <= 0 and sample_rate > 0 and channels > 0:
        # Live-written containers (browser MediaRecorder WebM/Opus, fragmented MP4) carry no
        # duration header; measure it by decoding instead of rejecting a genuine recording.
        duration = measure_duration_by_decoding(path, ffmpeg_bin=_ffmpeg_for(binary)) or 0.0
    if duration <= 0 or sample_rate <= 0 or channels <= 0:
        raise InvalidAudioInput(
            "The audio stream has no usable duration, sample rate or channel count",
            details={"duration": duration, "sample_rate": sample_rate, "channels": channels},
        )
    bitrate_bps = _float(stream.get("bit_rate")) or _float(fmt.get("bit_rate"))
    return AudioProbe(
        container=str(fmt.get("format_name", "unknown")).split(",")[0],
        codec=str(stream.get("codec_name", "unknown")),
        duration_seconds=float(duration),
        channels=channels,
        sample_rate=sample_rate,
        bitrate_kbps=int(bitrate_bps // 1000) if bitrate_bps else None,
        size_bytes=int(_float(fmt.get("size")) or path.stat().st_size),
    )


__all__ = ["AudioProbe", "measure_duration_by_decoding", "probe_audio"]

```

## backend/app/audio/vad.py

```python
"""Silero VAD (ONNX, via sherpa-onnx) and reference-window selection.

The VAD runs at 16 kHz.  ``select_window`` picks the contiguous stretch of audio that best
matches the configured target length (default 12 s) while staying within the engine-friendly
[3, 30] s band, adds a 100 ms margin on both sides and reports the amount of real speech inside.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from app.engine.config import get_engine_settings
from app.engine.types import AudioBuffer, InvalidReference

VAD_SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
VAD_WINDOW = 512  # samples per Silero step at 16 kHz (32 ms)
MARGIN_SECONDS = 0.1


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SpeechSegment:
    start: float
    end: float

    @property
    def duration(self) -> float:
        return self.end - self.start


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReferenceWindow:
    start: float
    end: float
    speech_seconds: float
    segments: int

    @property
    def duration(self) -> float:
        return self.end - self.start


def _vad_config(
    model_path: Path,
    *,
    threshold: float,
    min_silence_s: float,
    min_speech_s: float,
    max_speech_s: float,
    num_threads: int = 1,
) -> Any:  # sherpa types are opaque pybind objects
    import sherpa_onnx

    if not Path(model_path).is_file():
        raise InvalidReference(
            f"Silero VAD model not found at {model_path}; run scripts/download-models.py",
            code="vad_model_missing",
        )
    silero = sherpa_onnx.SileroVadModelConfig(
        model=str(model_path),
        threshold=threshold,
        min_silence_duration=min_silence_s,
        min_speech_duration=min_speech_s,
        window_size=VAD_WINDOW,
        max_speech_duration=max_speech_s,
    )
    config = sherpa_onnx.VadModelConfig(
        silero_vad=silero, sample_rate=VAD_SAMPLE_RATE, num_threads=num_threads, provider="cpu"
    )
    if not config.validate():
        raise InvalidReference("Silero VAD configuration failed validation", code="vad_config")
    return config


def make_detector(
    model_path: Path | None = None,
    *,
    threshold: float = 0.5,
    min_silence_s: float = 0.3,
    min_speech_s: float = 0.25,
    max_speech_s: float = 20.0,
    buffer_seconds: float = 60.0,
) -> Any:
    """A fresh ``sherpa_onnx.VoiceActivityDetector`` (one per stream — it is stateful)."""
    import sherpa_onnx

    path = model_path or get_engine_settings().vad_model
    config = _vad_config(
        Path(path),
        threshold=threshold,
        min_silence_s=min_silence_s,
        min_speech_s=min_speech_s,
        max_speech_s=max_speech_s,
    )
    return sherpa_onnx.VoiceActivityDetector(config, buffer_size_in_seconds=buffer_seconds)


def detect_speech(buffer: AudioBuffer, *, model_path: Path | None = None) -> list[SpeechSegment]:
    """Run Silero over a 16 kHz mono buffer and return speech segments in seconds."""
    if buffer.sample_rate != VAD_SAMPLE_RATE:
        raise ValueError(f"VAD expects {VAD_SAMPLE_RATE} Hz audio, got {buffer.sample_rate}")
    samples = np.ascontiguousarray(buffer.samples, dtype=np.float32)
    detector = make_detector(model_path, buffer_seconds=max(60.0, buffer.duration + 5.0))
    for start in range(0, samples.size, VAD_WINDOW):
        detector.accept_waveform(samples[start : start + VAD_WINDOW])
    detector.flush()
    segments: list[SpeechSegment] = []
    while not detector.empty():
        seg = detector.front
        start_s = float(seg.start) / VAD_SAMPLE_RATE
        segments.append(
            SpeechSegment(start=start_s, end=start_s + len(seg.samples) / VAD_SAMPLE_RATE)
        )
        detector.pop()
    segments.sort(key=lambda s: s.start)
    return _merge(segments, gap=0.05)


def _merge(segments: list[SpeechSegment], gap: float) -> list[SpeechSegment]:
    merged: list[SpeechSegment] = []
    for seg in segments:
        if merged and seg.start - merged[-1].end <= gap:
            merged[-1] = SpeechSegment(merged[-1].start, max(merged[-1].end, seg.end))
        else:
            merged.append(seg)
    return merged


def speech_total(segments: list[SpeechSegment]) -> float:
    return float(sum(s.duration for s in segments))


def select_window(
    segments: list[SpeechSegment],
    total_duration: float,
    *,
    target_seconds: float | None = None,
    min_seconds: float = 3.0,
    max_seconds: float = 30.0,
    margin: float = MARGIN_SECONDS,
) -> ReferenceWindow:
    """Choose the best contiguous window of speech.

    Candidates are spans from the start of segment *i* to the end of segment *j* (``i <= j``)
    whose length is within ``[min_seconds, max_seconds]``.  The score prefers spans close to the
    target and with a high speech density.  A single segment longer than ``max_seconds`` is cut
    to the target length from its start.
    """
    target = float(
        target_seconds
        if target_seconds is not None
        else get_engine_settings().REFERENCE_TARGET_SECONDS
    )
    target = min(max(target, min_seconds), max_seconds)
    if not segments:
        raise InvalidReference(
            "No speech was detected in the recording. "
            "Record at least a few seconds of clear speech.",
            details={"speech_seconds": 0.0},
        )
    if speech_total(segments) < min_seconds:
        raise InvalidReference(
            f"Only {speech_total(segments):.1f} s of speech were detected; at least "
            f"{min_seconds:.0f} s are required.",
            details={"speech_seconds": speech_total(segments), "min_seconds": min_seconds},
        )

    best: tuple[float, ReferenceWindow] | None = None
    n = len(segments)
    for i in range(n):
        speech = 0.0
        for j in range(i, n):
            speech += segments[j].duration
            span = segments[j].end - segments[i].start
            if span > max_seconds:
                if i == j:  # one very long segment: cut it to the target
                    cut_end = segments[i].start + target
                    window = ReferenceWindow(
                        segments[i].start, cut_end, speech_seconds=target, segments=1
                    )
                    score = 0.0 + 0.05  # tiny penalty: we had to cut inside speech
                    if best is None or score < best[0]:
                        best = (score, window)
                break
            if span < min_seconds:
                continue
            density = speech / span if span > 0 else 0.0
            score = abs(span - target) / target + (1.0 - density) * 2.0
            window = ReferenceWindow(
                segments[i].start, segments[j].end, speech_seconds=speech, segments=j - i + 1
            )
            if best is None or score < best[0]:
                best = (score, window)

    if best is None:
        # Speech exists (≥ min) but no span reaches ``min_seconds``: extend the densest cluster.
        first, last = segments[0], segments[-1]
        start = first.start
        end = max(last.end, start + min_seconds)
        if end > total_duration:
            end = total_duration
            start = max(0.0, end - min_seconds)
        best = (0.0, ReferenceWindow(start, end, speech_seconds=speech_total(segments), segments=n))

    window = best[1]
    start = max(0.0, window.start - margin)
    end = min(total_duration, window.end + margin)
    return ReferenceWindow(
        start=start, end=end, speech_seconds=window.speech_seconds, segments=window.segments
    )


__all__ = [
    "MARGIN_SECONDS",
    "VAD_SAMPLE_RATE",
    "ReferenceWindow",
    "SpeechSegment",
    "detect_speech",
    "make_detector",
    "select_window",
    "speech_total",
]

```
