## frontend/src/components/audio/AudioPlayer.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { Download, Pause, Play, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/IconButton";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { getAudioContextCtor } from "@/lib/audio";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { formatDuration } from "@/lib/format";
import { LiveLevels } from "./LiveLevels";

interface MeterGraph {
  ctx: AudioContext;
  analyser: AnalyserNode;
}

// A media element can only be wrapped in one MediaElementSourceNode for its lifetime.
const graphs = new WeakMap<HTMLMediaElement, MeterGraph>();

function attachMeter(el: HTMLMediaElement): MeterGraph | null {
  const existing = graphs.get(el);
  if (existing) return existing;
  const Ctor = getAudioContextCtor();
  if (!Ctor) return null;
  try {
    const ctx = new Ctor();
    const source = ctx.createMediaElementSource(el);
    const analyser = ctx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.7;
    source.connect(analyser);
    analyser.connect(ctx.destination);
    const graph = { ctx, analyser };
    graphs.set(el, graph);
    return graph;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export interface AudioPlayerProps {
  src: string;
  /** Known duration in seconds (recorder blobs often report Infinity until fully buffered). */
  duration?: number | null;
  downloadHref?: string;
  downloadName?: string;
  onRegenerate?: () => void;
  regenerateDisabled?: boolean;
  autoPlay?: boolean;
  compact?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name for the player region. */
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
  onError?: (message: string) => void;
}

export function AudioPlayer({
  src,
  duration: knownDuration,
  downloadHref,
  downloadName,
  onRegenerate,
  regenerateDisabled,
  autoPlay = false,
  compact = false,
  label = "Audio player",
  className,
  onError,
}: AudioPlayerProps) {
  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement>(null);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState<number>(knownDuration && Number.isFinite(knownDuration) ? knownDuration : 0);
  const [analyser, setAnalyser] = useState<AnalyserNode | null>(null);
  const [seeking, setSeeking] = useState(false);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (knownDuration && Number.isFinite(knownDuration)) setDuration(knownDuration);
  }, [knownDuration]);

  // Reset on source change.
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrent(0);
    setPlaying(false);
    setFailed(null);
  }, [src]);

  const togglePlay = useCallback(async () => {
    const el = audioRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    if (el.paused) {
      const graph = attachMeter(el);
      if (graph) {
        if (graph.ctx.state === "suspended") await graph.ctx.resume().catch(() => undefined);
        setAnalyser(graph.analyser);
      }
      try {
        await el.play();
      } catch (e) {
        const msg = e instanceof Error && e.name === "NotSupportedError" ? "This browser cannot play the audio format." : "Playback could not start.";
        setFailed(msg);
        onError?.(msg);
      }
    } else {
      el.pause();
    }
  }, [onError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoPlay) return;
    const el = audioRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const onCanPlay = () => void togglePlay();
    el.addEventListener("canplay", onCanPlay, { once: true });
    return () => el.removeEventListener("canplay", onCanPlay);
  }, [autoPlay, src, togglePlay]);

  const onLoaded = () => {
    const el = audioRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    if (Number.isFinite(el.duration) && el.duration > 0) setDuration(el.duration);
  };

  const onTime = () => {
    const el = audioRef.current;
    if (!el || seeking) return;
    setCurrent(el.currentTime);
    // Recorder blobs: duration becomes known as playback proceeds.
    if (Number.isFinite(el.duration) && el.duration > 0 && Math.abs(el.duration - duration) > 0.05) setDuration(el.duration);
  };

  const seekTo = (value: number) => {
    const el = audioRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.currentTime = value;
    setCurrent(value);
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === " " || e.key === "k") {
      e.preventDefault();
      void togglePlay();
    }
  };

  const max = duration > 0 ? duration : 0;
  const pct = max > 0 ? Math.min(100, (current / max) * 100) : 0;

  return (
    <div
      role="group"
      aria-label={label}
      onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
      className={cn("flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface p-3", className)}
    >
      <audio
        ref={audioRef}
        src={src}
        preload="metadata"
        crossOrigin="anonymous"
        onLoadedMetadata={onLoaded}
        onDurationChange={onLoaded}
        onTimeUpdate={onTime}
        onPlay={() => setPlaying(true)}
        onPause={() => setPlaying(false)}
        onEnded={() => {
          setPlaying(false);
          setCurrent(0);
        }}
        onError={() => {
          const msg = "The audio could not be loaded.";
          setFailed(msg);
          onError?.(msg);
        }}
      />
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <IconButton
          label={playing ? "Pause" : "Play"}
          onClick={() => void togglePlay()}
          disabled={Boolean(failed)}
          className={cn("shrink-0 rounded-full border border-border bg-surface text-ink hover:border-border-strong hover:bg-surface-2")}
        >
          {playing ? <Pause className="size-4" aria-hidden /> : <Play className="ml-0.5 size-4" aria-hidden />}
        </IconButton>

        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1.5">
          <div className="relative flex h-6 items-center">
            <div aria-hidden className="absolute inset-x-0 h-px bg-border-strong" />
            <div aria-hidden className="absolute left-0 h-px bg-ink" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
            <input
              type="range"
              aria-label="Seek"
              aria-valuetext={`${formatDuration(current)} of ${formatDuration(max)}`}
              min={0}
              max={max || 1}
              step={0.01}
              value={Math.min(current, max || 1)}
              disabled={max <= 0 || Boolean(failed)}
              onPointerDown={() => setSeeking(true)}
              onPointerUp={() => setSeeking(false)}
              onKeyUp={() => setSeeking(false)}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setSeeking(true);
                seekTo(Number(e.target.value));
              }}
              onMouseUp={() => setSeeking(false)}
              onTouchEnd={() => setSeeking(false)}
              className="pv-scrubber relative h-6 w-full cursor-pointer appearance-none bg-transparent disabled:cursor-default"
            />
          </div>
          {!compact && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-mono text-micro tabular text-ink-3">
              <span>{formatDuration(current)}</span>
              <span>{formatDuration(max)}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <LiveLevels analyser={analyser} active={playing} size={compact ? 20 : 24} className="shrink-0" />

        {compact && (
          <span className="shrink-0 font-mono text-micro tabular text-ink-3">
            {formatDuration(current)} / {formatDuration(max)}
          </span>
        )}

        {(downloadHref || onRegenerate) && (
          <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
            {downloadHref && (
              <IconButton label="Download" asChildAnchor href={downloadHref} download={downloadName}>
                <Download className="size-4" aria-hidden />
              </IconButton>
            )}
            {onRegenerate && !compact && (
              <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onRegenerate} disabled={regenerateDisabled} leading={<RotateCcw className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />}>
                Regenerate
              </Button>
            )}
            {onRegenerate && compact && (
              <IconButton label="Regenerate" size="sm" onClick={onRegenerate} disabled={regenerateDisabled}>
                <RotateCcw className="size-4" aria-hidden />
              </IconButton>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {failed && (
        <p role="alert" className="text-small text-danger">
          {failed}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/audio/LiveLevels.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { BrandMark } from "@/components/brand/BrandMark";
import { levelsFromAnalyser } from "@/lib/audio";

const IDLE = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];

/**
 * The brand bars driven by an AnalyserNode (recording / playback). Decorative; the caller
 * announces state textually. When `analyser` is null the static mark is shown.
 */
export function LiveLevels({
  analyser,
  active,
  size = 32,
  className,
  onLevel,
}: {
  analyser: AnalyserNode | null;
  active: boolean;
  size?: number;
  className?: string;
  /** Optional overall level (0–1) callback, e.g. for a textual level readout. */
  onLevel?: (level: number) => void;
}) {
  const [levels, setLevels] = useState<number[]>(IDLE);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!analyser || !active) {
      setLevels(IDLE);
      return;
    }
    const reduce = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    const scratch = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount) as Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    let raf = 0;
    let last = 0;
    const tick = (t: number) => {
      // ~30 fps is plenty for a meter; reduced motion gets 4 fps.
      const interval = reduce ? 250 : 33;
      if (t - last >= interval) {
        last = t;
        const next = levelsFromAnalyser(analyser, scratch);
        setLevels(next);
        onLevel?.(Math.max(...next));
      }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [analyser, active, onLevel]);

  return <BrandMark size={size} animated={active} levels={active ? levels : null} className={className} />;
}
```

## frontend/src/components/audio/Waveform.tsx

```tsx
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

/**
 * Static waveform drawn from normalised peaks (0–1). Decorative — callers must provide the
 * textual equivalent (duration) next to it. `progress` (0–1) tints the played portion.
 */
export function Waveform({
  peaks,
  height = 48,
  progress,
  className,
}: {
  peaks: ArrayLike<number>;
  height?: number;
  progress?: number;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const n = peaks.length;
  if (n === 0) return null;
  const width = 1000;
  const gap = 0.35;
  const barW = (width / n) * (1 - gap);
  const step = width / n;
  const mid = height / 2;
  const splitAt = progress == null ? null : Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress)) * n);

  const bars = (from: number, to: number, cls: string) => {
    const parts: string[] = [];
    for (let i = from; i < to; i++) {
      const v = Math.max(0.04, Math.min(1, peaks[i] ?? 0));
      const h = Math.max(1.5, v * (height - 2));
      const x = i * step + (step - barW) / 2;
      parts.push(`M${x.toFixed(2)} ${(mid - h / 2).toFixed(2)}h${barW.toFixed(2)}v${h.toFixed(2)}h-${barW.toFixed(2)}z`);
    }
    return parts.length ? <path d={parts.join("")} className={cls} /> : null;
  };

  return (
    <svg
      aria-hidden
      viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`}
      preserveAspectRatio="none"
      className={cn("block w-full", className)}
      style={{ height }}
    >
      {splitAt == null ? (
        bars(0, n, "fill-ink-2")
      ) : (
        <>
          {bars(0, splitAt, "fill-ink")}
          {bars(splitAt, n, "fill-border-strong")}
        </>
      )}
    </svg>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/audio/__tests__/AudioPlayer.test.tsx

```tsx
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { AudioPlayer } from "@/components/audio/AudioPlayer";

describe("AudioPlayer", () => {
  let playSpy: ReturnType<typeof vi.spyOn>;
  let pauseSpy: ReturnType<typeof vi.spyOn>;

  beforeEach(() => {
    // jsdom's HTMLMediaElement has no playback; emulate play/pause with events.
    playSpy = vi.spyOn(HTMLMediaElement.prototype, "play").mockImplementation(function (this: HTMLMediaElement) {
      Object.defineProperty(this, "paused", { value: false, configurable: true });
      this.dispatchEvent(new Event("play"));
      return Promise.resolve();
    });
    pauseSpy = vi.spyOn(HTMLMediaElement.prototype, "pause").mockImplementation(function (this: HTMLMediaElement) {
      Object.defineProperty(this, "paused", { value: true, configurable: true });
      this.dispatchEvent(new Event("pause"));
    });
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    playSpy.mockRestore();
    pauseSpy.mockRestore();
  });

  it("renders elapsed/total in mono using the known duration and toggles play/pause", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<AudioPlayer src="/api/v1/generations/g1/audio" duration={8.085} downloadHref="/api/v1/generations/g1/audio?download=1" />);
    expect(screen.getByText("0:00")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("0:08")).toBeInTheDocument();

    const play = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Play" });
    await user.click(play);
    expect(playSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Pause" })).toBeInTheDocument();

    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Pause" }));
    expect(pauseSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Play" })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("exposes a download link to the ?download=1 URL", () => {
    render(<AudioPlayer src="/api/v1/generations/g1/audio" duration={5} downloadHref="/api/v1/generations/g1/audio?download=1" />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Download" })).toHaveAttribute("href", "/api/v1/generations/g1/audio?download=1");
  });

  it("seeks with the scrubber and reports elapsed time from the element", () => {
    const { container } = render(<AudioPlayer src="/x.wav" duration={10} />);
    const audio = container.querySelector("audio") as HTMLAudioElement;
    const slider = screen.getByRole("slider", { name: "Seek" });
    fireEvent.change(slider, { target: { value: "4" } });
    expect(audio.currentTime).toBe(4);
    fireEvent.mouseUp(slider);
    act(() => {
      audio.currentTime = 6;
      audio.dispatchEvent(new Event("timeupdate"));
    });
    expect(screen.getByText("0:06")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuetext", "0:06 of 0:10");
  });

  it("calls onRegenerate", async () => {
    const onRegenerate = vi.fn();
    render(<AudioPlayer src="/x.wav" duration={1} onRegenerate={onRegenerate} />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Regenerate" }));
    expect(onRegenerate).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("surfaces load errors", () => {
    const { container } = render(<AudioPlayer src="/missing.wav" />);
    const audio = container.querySelector("audio") as HTMLAudioElement;
    act(() => {
      audio.dispatchEvent(new Event("error"));
    });
    expect(screen.getByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent("The audio could not be loaded.");
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Play" })).toBeDisabled();
  });
});
```

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Wordmark } from "@/components/brand/Wordmark";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { isApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { useLogin, useRegister } from "@/lib/api/hooks";

const EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
const PASSWORD_MIN = 10;
const PASSWORD_MAX = 128;

function safeNext(raw: string | null): string {
  if (!raw) return "/app";
  // Only allow same-origin app paths.
  if (raw.startsWith("/app") && !raw.startsWith("//")) return raw;
  return "/app";
}

export function AuthForm({ kind }: { kind: "login" | "register" }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const next = safeNext(params.get("next"));
  const login = useLogin();
  const register = useRegister();
  const mutation = kind === "login" ? login : register;

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  const emailError = !email ? "Enter your email." : !EMAIL_RE.test(email) ? "That does not look like an email address." : null;
  const nameError = kind === "register" && !displayName.trim() ? "Enter the name we should show." : null;
  const passwordError = !password
    ? "Enter your password."
    : kind === "register" && password.length < PASSWORD_MIN
      ? `Use at least ${PASSWORD_MIN} characters.`
      : password.length > PASSWORD_MAX
        ? `Use at most ${PASSWORD_MAX} characters.`
        : null;
  const valid = !emailError && !nameError && !passwordError;

  const serverFields = isApiError(mutation.error) ? mutation.error.fieldErrors() : {};
  const serverCode = isApiError(mutation.error) ? mutation.error.code : null;
  const showGeneralError = mutation.isError && Object.keys(serverFields).length === 0;

  const onSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setTouched({ email: true, display_name: true, password: true });
    if (!valid) return;
    const normalisedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const onSuccess = () => router.replace(next);
    if (kind === "login") {
      login.mutate({ email: normalisedEmail, password }, { onSuccess });
    } else {
      register.mutate({ email: normalisedEmail, password, display_name: displayName.trim() }, { onSuccess });
    }
  };

  const show = (field: string, local: string | null) => (touched[field] ? (serverFields[field] ?? local) : serverFields[field]);

  return (
    <main className="flex min-h-dvh flex-col bg-bg">
      <header className="flex h-14 items-center px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
        <Wordmark />
      </header>
      <section className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center px-4 pb-24 pt-8">
        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <h1 className="display text-h1 text-ink">{kind === "login" ? "Welcome back." : "Create your account."}</h1>
            <p className="text-body text-ink-2">
              {kind === "login" ? "Sign in to use your voice." : "One account, all your voices."}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <Input
              label="Email"
              type="email"
              name="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              inputMode="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              onBlur={() => setTouched((t) => ({ ...t, email: true }))}
              error={show("email", emailError)}
              required
            />
            {kind === "register" && (
              <Input
                label="Display name"
                name="display_name"
                autoComplete="nickname"
                value={displayName}
                maxLength={60}
                onChange={(e) => setDisplayName(e.target.value)}
                onBlur={() => setTouched((t) => ({ ...t, display_name: true }))}
                error={show("display_name", nameError)}
                required
              />
            )}
            <Input
              label="Password"
              type="password"
              name="password"
              autoComplete={kind === "login" ? "current-password" : "new-password"}
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              onBlur={() => setTouched((t) => ({ ...t, password: true }))}
              error={show("password", passwordError)}
              hint={kind === "register" ? `${PASSWORD_MIN}–${PASSWORD_MAX} characters.` : undefined}
              required
            />
          </div>

          {showGeneralError && <ErrorNote error={mutation.error} code={serverCode} />}

          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" size="lg" block loading={mutation.isPending}>
            {kind === "login" ? "Sign in" : "Create account"}
          </Button>

          <p className="text-small text-ink-2">
            {kind === "login" ? (
              <>
                New here?{" "}
                <Link href={`/register${params.get("next") ? `?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}` : ""}`} className="font-medium text-ink underline-offset-4 hover:underline">
                  Create an account
                </Link>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                Already have an account?{" "}
                <Link href={`/login${params.get("next") ? `?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}` : ""}`} className="font-medium text-ink underline-offset-4 hover:underline">
                  Sign in
                </Link>
              </>
            )}
          </p>
        </form>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/brand/BrandMark.tsx

```tsx
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

/**
 * Five vertical bars of a voice signature (heights 10/22/32/22/10 on a 32px grid, 3px wide,
 * 3px gaps, rounded ends). Centre bar in accent, others in ink. `levels` (0–1 per bar) drives
 * the live meter while recording / speaking. Decorative: aria-hidden unless given a label.
 */
export const BAR_HEIGHTS = [10, 22, 32, 22, 10] as const;
const BAR_W = 3;
const GAP = 3;
const GRID = 32;
const TOTAL_W = BAR_HEIGHTS.length * BAR_W + (BAR_HEIGHTS.length - 1) * GAP; // 27

export interface BrandMarkProps {
  size?: number;
  levels?: number[] | null;
  animated?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  label?: string;
  /** Animation delay per bar for the intro draw-in (CSS transition handled by caller). */
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

export function BrandMark({ size = 32, levels, animated = false, className, label, style }: BrandMarkProps) {
  const scale = size / GRID;
  const width = TOTAL_W * scale;
  return (
    <svg
      width={width}
      height={size}
      viewBox={`0 0 ${TOTAL_W} ${GRID}`}
      role={label ? "img" : undefined}
      aria-label={label}
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      className={cn("shrink-0 overflow-visible", className)}
      style={style}
    >
      {BAR_HEIGHTS.map((h, i) => {
        const level = levels?.[i];
        const live = animated && typeof level === "number";
        // Live mode: bar height follows the level, with the static silhouette as the floor at 35%.
        const height = live ? Math.max(4, h * (0.35 + 0.65 * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, level)))) : h;
        const x = i * (BAR_W + GAP);
        const y = (GRID - height) / 2;
        const isCentre = i === 2;
        return (
          <rect
            key={i}
            x={x}
            y={y}
            width={BAR_W}
            height={height}
            rx={BAR_W / 2}
            className={cn(
              isCentre ? "fill-accent" : "fill-ink",
              live && "transition-[y,height] duration-[80ms] ease-linear",
            )}
            data-bar={i}
          />
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/composer/Composer.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { VoiceSelector, useSelectedVoice } from "@/components/voice/VoiceSelector";
import { useCreateGeneration, useGeneration, useMe } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import { isApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { MAX_TEXT_CHARS, type GenerationCreate } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { GenerationResult } from "./GenerationResult";
import { RunButton } from "./RunButton";
import { TextComposer } from "./TextComposer";

const DRAFT_KEY = "pv-draft";

function readDraft(): string {
  try {
    return sessionStorage.getItem(DRAFT_KEY) ?? "";
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

function writeDraft(text: string) {
  try {
    if (text) sessionStorage.setItem(DRAFT_KEY, text);
    else sessionStorage.removeItem(DRAFT_KEY);
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

export interface ComposerProps {
  /** Advanced mode: metrics line, language chip, and caller-supplied request parameters. */
  advanced?: boolean;
  /** Extra generation parameters (Advanced mode). Simple mode uses the user's preferences. */
  params?: Partial<Omit<GenerationCreate, "voice_id" | "text">>;
  chips?: ReactNode;
  /** Rendered between the composer and the run row (Advanced controls). */
  controls?: ReactNode;
}

export function Composer({ advanced = false, params, chips, controls }: ComposerProps) {
  const me = useMe();
  const { selected, readyVoices, isPending: voicesPending } = useSelectedVoice();
  const create = useCreateGeneration();
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [generationId, setGenerationId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hydrated, setHydrated] = useState(false);
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setText(readDraft());
    setHydrated(true);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hydrated) writeDraft(text);
  }, [text, hydrated]);

  const generation = useGeneration(generationId, { initialData: create.data?.id === generationId ? create.data : undefined });
  const current = generation.data ?? null;
  const running = current && (current.status === "queued" || current.status === "processing") ? current : null;

  const trimmed = text.trim();
  let disabledReason: string | null = null;
  if (voicesPending) disabledReason = "Loading your voices";
  else if (readyVoices.length === 0) disabledReason = "Create a voice first";
  else if (!selected) disabledReason = "Choose a voice first";
  else if (!trimmed) disabledReason = "Write something to say";
  else if (text.length > MAX_TEXT_CHARS) disabledReason = `Keep it under ${MAX_TEXT_CHARS.toLocaleString()} characters`;

  const runWith = useCallback(
    (voiceId: string, body_text: string) => {
      if (running || create.isPending) return;
      const prefs = me.data?.preferences;
      const body: GenerationCreate = {
        voice_id: voiceId,
        text: body_text,
        language: params?.language ?? prefs?.default_language ?? "auto",
        speed: params?.speed ?? prefs?.speed ?? 1,
        output_format: params?.output_format ?? prefs?.output_format ?? "wav",
      };
      if (params?.quality) body.quality = params.quality;
      const engine = params?.engine_id ?? (advanced ? (prefs?.default_engine ?? undefined) : undefined);
      if (engine) body.engine_id = engine;
      create.mutate(body, { onSuccess: (gen) => setGenerationId(gen.id) });
    },
    [running, create, me.data, params, advanced],
  );

  const run = useCallback(() => {
    if (disabledReason || !selected) return;
    runWith(selected.id, trimmed);
  }, [disabledReason, selected, runWith, trimmed]);

  /** Same voice, same text, new generation. */
  const regenerate = useCallback(() => {
    if (!current) return;
    const voiceId = current.voice_id ?? selected?.id;
    if (!voiceId) return;
    runWith(voiceId, current.text);
  }, [current, selected, runWith]);

  const showMetrics = advanced;
  const createError = create.isError ? create.error : null;
  const supportedEngines =
    isApiError(createError) && Array.isArray(createError.details?.supported_engines)
      ? (createError.details.supported_engines as string[])
      : null;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <p className="eyebrow">Selected voice</p>
        <VoiceSelector />
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        <TextComposer
          ref={textareaRef}
          value={text}
          onChange={setText}
          onRun={run}
          disabled={Boolean(running) || create.isPending}
          chips={chips}
        />
        {controls}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            {createError && (
              <ErrorNote
                error={createError}
                message={
                  supportedEngines && supportedEngines.length > 0
                    ? `${createError instanceof Error ? createError.message : ""} Engines that support it: ${supportedEngines.join(", ")}.`
                    : undefined
                }
              />
            )}
          </div>
          <RunButton onRun={run} disabledReason={disabledReason} running={running} submitting={create.isPending} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {current && (
        <GenerationResult
          generation={current}
          showMetrics={showMetrics}
          onRegenerate={regenerate}
          regenerateDisabled={Boolean(running) || create.isPending || (!current.voice_id && !selected)}
        />
      )}
      {generation.isError && (
        <ErrorNote error={generation.error} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/composer/GenerationResult.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { AudioPlayer } from "@/components/audio/AudioPlayer";
import { ProgressBar } from "@/components/ui/ProgressBar";
import { generations } from "@/lib/api/resources";
import { LANGUAGE_NAMES, type Generation } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { formatDuration, formatSeconds, formatRtf } from "@/lib/format";
import { generationStageText, progressFraction } from "@/lib/stages";

export function GenerationResult({
  generation,
  onRegenerate,
  regenerateDisabled,
  showMetrics = false,
  className,
}: {
  generation: Generation;
  onRegenerate?: () => void;
  regenerateDisabled?: boolean;
  showMetrics?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const g = generation;
  const active = g.status === "queued" || g.status === "processing";
  const lang = g.language ? LANGUAGE_NAMES[g.language]?.name : null;

  return (
    <section aria-label="Result" aria-live="polite" className={cn("flex flex-col gap-3", className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <p className="eyebrow">Output</p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
          <p className="text-small text-ink-2">
            {active && <span>{generationStageText(g)}…</span>}
            {g.status === "completed" && g.output && (
              <span>
                Ready · {formatDuration(g.output.duration_seconds)} · {g.output.format.toUpperCase()}
                {lang ? ` · ${lang}` : ""}
                {g.voice_name ? ` · ${g.voice_name}` : ""}
              </span>
            )}
            {g.status === "failed" && <span className="text-danger">{g.error?.message ?? "Generation failed."}</span>}
            {g.status === "cancelled" && <span>Cancelled.</span>}
          </p>
          {g.status === "failed" && g.error?.code && <span className="font-mono text-micro text-ink-3">{g.error.code}</span>}
          {showMetrics && g.status === "completed" && g.engine_id && (
            <span className="font-mono text-micro text-ink-3">{g.engine_id}</span>
          )}
        </div>
        {active && g.status === "processing" && (
          <ProgressBar fraction={progressFraction(g.progress)} label="Generation progress" />
        )}
      </div>

      {g.status === "completed" && (
        <AudioPlayer
          src={generations.audioUrl(g.id)}
          duration={g.output?.duration_seconds ?? null}
          downloadHref={generations.audioUrl(g.id, true)}
          onRegenerate={onRegenerate}
          regenerateDisabled={regenerateDisabled}
          label={`Generated audio for ${g.voice_name}`}
        />
      )}

      {g.status === "failed" && onRegenerate && (
        <div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onRegenerate}
            disabled={regenerateDisabled}
            className="text-button font-medium text-ink underline-offset-4 hover:underline disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            Try again
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {showMetrics && g.status === "completed" && g.metrics && (
        <p className="font-mono text-micro tabular text-ink-3">
          inference {formatSeconds(g.metrics.inference_seconds)} · total {formatSeconds(g.metrics.total_seconds)} · rtf{" "}
          {formatRtf(g.metrics.real_time_factor)} · {g.metrics.chunks} {g.metrics.chunks === 1 ? "chunk" : "chunks"} ·{" "}
          {g.metrics.device} · peak {g.metrics.peak_dbfs.toFixed(1)} dBFS
          {g.output ? ` · ${(g.output.sample_rate / 1000).toFixed(0)} kHz` : ""}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/composer/RunButton.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import type { Generation } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { generationStageText, progressFraction } from "@/lib/stages";
import { Tooltip } from "@/components/ui/Tooltip";

export interface RunButtonProps {
  onRun: () => void;
  /** Reason the button is disabled, shown as a tooltip and read by assistive tech. */
  disabledReason?: string | null;
  /** The in-flight generation (queued / processing) — drives the real progress readout. */
  running?: Pick<Generation, "status" | "progress"> | null;
  /** Request has been sent but no generation object has come back yet. */
  submitting?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * The single accent-filled button. While running it shows the real pipeline stage text and a
 * 1px bar whose width is `current / total` — never a fabricated percentage.
 */
export function RunButton({ onRun, disabledReason, running, submitting, className }: RunButtonProps) {
  const isRunning = Boolean(running) || Boolean(submitting);
  const disabled = Boolean(disabledReason) || isRunning;
  const stage = submitting && !running ? "Starting" : running ? generationStageText(running) : "";
  const fraction = running ? progressFraction(running.progress) : null;
  const showBar = isRunning && running?.status === "processing";

  const button = (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onRun}
      disabled={disabled}
      aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
      aria-describedby={disabledReason ? "run-reason" : undefined}
      aria-busy={isRunning || undefined}
      className={cn(
        "relative inline-flex h-12 min-w-36 items-center justify-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-sm bg-accent px-6 text-button font-medium text-on-accent",
        "transition-[background-color,transform,box-shadow] duration-fast ease-pv",
        "hover:bg-accent-hover active:translate-y-px active:shadow-sm",
        "disabled:cursor-not-allowed",
        !isRunning && disabled && "opacity-50",
        className,
      )}
    >
      {isRunning ? (
        <>
          <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden />
          <span className="tabular" aria-live="polite">
            {stage || "Processing"}
          </span>
          {showBar && (
            <span aria-hidden className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-px bg-on-accent/30">
              <span
                className="block h-full bg-on-accent transition-[width] duration-base ease-pv"
                style={{ width: fraction == null ? "0%" : `${Math.round(fraction * 100)}%` }}
                data-testid="run-progress"
              />
            </span>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        "Run"
      )}
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <div className="inline-flex flex-col items-end gap-1">
      {disabledReason && !isRunning ? (
        <Tooltip content={disabledReason}>
          <span tabIndex={0} className="inline-flex rounded-sm">
            {button}
          </span>
        </Tooltip>
      ) : (
        button
      )}
      {disabledReason && !isRunning && (
        <span id="run-reason" className="sr-only">
          {disabledReason}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/composer/TextComposer.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { forwardRef, useCallback, useEffect, useImperativeHandle, useRef, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Kbd } from "@/components/ui/Kbd";
import { MAX_TEXT_CHARS } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export interface TextComposerProps {
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  /** Called on ⌘/Ctrl+Enter. */
  onRun?: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  maxChars?: number;
  /** Extra chips (e.g. the language chip in Advanced mode) rendered in the footer. */
  chips?: ReactNode;
  id?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export const TextComposer = forwardRef<HTMLTextAreaElement, TextComposerProps>(function TextComposer(
  {
    value,
    onChange,
    onRun,
    disabled,
    placeholder = "What would you like your voice to say?",
    maxChars = MAX_TEXT_CHARS,
    chips,
    id = "composer-text",
    className,
  },
  ref,
) {
  const innerRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  useImperativeHandle(ref, () => innerRef.current as HTMLTextAreaElement);

  const resize = useCallback(() => {
    const el = innerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.style.height = "0px";
    const next = Math.max(144, Math.min(el.scrollHeight, 480));
    el.style.height = `${next}px`;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    resize();
  }, [value, resize]);

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      onRun?.();
    }
  };

  const count = value.length;
  const over = count > maxChars;
  const isMac = typeof navigator !== "undefined" && /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform);

  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-col", className)}>
      <label htmlFor={id} className="sr-only">
        Text to speak
      </label>
      <div
        className={cn(
          "group relative rounded-md border border-border bg-surface transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv",
          "focus-within:border-border-strong hover:border-border-strong",
          over && "border-danger focus-within:border-danger",
        )}
      >
        <textarea
          ref={innerRef}
          id={id}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          disabled={disabled}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          spellCheck
          aria-describedby={`${id}-count`}
          aria-invalid={over || undefined}
          className={cn(
            "block w-full resize-none bg-transparent px-4 pb-10 pt-4 text-[17px] leading-[1.55] text-ink outline-none",
            "placeholder:text-ink-3 disabled:opacity-60",
          )}
          style={{ minHeight: 144 }}
        />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 flex h-10 items-center justify-between gap-3 px-3">
          <div className="pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-2">{chips}</div>
          <div className="pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-2">
            {onRun && (
              <span className="hidden items-center gap-1 text-micro text-ink-3 sm:inline-flex" aria-hidden>
                <Kbd>{isMac ? "⌘" : "Ctrl"}</Kbd>
                <Kbd>↵</Kbd>
              </span>
            )}
            <span
              id={`${id}-count`}
              className={cn("font-mono text-micro tabular", over ? "text-danger" : "text-ink-3")}
              aria-live="polite"
              aria-atomic="true"
            >
              <span className="sr-only">Characters: </span>
              {count.toLocaleString()} / {maxChars.toLocaleString()}
            </span>
            {value.length > 0 && !disabled && (
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label="Clear text"
                onClick={() => {
                  onChange("");
                  innerRef.current?.focus();
                }}
                className="inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-sm text-ink-3 transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-ink"
              >
                <X className="size-4" aria-hidden />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});
```

## frontend/src/components/composer/__tests__/RunButton.test.tsx

```tsx
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { RunButton } from "@/components/composer/RunButton";
import { TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/Tooltip";

const wrap = (ui: React.ReactElement) => render(<TooltipProvider>{ui}</TooltipProvider>);

describe("RunButton", () => {
  it("is enabled and labelled Run when idle", async () => {
    const onRun = vi.fn();
    wrap(<RunButton onRun={onRun} />);
    const btn = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Run" });
    expect(btn).toBeEnabled();
    await userEvent.click(btn);
    expect(onRun).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("is disabled with an accessible reason", () => {
    wrap(<RunButton onRun={() => undefined} disabledReason="Create a voice first" />);
    const btn = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Run" });
    expect(btn).toBeDisabled();
    expect(btn).toHaveAttribute("aria-describedby", "run-reason");
    expect(screen.getByText("Create a voice first")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shows Queued while queued, without a progress bar", () => {
    wrap(<RunButton onRun={() => undefined} running={{ status: "queued", progress: null }} />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button")).toHaveTextContent("Queued");
    expect(screen.getByRole("button")).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.queryByTestId("run-progress")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shows the real stage text and a bar whose width is current/total", () => {
    wrap(<RunButton onRun={() => undefined} running={{ status: "processing", progress: { stage: "synthesize", current: 2, total: 4 } }} />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button")).toHaveTextContent("Synthesising 2 of 4");
    expect(screen.getByTestId("run-progress")).toHaveStyle({ width: "50%" });
  });

  it("shows Processing with an empty bar when progress is null", () => {
    wrap(<RunButton onRun={() => undefined} running={{ status: "processing", progress: null }} />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button")).toHaveTextContent("Processing");
    expect(screen.getByTestId("run-progress")).toHaveStyle({ width: "0%" });
  });

  it("shows Starting while the request is in flight", () => {
    wrap(<RunButton onRun={() => undefined} submitting />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button")).toHaveTextContent("Starting");
  });
});
```

## frontend/src/components/composer/__tests__/TextComposer.test.tsx

```tsx
import { fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { useState } from "react";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { TextComposer } from "@/components/composer/TextComposer";

function Harness({ onRun, initial = "" }: { onRun?: () => void; initial?: string }) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initial);
  return <TextComposer value={value} onChange={setValue} onRun={onRun} />;
}

describe("TextComposer", () => {
  it("shows the placeholder and a mono character count out of 5000", () => {
    render(<Harness />);
    expect(screen.getByPlaceholderText("What would you like your voice to say?")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/0 \/ 5,000/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("updates the count as the user types and clears", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<Harness />);
    const ta = screen.getByLabelText("Text to speak");
    await user.type(ta, "Hello");
    expect(screen.getByText(/5 \/ 5,000/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Clear text" }));
    expect(ta).toHaveValue("");
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: "Clear text" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("runs on Ctrl/Cmd+Enter but not on plain Enter", () => {
    const onRun = vi.fn();
    render(<Harness onRun={onRun} initial="Say this" />);
    const ta = screen.getByLabelText("Text to speak");
    fireEvent.keyDown(ta, { key: "Enter" });
    expect(onRun).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    fireEvent.keyDown(ta, { key: "Enter", ctrlKey: true });
    fireEvent.keyDown(ta, { key: "Enter", metaKey: true });
    expect(onRun).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it("flags text over the limit", () => {
    render(<Harness initial={"a".repeat(5001)} />);
    expect(screen.getByLabelText("Text to speak")).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
  });
});
```

## frontend/src/components/conversation/ConversationPanel.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { Mic, MicOff, Square } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { LiveLevels } from "@/components/audio/LiveLevels";
import { Badge, type BadgeTone } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/ui/PageHeader";
import { Select, type SelectOption } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { VoiceSelector, useSelectedVoice } from "@/components/voice/VoiceSelector";
import { useConversationEngines, useMe } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import type { ConversationState } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { useConversation, type SocketStatus } from "@/lib/conversation/useConversation";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const STATE_LABEL: Record<ConversationState, string> = {
  idle: "Idle",
  listening: "Listening",
  thinking: "Thinking",
  speaking: "Speaking",
};

const SOCKET_LABEL: Record<SocketStatus, { label: string; tone: BadgeTone }> = {
  disconnected: { label: "Not connected", tone: "neutral" },
  connecting: { label: "Connecting", tone: "processing" },
  connected: { label: "Connected", tone: "success" },
  reconnecting: { label: "Reconnecting", tone: "warning" },
  closed: { label: "Closed", tone: "neutral" },
};

const ENGINE_LABEL: Record<string, { label: string; description: string }> = {
  mirror: { label: "Mirror", description: "Speaks your own words back in your voice." },
  llm: { label: "Assistant", description: "Replies with a language model, in your voice." },
};

export function ConversationPanel() {
  const me = useMe();
  const { selected, readyVoices } = useSelectedVoice();
  const engines = useConversationEngines();
  const [engine, setEngine] = useState<string>("mirror");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!engines.data) return;
    const current = engines.data.find((e) => e.id === engine);
    if (!current?.available) {
      const first = engines.data.find((e) => e.available);
      if (first) setEngine(first.id);
    }
  }, [engines.data, engine]);

  const conv = useConversation({ voiceId: selected?.id ?? null, engine, language: me.data?.preferences.default_language });
  const active = conv.socket !== "disconnected" && conv.socket !== "closed";
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ top: scrollRef.current.scrollHeight });
  }, [conv.turns.length, conv.live.transcript, conv.live.response]);

  const engineOptions: SelectOption<string>[] = (engines.data ?? []).map((e) => ({
    value: e.id,
    label: e.available ? (ENGINE_LABEL[e.id]?.label ?? e.id) : `${ENGINE_LABEL[e.id]?.label ?? e.id} — unavailable`,
    description: e.available ? ENGINE_LABEL[e.id]?.description : (e.reason ?? "Not configured on this server."),
    disabled: !e.available,
  }));
  const noEngine = engines.isSuccess && !engines.data.some((e) => e.available);
  const sock = SOCKET_LABEL[conv.socket];

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[720px] px-4 py-10 sm:px-6 sm:py-14 lg:px-10">
      <PageHeader
        title="Conversation"
        description="Turn-based conversation — speak, pause, and your voice replies."
      />

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
        <div className="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <p className="eyebrow">Voice</p>
            <VoiceSelector />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            <Select<string>
              label="Response engine"
              value={engine}
              onValueChange={setEngine}
              options={engineOptions.length ? engineOptions : [{ value: "mirror", label: "Mirror" }]}
              disabled={active || engines.isPending}
            />
            {engines.isError && <ErrorNote error={engines.error} />}
            {noEngine && <p className="text-micro text-ink-3">No response engine is available on this server.</p>}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface p-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <LiveLevels
                analyser={conv.state === "speaking" ? conv.outAnalyser : conv.micAnalyser}
                active={active && (conv.state === "listening" || conv.state === "speaking")}
                size={32}
              />
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                <p className="text-body font-medium text-ink" role="status" aria-live="polite">
                  {active ? STATE_LABEL[conv.state] : "Ready"}
                  {conv.state === "listening" && active && <span aria-hidden className="ml-2 inline-block size-2 rounded-full bg-accent align-middle" />}
                </p>
                <p className="text-micro text-ink-3">
                  {!active && "Press start, then speak. Pause when you are done and the reply follows."}
                  {active && conv.state === "listening" && "Speak now. A pause ends your turn."}
                  {active && conv.state === "thinking" && "Transcribing and preparing the reply."}
                  {active && conv.state === "speaking" && "Speak over it to interrupt."}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Badge tone={sock.tone} mono>
              {sock.label}
              {conv.socket === "reconnecting" && conv.reconnectAttempt > 0 ? ` (${conv.reconnectAttempt})` : ""}
            </Badge>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {!active ? (
              <Button
                variant="primary"
                size="lg"
                onClick={() => void conv.start()}
                disabled={!selected || noEngine || readyVoices.length === 0}
                leading={<Mic className="size-4" aria-hidden />}
              >
                Start
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Button variant="primary" size="lg" onClick={conv.stop} leading={<MicOff className="size-4" aria-hidden />}>
                  Stop
                </Button>
                <Button size="lg" onClick={conv.endTurn} disabled={conv.state !== "listening"}>
                  End turn
                </Button>
                <Button size="lg" variant="ghost" onClick={conv.interrupt} disabled={conv.state !== "speaking"} leading={<Square className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />}>
                  Interrupt
                </Button>
              </>
            )}
            {!selected && readyVoices.length > 0 && <span className="text-small text-ink-3">Choose a voice to begin.</span>}
          </div>

          {conv.error && <ErrorNote message={conv.error.message} code={conv.error.code} />}
        </div>

        <div ref={scrollRef} className="flex max-h-[50vh] flex-col gap-5 overflow-y-auto" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Conversation transcript">
          {conv.turns.length === 0 && !conv.live.transcript && !conv.live.response && (
            <p className="text-small text-ink-3">Your words and the replies will appear here.</p>
          )}
          {conv.turns.map((t) => (
            <TurnView key={t.id} transcript={t.transcript} response={t.response} />
          ))}
          {(conv.live.transcript || conv.live.response) && (
            <TurnView transcript={conv.live.transcript} response={conv.live.response} live />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TurnView({ transcript, response, live }: { transcript: string; response: string; live?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-3", live && "animate-in")}>
      {transcript && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <span className="eyebrow">You</span>
          <p className="text-body text-ink-2">{transcript}</p>
        </div>
      )}
      {response && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <span className="eyebrow">Your voice</span>
          <p className="text-body text-ink">{response}</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/developer/ApiKeys.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { DialogContent, DialogRoot } from "@/components/ui/Dialog";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { useApiKeys, useCreateApiKey, useRevokeApiKey } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import { formatDateTime, formatRelative } from "@/lib/format";
import { CopyButton, Panel } from "./panels";

export function ApiKeys() {
  const q = useApiKeys();
  const create = useCreateApiKey();
  const revoke = useRevokeApiKey();
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [secret, setSecret] = useState<{ name: string; secret: string } | null>(null);
  const [revokeId, setRevokeId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const active = (q.data ?? []).filter((k) => !k.revoked_at);
  const revoked = (q.data ?? []).filter((k) => k.revoked_at);

  return (
    <Panel title="API keys" meta={`Authorization: Bearer pv_live_…`}>
      <form
        className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2"
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          const n = name.trim();
          if (!n) return;
          create.mutate(n, {
            onSuccess: (res) => {
              setSecret({ name: res.api_key.name, secret: res.secret });
              setName("");
            },
          });
        }}
      >
        <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
          <Input label="New key name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. laptop script" maxLength={60} mono />
        </div>
        <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={!name.trim()} loading={create.isPending}>
          Create key
        </Button>
      </form>
      {create.isError && <ErrorNote error={create.error} />}

      {secret && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-md border border-border-strong bg-surface p-4" role="status">
          <p className="text-small text-ink">
            Key <span className="font-medium">{secret.name}</span> created. Copy it now — it is shown only once.
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <code className="flex-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-sm bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-small text-ink">{secret.secret}</code>
            <CopyButton text={secret.secret} label="Copy secret" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setSecret(null)}>
              Done
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {q.isPending && <Skeleton className="h-16 w-full" />}
      {q.isError && <ErrorNote error={q.error} />}
      {q.data && q.data.length === 0 && <p className="text-small text-ink-3">No keys yet.</p>}
      {active.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="divide-y divide-border border-y border-border font-mono text-small">
          {active.map((k) => (
            <li key={k.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 py-2.5">
              <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
                <span className="text-ink">{k.name}</span>
                <span className="text-micro text-ink-3">
                  {k.prefix}… · created {formatDateTime(k.created_at)} · last used {k.last_used_at ? formatRelative(k.last_used_at) : "never"}
                </span>
              </div>
              <Button size="sm" variant="danger" onClick={() => setRevokeId(k.id)}>
                Revoke
              </Button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {revoked.length > 0 && (
        <details className="font-mono text-small text-ink-3">
          <summary className="cursor-pointer">
            {revoked.length} revoked {revoked.length === 1 ? "key" : "keys"}
          </summary>
          <ul className="mt-2 flex flex-col gap-1">
            {revoked.map((k) => (
              <li key={k.id} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Badge tone="neutral" mono>
                  revoked
                </Badge>
                {k.name} · {k.prefix}… · {formatDateTime(k.revoked_at)}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </details>
      )}

      <DialogRoot open={Boolean(revokeId)} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setRevokeId(null)}>
        <DialogContent
          title="Revoke this key?"
          description="Requests using it will fail immediately."
          footer={
            <>
              <Button onClick={() => setRevokeId(null)}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button
                variant="danger"
                loading={revoke.isPending}
                onClick={() => revokeId && revoke.mutate(revokeId, { onSuccess: () => setRevokeId(null) })}
              >
                Revoke
              </Button>
            </>
          }
        >
          {revoke.isError && <ErrorNote error={revoke.error} />}
        </DialogContent>
      </DialogRoot>
    </Panel>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { useAudit } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import { formatDateTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { Panel } from "./panels";

export function AuditLog() {
  const q = useAudit();
  const items = q.data?.pages.flatMap((p) => p.items) ?? [];
  const total = q.data?.pages[0]?.total ?? 0;

  return (
    <Panel title="Audit" meta={total ? `${total} events` : null}>
      {q.isPending && <Skeleton className="h-24 w-full" />}
      {q.isError && <ErrorNote error={q.error} />}
      {q.isSuccess && items.length === 0 && <p className="text-small text-ink-3">No events recorded yet.</p>}
      {items.length > 0 && (
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[560px] border-collapse font-mono text-small">
            <thead>
              <tr className="text-left text-micro text-ink-3">
                <th className="pb-2 pr-4 font-medium">time</th>
                <th className="pb-2 pr-4 font-medium">action</th>
                <th className="pb-2 pr-4 font-medium">resource</th>
                <th className="pb-2 font-medium">ip</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-border border-t border-border">
              {items.map((e) => (
                <tr key={e.id}>
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap py-2 pr-4 tabular text-ink-3">{formatDateTime(e.created_at)}</td>
                  <td className="py-2 pr-4 text-ink">{e.action}</td>
                  <td className="py-2 pr-4 text-ink-2">
                    {e.resource_type ? (
                      <>
                        {e.resource_type}
                        {e.resource_id && <span className="text-ink-3"> {e.resource_id.slice(0, 8)}…</span>}
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      "—"
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2 text-ink-3">{e.ip ?? "—"}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
      {q.hasNextPage && (
        <div>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => q.fetchNextPage()} loading={q.isFetchingNextPage}>
            Load more
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </Panel>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { ExternalLink } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { CopyButton, Panel } from "./panels";

interface Example {
  title: string;
  method: string;
  path: string;
  curl: (origin: string) => string;
}

const EXAMPLES: Example[] = [
  {
    title: "List your voices",
    method: "GET",
    path: "/api/v1/voices",
    curl: (o) => `curl -s ${o}/api/v1/voices \\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PV_API_KEY"`,
  },
  {
    title: "Create a voice (multipart)",
    method: "POST",
    path: "/api/v1/voices",
    curl: (o) =>
      `curl -s ${o}/api/v1/voices \\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PV_API_KEY" \\\n  -F "file=@sample.wav" \\\n  -F "name=My voice" \\\n  -F "language_hint=auto" \\\n  -F "consent_confirmed=true" \\\n  -F "consent_text_version=v1"`,
  },
  {
    title: "Generate speech",
    method: "POST",
    path: "/api/v1/generations",
    curl: (o) =>
      `curl -s ${o}/api/v1/generations \\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PV_API_KEY" \\\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\\n  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \\\n  -d '{"voice_id":"<voice_id>","text":"Hello from my own voice.","output_format":"wav"}'`,
  },
  {
    title: "Poll a generation",
    method: "GET",
    path: "/api/v1/generations/{id}",
    curl: (o) => `curl -s ${o}/api/v1/generations/<generation_id> \\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PV_API_KEY"`,
  },
  {
    title: "Download the audio",
    method: "GET",
    path: "/api/v1/generations/{id}/audio?download=1",
    curl: (o) => `curl -s -o out.wav "${o}/api/v1/generations/<generation_id>/audio?download=1" \\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PV_API_KEY"`,
  },
];

export function Endpoints() {
  const [origin, setOrigin] = useState("https://your-host");
  useEffect(() => setOrigin(window.location.origin), []);

  return (
    <Panel
      title="Endpoints"
      meta={
        <a href="/api/docs" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-ink-2 underline-offset-4 hover:text-ink hover:underline">
          /api/docs
          <ExternalLink className="size-3" aria-hidden />
        </a>
      }
    >
      <p className="text-small text-ink-2">
        Every route lives under <code className="font-mono text-ink">/api/v1</code>. Errors come back as{" "}
        <code className="font-mono text-ink">{`{"error":{"code","message","details"}}`}</code>; lists are paginated with{" "}
        <code className="font-mono text-ink">?limit=&amp;offset=</code>.
      </p>
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {EXAMPLES.map((ex) => (
          <li key={ex.title} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <p className="flex items-baseline gap-2 font-mono text-small">
                <span className="text-micro font-medium text-ink-3">{ex.method}</span>
                <span className="text-ink">{ex.path}</span>
                <span className="text-ink-3">— {ex.title}</span>
              </p>
              <CopyButton text={ex.curl(origin)} label={`Copy curl for ${ex.title}`} />
            </div>
            <pre className="overflow-x-auto rounded-sm border border-border bg-surface-2 p-3 font-mono text-micro leading-relaxed text-ink-2">
              {ex.curl(origin)}
            </pre>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </Panel>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { Check, Copy } from "lucide-react";
import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/IconButton";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { isApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { useHardware, useHealth, useMetrics, useModels } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import { LANGUAGE_NAMES } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { formatMegabytes, formatRelative, formatRtf } from "@/lib/format";

export const DEV_POLL_MS = 5000;

export function Panel({ title, meta, children, className }: { title: string; meta?: ReactNode; children: ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <section className={cn("flex flex-col gap-4 border-t border-border py-6", className)} aria-label={title}>
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
        <h2 className="eyebrow">{title}</h2>
        {meta && <div className="font-mono text-micro text-ink-3">{meta}</div>}
      </div>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

export function KV({ rows }: { rows: [string, ReactNode][] }) {
  return (
    <dl className="grid grid-cols-[max-content_1fr] gap-x-6 gap-y-1.5 font-mono text-small">
      {rows.map(([k, v]) => (
        <div key={k} className="contents">
          <dt className="text-ink-3">{k}</dt>
          <dd className="tabular text-ink">{v}</dd>
        </div>
      ))}
    </dl>
  );
}

export function CopyButton({ text, label = "Copy" }: { text: string; label?: string }) {
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  return (
    <IconButton
      label={done ? "Copied" : label}
      size="sm"
      onClick={async () => {
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
          setDone(true);
          window.setTimeout(() => setDone(false), 1500);
        } catch {
          /* clipboard unavailable */
        }
      }}
    >
      {done ? <Check className="size-4 text-success" aria-hidden /> : <Copy className="size-4" aria-hidden />}
    </IconButton>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function ModelStatus() {
  const q = useModels({ refetchInterval: DEV_POLL_MS });
  return (
    <Panel title="Models" meta={q.dataUpdatedAt ? `updated ${formatRelative(new Date(q.dataUpdatedAt).toISOString())}` : null}>
      {q.isPending && <Skeleton className="h-24 w-full" />}
      {q.isError && <ErrorNote error={q.error} />}
      {q.data && (
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[640px] border-collapse font-mono text-small">
            <thead>
              <tr className="text-left text-micro text-ink-3">
                <th className="pb-2 pr-4 font-medium">engine</th>
                <th className="pb-2 pr-4 font-medium">status</th>
                <th className="pb-2 pr-4 font-medium">languages</th>
                <th className="pb-2 pr-4 font-medium">device</th>
                <th className="pb-2 pr-4 font-medium">rtf</th>
                <th className="pb-2 pr-4 font-medium">infer</th>
                <th className="pb-2 font-medium">licence</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-border border-t border-border">
              {q.data.map((m) => (
                <tr key={m.id} className="align-top">
                  <td className="py-2 pr-4">
                    <div className="text-ink">{m.id}</div>
                    <div className="text-micro text-ink-3">
                      {m.name} {m.version}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2 pr-4">
                    {m.available ? (
                      <Badge tone={m.loaded ? "success" : "neutral"} mono>
                        {m.loaded ? "loaded" : "available"}
                      </Badge>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                        <Badge tone="warning" mono>
                          unavailable
                        </Badge>
                        {m.unavailable_reason && <span className="max-w-56 text-micro text-ink-3">{m.unavailable_reason}</span>}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2 pr-4 text-ink-2">
                    {m.tts_languages.map((l) => LANGUAGE_NAMES[l]?.name ?? l).join(", ") || "—"}
                    {m.cross_lingual && <div className="text-micro text-ink-3">cross-lingual</div>}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2 pr-4 text-ink-2">{m.device ?? "—"}</td>
                  <td className="py-2 pr-4 tabular text-ink-2">{formatRtf(m.stats.avg_rtf)}</td>
                  <td className="py-2 pr-4 tabular text-ink-2">{m.stats.inferences}</td>
                  <td className="py-2 text-micro text-ink-3">
                    {m.licence}
                    <div>{m.weight_licence}</div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
    </Panel>
  );
}

export function HardwarePanel() {
  const q = useHardware({ refetchInterval: DEV_POLL_MS });
  const unavailable = q.isError && isApiError(q.error) && q.error.status === 503;
  return (
    <Panel title="Hardware">
      {q.isPending && <Skeleton className="h-24 w-full" />}
      {unavailable && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <p className="text-small text-ink-2">The API image does not include the engine package, so hardware details are not reported here.</p>
          <p className="font-mono text-micro text-ink-3">{isApiError(q.error) ? q.error.code : "engine_unavailable"}</p>
        </div>
      )}
      {q.isError && !unavailable && <ErrorNote error={q.error} />}
      {q.data && (
        <KV
          rows={[
            ["device", q.data.device + (q.data.cuda_available ? " (cuda available)" : "")],
            ["gpu", q.data.gpu ? `${q.data.gpu.name} · ${formatMegabytes(q.data.gpu.vram_used_mb)} / ${formatMegabytes(q.data.gpu.vram_total_mb)}` : "none"],
            ["cpu", `${q.data.cpu_cores} cores`],
            ["ram", `${formatMegabytes(q.data.ram_used_mb)} / ${formatMegabytes(q.data.ram_total_mb)}`],
            ["disk free", formatMegabytes(q.data.disk_free_mb)],
            ["torch", q.data.torch_version ?? "—"],
            ["onnxruntime", q.data.onnxruntime_version ?? "—"],
          ]}
        />
      )}
    </Panel>
  );
}

export function QueuePanel() {
  const q = useMetrics({ refetchInterval: DEV_POLL_MS });
  const health = useHealth({ refetchInterval: DEV_POLL_MS });
  return (
    <Panel
      title="Queue"
      meta={
        health.data ? (
          <span className={health.data.status === "ok" ? "text-success" : "text-warning"}>
            api {health.data.status} · v{health.data.version}
          </span>
        ) : null
      }
    >
      {q.isPending && <Skeleton className="h-24 w-full" />}
      {q.isError && <ErrorNote error={q.error} />}
      {q.data && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
          <KV
            rows={[
              ["voice queue", q.data.queues.voice],
              ["generation queue", q.data.queues.generation],
              ["voices", q.data.voices_total],
              ["24h generations", `${q.data.generations_24h.total} · ${q.data.generations_24h.completed} ok · ${q.data.generations_24h.failed} failed`],
              ["24h avg rtf", formatRtf(q.data.generations_24h.avg_rtf)],
            ]}
          />
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 border-t border-border pt-4 font-mono text-small">
            <span className="text-ink-3">workers</span>
            {q.data.workers.length === 0 && <span className="text-warning">no worker heartbeat</span>}
            {q.data.workers.map((w) => (
              <div key={w.name} className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-3">
                <span className="text-ink">{w.name}</span>
                <span className="text-ink-3">{formatRelative(w.last_heartbeat)}</span>
                <span className="text-ink-2">{w.loaded_engine ?? "idle"}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {q.data && (
        <div className="pt-1">
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => void q.refetch()} loading={q.isFetching}>
            Refresh
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </Panel>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { Download, Play, Trash2, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { AudioPlayer } from "@/components/audio/AudioPlayer";
import { Badge, type BadgeTone } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { DialogContent, DialogRoot } from "@/components/ui/Dialog";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/IconButton";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/ui/PageHeader";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { useDeleteGeneration, useGenerations } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import { generations } from "@/lib/api/resources";
import type { Generation } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { excerpt, formatDateTime, formatDuration } from "@/lib/format";
import { generationStageText } from "@/lib/stages";

const STATUS: Record<Generation["status"], { label: string; tone: BadgeTone }> = {
  queued: { label: "Queued", tone: "processing" },
  processing: { label: "Processing", tone: "processing" },
  completed: { label: "Ready", tone: "success" },
  failed: { label: "Failed", tone: "danger" },
  cancelled: { label: "Cancelled", tone: "neutral" },
};

export function HistoryList() {
  const q = useGenerations();
  const items = q.data?.pages.flatMap((p) => p.items) ?? [];
  const total = q.data?.pages[0]?.total ?? 0;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1040px] px-4 py-10 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
      <PageHeader
        title="History"
        description={total > 0 ? `${total.toLocaleString()} ${total === 1 ? "generation" : "generations"}, newest first.` : "Everything you have generated, newest first."}
      />

      {q.isPending && (
        <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-border border-y border-border" aria-busy="true">
          {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
            <li key={i} className="flex flex-col gap-2 py-4">
              <Skeleton className="h-4 w-3/4" />
              <Skeleton className="h-3 w-48" />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {q.isError && (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
          <ErrorNote error={q.error} />
          <Button onClick={() => q.refetch()}>Try again</Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {q.isSuccess && items.length === 0 && (
        <EmptyState
          title="Nothing here yet."
          description="Run your first generation and it will appear here."
          action={
            <Button variant="primary" size="lg" asChildLink href="/app">
              Go to Create
            </Button>
          }
        />
      )}

      {items.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-border border-y border-border">
          {items.map((g) => (
            <HistoryRow key={g.id} generation={g} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {q.hasNextPage && (
        <div className="flex justify-center pt-8">
          <Button onClick={() => q.fetchNextPage()} loading={q.isFetchingNextPage}>
            Load more
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function HistoryRow({ generation: g }: { generation: Generation }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(false);
  const remove = useDeleteGeneration();
  const status = STATUS[g.status];
  const active = g.status === "queued" || g.status === "processing";

  return (
    <li className="flex flex-col gap-3 py-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1.5">
          <p className="text-body text-ink">{excerpt(g.text, 160)}</p>
          <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-small text-ink-3">
            <span className="text-ink-2">{g.voice_name}</span>
            <span aria-hidden>·</span>
            <time dateTime={g.created_at}>{formatDateTime(g.created_at)}</time>
            {g.output && (
              <>
                <span aria-hidden>·</span>
                <span className="font-mono tabular">{formatDuration(g.output.duration_seconds)}</span>
              </>
            )}
            <Badge tone={status.tone} className="ml-1">
              {active ? generationStageText(g) : status.label}
            </Badge>
          </p>
          {g.status === "failed" && g.error && <ErrorNote message={g.error.message} code={g.error.code} />}
        </div>
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5">
          {g.status === "completed" && (
            <>
              <IconButton label={open ? "Hide player" : "Play"} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}>
                {open ? <X className="size-4" aria-hidden /> : <Play className="size-4" aria-hidden />}
              </IconButton>
              <IconButton label="Download" asChildAnchor href={generations.audioUrl(g.id, true)}>
                <Download className="size-4" aria-hidden />
              </IconButton>
            </>
          )}
          <IconButton label="Delete" tone="danger" onClick={() => setConfirm(true)} disabled={active}>
            <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden />
          </IconButton>
        </div>
      </div>

      {open && g.status === "completed" && (
        <AudioPlayer
          src={generations.audioUrl(g.id)}
          duration={g.output?.duration_seconds}
          downloadHref={generations.audioUrl(g.id, true)}
          autoPlay
          label={`Generated audio for ${g.voice_name}`}
          className={cn("animate-in")}
        />
      )}

      <DialogRoot open={confirm} onOpenChange={setConfirm}>
        <DialogContent
          title="Delete this generation?"
          description="The audio file is removed. This cannot be undone."
          footer={
            <>
              <Button onClick={() => setConfirm(false)}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button variant="danger" loading={remove.isPending} onClick={() => remove.mutate(g.id, { onSuccess: () => setConfirm(false) })}>
                Delete
              </Button>
            </>
          }
        >
          {remove.isError && <ErrorNote error={remove.error} />}
        </DialogContent>
      </DialogRoot>
    </li>
  );
}
```
