## frontend/src/components/intro/Introduction.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import { ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { BAR_HEIGHTS } from "@/components/brand/BrandMark";
import { useMe } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const EASE = [0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1] as const;

// Timeline (seconds) — total ≤ 2.2 s.
const T = {
  bars: 0,
  wordmark: 0.4,
  headline: 0.6,
  wave: 1.0,
  tagline: 1.5,
  cta: 1.8,
};

/** Deterministic voice-like line so server and client render the same path. */
function buildWavePath(width = 1000, height = 64, points = 240): string {
  const mid = height / 2;
  let d = `M 0 ${mid}`;
  for (let i = 1; i <= points; i++) {
    const t = i / points;
    const x = t * width;
    // Envelope: quiet → speech → quiet, with a few syllable-like swells.
    const env = Math.sin(Math.PI * t) ** 1.4 * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 23.0 + 0.7) * Math.sin(t * 7.3));
    const carrier = Math.sin(t * 160) * 0.65 + Math.sin(t * 93 + 1.3) * 0.35;
    const y = mid + carrier * env * (height / 2 - 2);
    d += ` L ${x.toFixed(2)} ${y.toFixed(2)}`;
  }
  return d;
}

const WAVE_PATH = buildWavePath();

export function Introduction() {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion() ?? false;
  const me = useMe({ redirect: false });
  const authed = me.isSuccess && Boolean(me.data);
  const ctaRef = useRef<HTMLAnchorElement>(null);

  // Keyboard users: the first Tab after the sequence lands on the primary CTA (with its ring).
  // Mouse users never see a ring appear on its own.
  useEffect(() => {
    const readyAt = performance.now() + (reduce ? 0 : (T.cta + 0.2) * 1000);
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key !== "Tab" || e.shiftKey) return;
      if (performance.now() < readyAt) return;
      if (document.activeElement !== document.body) return;
      const el = ctaRef.current;
      if (!el) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [reduce]);

  const fade = useMemo(
    () => (delay: number, rise = 0) =>
      reduce
        ? {}
        : {
            initial: { opacity: 0, y: rise },
            animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
            transition: { delay, duration: rise ? 0.48 : 0.2, ease: EASE },
          },
    [reduce],
  );

  const createHref = authed ? "/app/voices/create" : "/register";

  return (
    <main className="relative flex min-h-dvh flex-col bg-bg text-ink">
      <header className="flex h-14 items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
        <motion.div {...fade(T.wordmark)} className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <span className="text-[13px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-ink">PROJECT VOICE</span>
        </motion.div>
        <motion.div {...fade(T.cta)}>
          {me.isPending ? null : authed ? (
            <Link
              href="/app"
              className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-sm px-3 text-small font-medium text-ink-2 hover:text-ink"
            >
              Open the app
              <ArrowRight className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
            </Link>
          ) : (
            <Link href="/login" className="inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-sm px-3 text-small font-medium text-ink-2 hover:text-ink">
              Sign in
            </Link>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      </header>

      <section className="flex flex-1 flex-col justify-center px-4 pb-16 pt-8 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
        <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1040px]">
          {/* Brand mark: bars scale in from the centre, 400 ms, slight stagger. */}
          <div className="mb-10 flex h-12 items-center" aria-hidden>
            <svg width={48 * (27 / 32)} height={48} viewBox="0 0 27 32" className="overflow-visible">
              {BAR_HEIGHTS.map((h, i) => (
                <motion.rect
                  key={i}
                  x={i * 6}
                  y={(32 - h) / 2}
                  width={3}
                  height={h}
                  rx={1.5}
                  style={{ originY: "16px", originX: `${i * 6 + 1.5}px` }}
                  className={i === 2 ? "fill-accent" : "fill-ink"}
                  initial={reduce ? false : { scaleY: 0 }}
                  animate={{ scaleY: 1 }}
                  transition={reduce ? { duration: 0 } : { delay: T.bars + i * 0.04, duration: 0.4, ease: EASE }}
                />
              ))}
            </svg>
          </div>

          <motion.h1
            {...fade(T.headline, 12)}
            className="display text-ink text-[56px] leading-[1.02] sm:text-[64px] lg:text-[80px]"
          >
            YOUR VOICE.
            <br />
            YOUR <em className="italic">WORDS.</em>
          </motion.h1>

          {/* Thin waveform line draws across the width. */}
          <div className="my-10 h-12 w-full sm:my-12" aria-hidden>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 1000 64" preserveAspectRatio="none" className="h-full w-full overflow-visible">
              <motion.path
                d={WAVE_PATH}
                fill="none"
                className="stroke-ink-3"
                strokeWidth={1}
                vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                initial={reduce ? false : { pathLength: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ pathLength: 1, opacity: 1 }}
                transition={reduce ? { duration: 0 } : { delay: T.wave, duration: 0.6, ease: EASE }}
              />
            </svg>
          </div>

          <motion.p {...fade(T.tagline)} className="max-w-xl text-h3 text-ink-2">
            Create your personal voice once. Use it whenever you need.
          </motion.p>

          <motion.div {...fade(T.cta)} className="mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <Link
              ref={ctaRef}
              href={createHref}
              className={cn(
                "inline-flex h-12 items-center gap-2 rounded-sm bg-ink px-6 text-button font-medium text-ink-inverse",
                "transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv hover:bg-ink-2",
              )}
            >
              Create your voice
            </Link>
            <Link
              href="/app/voices"
              className="inline-flex h-12 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-sm px-4 text-button font-medium text-ink-2 transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv hover:text-ink"
            >
              Explore my voices
              <ArrowRight className="size-4" aria-hidden />
            </Link>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <footer className="flex h-12 items-center px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
        <motion.p {...fade(T.cta)} className="font-mono text-micro text-ink-3">
          Your voice. Your words.
        </motion.p>
      </footer>
    </main>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/navigation/AccountMenu.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import * as Dropdown from "@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu";
import { ChevronDown, Code2, LogOut, MessageSquare, Settings, SlidersHorizontal } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useLogout, useUpdateMe } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import type { Mode, User } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { useAppStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

const itemClass =
  "flex h-9 cursor-pointer select-none items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xs px-2.5 text-small text-ink outline-none " +
  "data-[highlighted]:bg-surface-2 data-[disabled]:opacity-50";

export function AccountMenu({ user }: { user: User }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const logout = useLogout();
  const updateMe = useUpdateMe();
  const mode = useAppStore((s) => s.mode);
  const setMode = useAppStore((s) => s.setMode);

  const initials = (user.display_name || user.email).trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  const changeMode = (next: Mode) => {
    if (next === mode) return;
    setMode(next);
    updateMe.mutate({ preferences: { mode: next } });
    router.push(next === "advanced" ? "/app/advanced" : "/app");
  };

  const signOut = () => {
    logout.mutate(undefined, {
      onSettled: () => {
        useAppStore.getState().setSelectedVoiceId(null);
        window.location.assign("/");
      },
    });
  };

  return (
    <Dropdown.Root modal={false}>
      <Dropdown.Trigger
        aria-label="Account menu"
        className={cn(
          "inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-sm pl-1 pr-2 text-small text-ink-2 transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv",
          "hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-ink data-[state=open]:bg-surface-2 data-[state=open]:text-ink",
        )}
      >
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className="flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border bg-surface text-micro font-medium text-ink"
        >
          {initials}
        </span>
        <span className="hidden max-w-32 truncate sm:inline">{user.display_name}</span>
        <ChevronDown className="size-3.5 text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
      </Dropdown.Trigger>
      <Dropdown.Portal>
        <Dropdown.Content
          align="end"
          sideOffset={6}
          className="z-50 w-60 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface p-1 shadow-md outline-none data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out"
        >
          <div className="px-2.5 py-2">
            <p className="truncate text-small font-medium text-ink">{user.display_name}</p>
            <p className="truncate font-mono text-micro text-ink-3">{user.email}</p>
          </div>
          <Dropdown.Separator className="my-1 h-px bg-border" />
          <Dropdown.Label className="eyebrow px-2.5 pb-1 pt-2">Mode</Dropdown.Label>
          <Dropdown.RadioGroup value={mode} onValueChange={(v) => changeMode(v as Mode)}>
            <Dropdown.RadioItem value="simple" className={itemClass}>
              <Dot active={mode === "simple"} />
              Simple
            </Dropdown.RadioItem>
            <Dropdown.RadioItem value="advanced" className={itemClass}>
              <Dot active={mode === "advanced"} />
              Advanced
            </Dropdown.RadioItem>
          </Dropdown.RadioGroup>
          <Dropdown.Separator className="my-1 h-px bg-border" />
          <Dropdown.Item className={itemClass} onSelect={() => router.push("/app/advanced")}>
            <SlidersHorizontal className="size-4 text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
            Advanced controls
          </Dropdown.Item>
          <Dropdown.Item className={itemClass} onSelect={() => router.push("/app/conversation")}>
            <MessageSquare className="size-4 text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
            Conversation
          </Dropdown.Item>
          <Dropdown.Item className={itemClass} onSelect={() => router.push("/app/developer")}>
            <Code2 className="size-4 text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
            Developer
          </Dropdown.Item>
          <Dropdown.Item className={itemClass} onSelect={() => router.push("/app/settings")}>
            <Settings className="size-4 text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
            Settings
          </Dropdown.Item>
          <Dropdown.Separator className="my-1 h-px bg-border" />
          <Dropdown.Item className={itemClass} onSelect={signOut} disabled={logout.isPending}>
            <LogOut className="size-4 text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
            Sign out
          </Dropdown.Item>
        </Dropdown.Content>
      </Dropdown.Portal>
    </Dropdown.Root>
  );
}

function Dot({ active }: { active: boolean }) {
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden
      className={cn("size-1.5 rounded-full", active ? "bg-accent" : "border border-border-strong")}
    />
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/navigation/AppShell.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Wordmark } from "@/components/brand/Wordmark";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { useMe } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import { isApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { applyTheme } from "@/lib/theme";
import { useAppStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { MobileTabs } from "./MobileTabs";
import { TopBar } from "./TopBar";

/**
 * Guards every `/app/**` route behind `GET /users/me`, applies the user's theme and mode
 * preferences, and lays out the top bar / bottom tabs.
 */
export function AppShell({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const me = useMe();
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const setMode = useAppStore((s) => s.setMode);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!me.data) return;
    applyTheme(me.data.preferences.theme);
    setMode(me.data.preferences.mode);
  }, [me.data, setMode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (me.isError && isApiError(me.error) && me.error.status === 401) {
      router.replace(`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(pathname)}`);
    }
  }, [me.isError, me.error, pathname, router]);

  if (me.isPending) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-dvh bg-bg">
        <header className="h-14 border-b border-border">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-full max-w-[1200px] items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
            <Wordmark href={null} />
            <Skeleton className="h-7 w-7 rounded-full" />
          </div>
        </header>
        <main className="mx-auto max-w-[720px] px-4 py-12 sm:px-6 lg:px-10" aria-busy="true" aria-live="polite">
          <Skeleton className="h-3 w-24" />
          <Skeleton className="mt-4 h-10 w-64" />
          <Skeleton className="mt-8 h-32 w-full" />
          <span className="sr-only">Loading your account</span>
        </main>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (me.isError) {
    const unauthenticated = isApiError(me.error) && me.error.status === 401;
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-dvh flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 px-4 text-center">
        <Wordmark href="/" />
        {unauthenticated ? (
          <p className="text-body text-ink-2">Redirecting you to sign in…</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <p className="text-body text-ink-2">We could not reach the server.</p>
            <ErrorNote error={me.error} className="items-center" />
            <Button onClick={() => me.refetch()}>Try again</Button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-dvh flex-col bg-bg">
      <TopBar user={me.data} />
      <main className="flex-1 pb-20 nav:pb-0">{children}</main>
      <MobileTabs />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/navigation/MobileTabs.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { Clock, Mic, PenLine, Settings } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { useNavItems } from "./TopBar";

const ICONS = [PenLine, Mic, Clock, Settings];

/** Bottom tab bar shown under 720px (DESIGN.md §3). */
export function MobileTabs() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const items = useNavItems();
  return (
    <nav
      aria-label="Primary"
      className="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-30 border-t border-border bg-bg pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)] nav:hidden"
    >
      <ul className="grid h-14 grid-cols-4">
        {items.map((item, i) => {
          const Icon = ICONS[i] ?? PenLine;
          const active = item.match ? item.match(pathname) : pathname === item.href;
          return (
            <li key={item.label} className="flex">
              <Link
                href={item.href}
                aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
                className={cn(
                  "flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv",
                  active ? "text-ink" : "text-ink-3",
                )}
              >
                <Icon className="size-[18px]" aria-hidden strokeWidth={active ? 2 : 1.75} />
                {item.label}
              </Link>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/navigation/TopBar.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { Wordmark } from "@/components/brand/Wordmark";
import { useAppStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { AccountMenu } from "./AccountMenu";
import type { User } from "@/lib/api/types";

export interface NavItem {
  label: string;
  href: string;
  /** Additional pathnames that should highlight this item. */
  match?: (pathname: string) => boolean;
}

export function useNavItems(): NavItem[] {
  const mode = useAppStore((s) => s.mode);
  const createHref = mode === "advanced" ? "/app/advanced" : "/app";
  return [
    { label: "Create", href: createHref, match: (p) => p === "/app" || p === "/app/advanced" },
    { label: "My Voices", href: "/app/voices", match: (p) => p.startsWith("/app/voices") },
    { label: "History", href: "/app/history", match: (p) => p.startsWith("/app/history") },
    { label: "Settings", href: "/app/settings", match: (p) => p.startsWith("/app/settings") },
  ];
}

export function TopBar({ user }: { user: User }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const items = useNavItems();
  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 h-14 border-b border-border bg-bg/95 backdrop-blur-[2px]">
      <div className="mx-auto flex h-full max-w-[1200px] items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
        <Wordmark href="/app" />
        <nav aria-label="Primary" className="hidden h-full items-center gap-6 nav:flex">
          {items.map((item) => {
            const active = item.match ? item.match(pathname) : pathname === item.href;
            return (
              <Link
                key={item.label}
                href={item.href}
                aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
                className={cn(
                  "relative flex h-14 items-center text-small font-medium transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv",
                  active ? "text-ink" : "text-ink-3 hover:text-ink",
                )}
              >
                {item.label}
                {active && <span aria-hidden className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-px bg-ink" />}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </nav>
        <AccountMenu user={user} />
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { DialogContent, DialogRoot } from "@/components/ui/Dialog";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/ui/PageHeader";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/Slider";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { useLanguageOptions } from "@/components/voice/VoiceNameField";
import { useDeleteMe, useLogout, useMe, useUpdateMe } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import type { Mode, OutputFormat, Theme, User, UserPreferences } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { useAppStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { applyTheme } from "@/lib/theme";

export function SettingsPanel() {
  const me = useMe();
  if (!me.data) return null;
  return <SettingsForm user={me.data} />;
}

function Section({ title, description, children }: { title: string; description?: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="grid gap-6 border-t border-border py-8 md:grid-cols-[220px_1fr]">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <h2 className="text-h3 font-medium text-ink">{title}</h2>
        {description && <p className="text-small text-ink-3">{description}</p>}
      </div>
      <div className="flex max-w-md flex-col gap-5">{children}</div>
    </section>
  );
}

function SettingsForm({ user }: { user: User }) {
  const update = useUpdateMe();
  const logout = useLogout();
  const remove = useDeleteMe();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const setMode = useAppStore((s) => s.setMode);
  const { options: languageOptions } = useLanguageOptions();

  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState(user.display_name);
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState(user.preferences.speed);
  const [deleteOpen, setDeleteOpen] = useState(false);
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => setDisplayName(user.display_name), [user.display_name]);
  useEffect(() => setSpeed(user.preferences.speed), [user.preferences.speed]);

  const savePrefs = (patch: Partial<UserPreferences>) => {
    update.mutate(
      { preferences: patch },
      {
        onError: (e) => toast({ title: "Could not save", description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined, tone: "danger" }),
      },
    );
  };

  const saveName = () => {
    const next = displayName.trim();
    if (!next || next === user.display_name) return;
    update.mutate({ display_name: next }, { onSuccess: () => toast({ title: "Name updated" }) });
  };

  const signOut = () => {
    logout.mutate(undefined, {
      onSettled: () => {
        useAppStore.getState().setSelectedVoiceId(null);
        window.location.assign("/");
      },
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1040px] px-4 py-10 sm:px-6 lg:px-10">
      <PageHeader title="Settings" description="Your account and how the app behaves." />

      <Section title="Profile" description="How we address you.">
        <form
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            saveName();
          }}
          className="flex flex-col gap-4"
        >
          <Input label="Display name" value={displayName} onChange={(e) => setDisplayName(e.target.value)} maxLength={60} />
          <Input label="Email" value={user.email} readOnly disabled mono hint="Email cannot be changed here." />
          <div>
            <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={!displayName.trim() || displayName.trim() === user.display_name} loading={update.isPending && update.variables?.display_name != null}>
              Save name
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Section>

      <Section title="Preferences" description="Defaults for every generation. Saved as you change them.">
        <Select
          label="Default language"
          value={user.preferences.default_language}
          onValueChange={(v) => savePrefs({ default_language: v })}
          options={languageOptions}
        />
        <Select<OutputFormat>
          label="Output format"
          value={user.preferences.output_format}
          onValueChange={(v) => savePrefs({ output_format: v })}
          options={[
            { value: "wav", label: "WAV", description: "Lossless, largest files." },
            { value: "flac", label: "FLAC", description: "Lossless, compressed." },
            { value: "mp3", label: "MP3", description: "Smallest, lossy." },
          ]}
        />
        <Slider
          label="Speed"
          min={0.5}
          max={2}
          step={0.05}
          value={speed}
          onValueChange={setSpeed}
          format={(v) => `${v.toFixed(2)}×`}
        />
        {Math.abs(speed - user.preferences.speed) > 0.001 && (
          <div className="-mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => savePrefs({ speed: Number(speed.toFixed(2)) })} loading={update.isPending && update.variables?.preferences?.speed != null}>
              Save speed
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setSpeed(user.preferences.speed)}>
              Reset
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
        <Select<Theme>
          label="Theme"
          value={user.preferences.theme}
          onValueChange={(v) => {
            applyTheme(v);
            savePrefs({ theme: v });
          }}
          options={[
            { value: "system", label: "System" },
            { value: "light", label: "Light" },
            { value: "dark", label: "Dark" },
          ]}
        />
        <Select<Mode>
          label="Composer mode"
          value={user.preferences.mode}
          onValueChange={(v) => {
            setMode(v);
            savePrefs({ mode: v });
          }}
          options={[
            { value: "simple", label: "Simple", description: "Choose a voice, write, run." },
            { value: "advanced", label: "Advanced", description: "Language, speed, format, quality and engine controls." },
          ]}
        />
        {update.isError && <ErrorNote error={update.error} />}
      </Section>

      <Section title="Session">
        <div>
          <Button onClick={signOut} loading={logout.isPending}>
            Sign out
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Section>

      <Section title="Danger zone" description="Deleting your account removes your voices, generations and files. This cannot be undone.">
        <div>
          <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => setDeleteOpen(true)}>
            Delete account
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Section>

      <DialogRoot open={deleteOpen} onOpenChange={setDeleteOpen}>
        <DialogContent
          title="Delete your account?"
          description="Every voice, generation and file is removed permanently. Enter your password to confirm."
          footer={
            <>
              <Button onClick={() => setDeleteOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button
                variant="danger"
                disabled={!password}
                loading={remove.isPending}
                onClick={() =>
                  remove.mutate(password, {
                    onSuccess: () => {
                      useAppStore.getState().setSelectedVoiceId(null);
                      window.location.assign("/");
                    },
                  })
                }
              >
                Delete everything
              </Button>
            </>
          }
        >
          <form
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              if (password) remove.mutate(password);
            }}
            className="flex flex-col gap-3"
          >
            <Input label="Password" type="password" autoComplete="current-password" value={password} onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
            {remove.isError && <ErrorNote error={remove.error} />}
          </form>
        </DialogContent>
      </DialogRoot>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export type BadgeTone = "neutral" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "accent" | "processing";

const tones: Record<BadgeTone, string> = {
  neutral: "text-ink-2 border-border",
  success: "text-success border-border",
  warning: "text-warning border-border",
  danger: "text-danger border-border",
  accent: "text-accent border-border",
  processing: "text-ink-2 border-border",
};

const dots: Record<BadgeTone, string> = {
  neutral: "bg-ink-3",
  success: "bg-success",
  warning: "bg-warning",
  danger: "bg-danger",
  accent: "bg-accent",
  processing: "bg-ink-3 animate-pulse",
};

export function Badge({
  tone = "neutral",
  children,
  dot = true,
  className,
  mono,
}: {
  tone?: BadgeTone;
  children: ReactNode;
  dot?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  mono?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex h-6 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xs border px-2 text-micro font-medium tracking-[0.01em]",
        mono && "font-mono",
        tones[tone],
        className,
      )}
    >
      {dot && <span className={cn("size-1.5 rounded-full", dots[tone])} aria-hidden />}
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/ui/Button.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { forwardRef, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export type ButtonVariant = "primary" | "accent" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger";
export type ButtonSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg";

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  loading?: boolean;
  leading?: ReactNode;
  trailing?: ReactNode;
  block?: boolean;
  /** Render as a Next.js link with button styling. */
  asChildLink?: boolean;
  href?: string;
}

const base =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-sm font-medium text-button whitespace-nowrap select-none " +
  "transition-[background-color,color,border-color,box-shadow,transform] duration-fast ease-pv " +
  "disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none";

const variants: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
  primary: "bg-ink text-ink-inverse hover:bg-ink-2 active:translate-y-px",
  accent: "bg-accent text-on-accent hover:bg-accent-hover active:translate-y-px active:shadow-sm",
  secondary: "bg-surface text-ink border border-border hover:border-border-strong hover:bg-surface-2 active:translate-y-px",
  ghost: "bg-transparent text-ink-2 hover:text-ink hover:bg-surface-2",
  danger: "bg-transparent text-danger border border-border hover:border-danger hover:bg-surface-2",
};

const sizes: Record<ButtonSize, string> = {
  sm: "h-8 px-3 text-small",
  md: "h-10 px-4",
  lg: "h-12 px-6",
};

export const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(function Button(
  {
    variant = "secondary",
    size = "md",
    loading = false,
    leading,
    trailing,
    block,
    className,
    children,
    disabled,
    type = "button",
    asChildLink,
    href,
    ...rest
  },
  ref,
) {
  const cls = cn(base, variants[variant], sizes[size], block && "w-full", className);
  if (asChildLink && href) {
    return (
      <Link href={href} className={cls}>
        {leading}
        {children}
        {trailing}
      </Link>
    );
  }
  return (
    <button ref={ref} type={type} className={cls} disabled={disabled || loading} aria-busy={loading || undefined} {...rest}>
      {loading ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden /> : leading}
      {children}
      {!loading && trailing}
    </button>
  );
});
```

```tsx
import { errorCode, errorMessage } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

/** Human message first, error code in small mono underneath. */
export function ErrorNote({
  error,
  message,
  code,
  className,
}: {
  error?: unknown;
  message?: string;
  code?: string | null;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const msg = message ?? (error ? errorMessage(error) : "");
  const c = code ?? (error ? errorCode(error) : null);
  if (!msg) return null;
  return (
    <div role="alert" className={cn("flex flex-col gap-1 text-small text-danger", className)}>
      <p>{msg}</p>
      {c && <p className="font-mono text-micro text-ink-3">{c}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { forwardRef, type AnchorHTMLAttributes, type ButtonHTMLAttributes } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

type CommonProps = {
  label: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md";
  tone?: "default" | "danger";
};

export type IconButtonProps = CommonProps &
  ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
    /** Render as a link (e.g. a download). */
    asChildAnchor?: boolean;
    href?: string;
    download?: string | boolean;
    target?: AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>["target"];
    rel?: string;
  };

function classes(size: "sm" | "md", tone: "default" | "danger", className?: string) {
  return cn(
    "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv",
    "disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none",
    size === "md" ? "size-10" : "size-8",
    tone === "danger" ? "text-ink-2 hover:text-danger hover:bg-surface-2" : "text-ink-2 hover:text-ink hover:bg-surface-2",
    className,
  );
}

/** 40px square (minimum touch target) icon-only button with an accessible name. */
export const IconButton = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, IconButtonProps>(function IconButton(
  { label, size = "md", tone = "default", className, type = "button", children, asChildAnchor, href, download, target, rel, ...rest },
  ref,
) {
  if (asChildAnchor && href) {
    return (
      <a
        href={href}
        download={download}
        target={target}
        rel={rel}
        aria-label={label}
        title={label}
        className={classes(size, tone, className)}
      >
        {children}
      </a>
    );
  }
  return (
    <button ref={ref} type={type} aria-label={label} title={label} className={classes(size, tone, className)} {...rest}>
      {children}
    </button>
  );
});
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { forwardRef, useId, type InputHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export interface InputProps extends InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> {
  label?: ReactNode;
  hint?: ReactNode;
  error?: ReactNode;
  mono?: boolean;
}

export const inputClass =
  "h-10 w-full rounded-sm border border-border bg-surface px-3 text-body text-ink placeholder:text-ink-3 " +
  "transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv hover:border-border-strong focus:border-border-strong " +
  "disabled:opacity-50 aria-[invalid=true]:border-danger";

export const Input = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, InputProps>(function Input(
  { label, hint, error, mono, className, id: idProp, ...rest },
  ref,
) {
  const autoId = useId();
  const id = idProp ?? autoId;
  const hintId = `${id}-hint`;
  const errorId = `${id}-error`;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
      {label && (
        <label htmlFor={id} className="text-small font-medium text-ink-2">
          {label}
        </label>
      )}
      <input
        ref={ref}
        id={id}
        aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
        aria-describedby={cn(hint && hintId, error && errorId) || undefined}
        className={cn(inputClass, mono && "font-mono text-small", className)}
        {...rest}
      />
      {error ? (
        <p id={errorId} className="text-small text-danger" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : hint ? (
        <p id={hintId} className="text-small text-ink-3">
          {hint}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
});
```

```tsx
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

/** 1px progress bar. `fraction` null → indeterminate sweep (status is still real, only the width is unknown). */
export function ProgressBar({ fraction, className, label }: { fraction: number | null; className?: string; label?: string }) {
  const pct = fraction == null ? null : Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, fraction)) * 100);
  return (
    <div
      className={cn("pv-progress w-full", className)}
      role="progressbar"
      aria-label={label}
      aria-valuemin={0}
      aria-valuemax={100}
      aria-valuenow={pct ?? undefined}
      data-indeterminate={pct == null ? "true" : undefined}
    >
      <span style={pct == null ? undefined : { width: `${pct}%` }} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
}

export function Select<T extends string>({
  value,
  onValueChange,
  options,

  disabled,
  className,

  ariaLabel,
}: {
  value: T | undefined;
  onValueChange: (v: T) => void;
  options: SelectOption<T>[];
  label?: ReactNode;
  placeholder?: string;

  className?: string;

}) {

                    "data-[highlighted]:bg-surface-2 data-[disabled]:cursor-not-allowed data-[disabled]:opacity-50",
```

## frontend/src/components/ui/Toast.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import * as RadixToast from "@radix-ui/react-toast";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

interface ToastItem {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  tone?: "neutral" | "danger" | "success";
}

interface ToastApi {
  toast: (t: Omit<ToastItem, "id">) => void;
}

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastApi>({ toast: () => undefined });

export function useToast() {
  return useContext(ToastContext);
}

export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<ToastItem[]>([]);
  const toast = useCallback((t: Omit<ToastItem, "id">) => {
    setItems((prev) => [...prev.slice(-3), { ...t, id: Date.now() + Math.random() }]);
  }, []);
  const api = useMemo(() => ({ toast }), [toast]);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={api}>
      <RadixToast.Provider swipeDirection="right" duration={4500}>
        {children}
        {items.map((t) => (
          <RadixToast.Root
            key={t.id}
            onOpenChange={(open) => {
              if (!open) setItems((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i.id !== t.id));
            }}
            className={cn(
              "flex items-start gap-3 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface p-3 pr-2 shadow-md",
              "data-[state=closed]:animate-out",
            )}
          >
            <span
              aria-hidden
              className={cn(
                "mt-1.5 size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full",
                t.tone === "danger" ? "bg-danger" : t.tone === "success" ? "bg-success" : "bg-ink-3",
              )}
            />
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-0.5">
              <RadixToast.Title className="text-small font-medium text-ink">{t.title}</RadixToast.Title>
              {t.description && (
                <RadixToast.Description className="text-small text-ink-2">{t.description}</RadixToast.Description>
              )}
            </div>
            <RadixToast.Close
              aria-label="Dismiss"
              className="inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-sm text-ink-3 hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-ink"
            >
              <X className="size-4" aria-hidden />
            </RadixToast.Close>
          </RadixToast.Root>
        ))}
        <RadixToast.Viewport className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-[60] flex w-[calc(100vw-32px)] max-w-sm flex-col gap-2 outline-none max-[720px]:bottom-20" />
      </RadixToast.Provider>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/voice/AudioUploader.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { FileAudio, Upload, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type DragEvent } from "react";
import { AudioPlayer } from "@/components/audio/AudioPlayer";
import { Waveform } from "@/components/audio/Waveform";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { MAX_REFERENCE_SECONDS, MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES, MIN_REFERENCE_SECONDS } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { ACCEPT_ATTR, ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS, decodeAudio, isAcceptedExtension } from "@/lib/audio";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { formatBytes, formatDuration } from "@/lib/format";
import type { CapturedAudio } from "./VoiceRecorder";

interface Picked {
  file: File;
  url: string;
  duration: number | null;
  peaks: Float32Array | null;
  decodeFailed: boolean;
}

export function validateFile(file: File): { code: string; message: string } | null {
  if (!isAcceptedExtension(file.name)) {
    return {
      code: "unsupported_format",
      message: `That file type is not supported. Use ${ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS.map((e) => e.toUpperCase()).join(", ")}.`,
    };
  }
  if (file.size > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES) {
    return { code: "file_too_large", message: `That file is ${formatBytes(file.size)}. The limit is ${formatBytes(MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES)}.` };
  }
  if (file.size === 0) {
    return { code: "file_empty", message: "That file is empty." };
  }
  return null;
}

export function validateDuration(duration: number): { code: string; message: string } | null {
  if (duration < MIN_REFERENCE_SECONDS) {
    return { code: "reference_too_short", message: `That recording is ${formatDuration(duration)}. It needs to be at least ${MIN_REFERENCE_SECONDS} seconds.` };
  }
  if (duration > MAX_REFERENCE_SECONDS) {
    return {
      code: "reference_too_long",
      message: `That recording is ${formatDuration(duration)}. Keep it under ${formatDuration(MAX_REFERENCE_SECONDS)} — 10 to 30 seconds is ideal.`,
    };
  }
  return null;
}

export function AudioUploader({ onCaptured, className }: { onCaptured: (audio: CapturedAudio | null) => void; className?: string }) {
  const inputId = useId();
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<Picked | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<{ code: string; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const [decoding, setDecoding] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (picked) URL.revokeObjectURL(picked.url);
    };
  }, [picked]);

  const clear = useCallback(() => {
    setPicked(null);
    setError(null);
    onCaptured(null);
    if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = "";
  }, [onCaptured]);

  const handleFile = useCallback(
    async (file: File) => {
      setError(null);
      const invalid = validateFile(file);
      if (invalid) {
        setPicked(null);
        setError(invalid);
        onCaptured(null);
        return;
      }
      setDecoding(true);
      let duration: number | null = null;
      let peaks: Float32Array | null = null;
      let decodeFailed = false;
      try {
        const info = await decodeAudio(file);
        duration = Number.isFinite(info.duration) ? info.duration : null;
        peaks = info.peaks;
      } catch {
        decodeFailed = true;
      }
      setDecoding(false);
      if (duration != null) {
        const bad = validateDuration(duration);
        if (bad) {
          setPicked(null);
          setError(bad);
          onCaptured(null);
          return;
        }
      }
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      setPicked({ file, url, duration, peaks, decodeFailed });
      onCaptured({ blob: file, fileName: file.name, duration, peaks, source: "upload" });
    },
    [onCaptured],
  );

  const onDrop = (e: DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragging(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
    if (file) void handleFile(file);
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-6", className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <h2 className="display text-h2 text-ink">Upload a recording.</h2>
        <p className="text-body text-ink-2">
          Clear speech from one person, {MIN_REFERENCE_SECONDS} seconds to {formatDuration(MAX_REFERENCE_SECONDS)} long. WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG or WebM, up to{" "}
          {formatBytes(MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES)}.
        </p>
      </div>

      {!picked ? (
        <div
          onDragOver={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            setDragging(true);
          }}
          onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)}
          onDrop={onDrop}
          className={cn(
            "flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 rounded-md border border-dashed bg-surface px-6 py-12 text-center transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv",
            dragging ? "border-ink bg-surface-2" : "border-border-strong",
          )}
        >
          <Upload className="size-6 text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
          <p className="text-body text-ink-2">Drag a file here, or</p>
          <label
            htmlFor={inputId}
            className="inline-flex h-10 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-sm border border-border bg-surface px-4 text-button font-medium text-ink transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv hover:border-border-strong hover:bg-surface-2 focus-within:outline focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-accent"
          >
            {decoding ? "Reading file…" : "Choose a file"}
            <input
              ref={inputRef}
              id={inputId}
              type="file"
              accept={ACCEPT_ATTR}
              className="sr-only"
              disabled={decoding}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const f = e.target.files?.[0];
                if (f) void handleFile(f);
              }}
            />
          </label>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface p-4">
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
              <FileAudio className="size-5 shrink-0 text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="truncate text-body font-medium text-ink">{picked.file.name}</p>
                <p className="font-mono text-micro tabular text-ink-3">
                  {formatBytes(picked.file.size)}
                  {picked.duration != null ? ` · ${formatDuration(picked.duration)}` : ""}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={clear} leading={<X className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />}>
              Remove
            </Button>
          </div>
          {picked.peaks && <Waveform peaks={picked.peaks} height={40} />}
          {picked.decodeFailed && (
            <p className="text-small text-ink-2">
              This browser could not decode the file to check its length. The server will verify it after upload.
            </p>
          )}
          <AudioPlayer src={picked.url} duration={picked.duration} label="Uploaded recording" />
        </div>
      )}

      {error && <ErrorNote message={error.message} code={error.code} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import * as Checkbox from "@radix-ui/react-checkbox";
import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import { useId } from "react";
import { CONSENT_TEXT } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export function ConsentCheckbox({
  checked,
  onCheckedChange,
  error,
  className,
}: {
  checked: boolean;
  onCheckedChange: (v: boolean) => void;
  error?: string | null;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  const errorId = `${id}-error`;
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-2", className)}>
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
        <Checkbox.Root
          id={id}
          checked={checked}
          onCheckedChange={(v) => onCheckedChange(v === true)}
          required
          aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby={error ? errorId : undefined}
          className={cn(
            "mt-0.5 flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xs border bg-surface transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv",
            checked ? "border-ink bg-ink text-ink-inverse" : "border-border-strong hover:border-ink",
            error && !checked && "border-danger",
          )}
        >
          <Checkbox.Indicator>
            <Check className="size-3.5" aria-hidden strokeWidth={3} />
          </Checkbox.Indicator>
        </Checkbox.Root>
        <label htmlFor={id} className="cursor-pointer text-body leading-snug text-ink">
          {CONSENT_TEXT}
        </label>
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p id={errorId} role="alert" className="pl-8 text-small text-danger">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/voice/CreateVoiceWizard.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { ArrowLeft, Check, Mic, Upload } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { ProgressBar } from "@/components/ui/ProgressBar";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Textarea";
import { useCreateVoice, useJob, useUpdateVoice, useVoice } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import type { UploadProgress } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { CONSENT_TEXT_VERSION, type LanguageHint, type Voice } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { useAppStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { formatBytes } from "@/lib/format";
import { VOICE_STAGE_LABELS, jobStageText } from "@/lib/stages";
import { AudioUploader } from "./AudioUploader";
import { ConsentCheckbox } from "./ConsentCheckbox";
import { VoiceNameField } from "./VoiceNameField";
import { VoiceRecorder, type CapturedAudio } from "./VoiceRecorder";

type Step = "source" | "capture" | "details" | "uploading" | "processing" | "done";
type Source = "record" | "upload";

const STEP_INDEX: Record<Step, number> = { source: 1, capture: 2, details: 3, uploading: 4, processing: 4, done: 5 };

export function CreateVoiceWizard() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const setSelected = useAppStore((s) => s.setSelectedVoiceId);
  const create = useCreateVoice();

  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>("source");
  const [source, setSource] = useState<Source | null>(null);
  const [audio, setAudio] = useState<CapturedAudio | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [language, setLanguage] = useState<LanguageHint>("auto");
  const [consent, setConsent] = useState(false);
  const [showErrors, setShowErrors] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<UploadProgress | null>(null);
  const [voiceId, setVoiceId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const onCaptured = useCallback((a: CapturedAudio | null) => setAudio(a), []);

  const nameError = showErrors && !name.trim() ? "Give the voice a name." : null;
  const consentError = showErrors && !consent ? "You need to confirm this before we can continue." : null;
  const canSubmit = Boolean(audio) && name.trim().length > 0 && consent;

  const submit = () => {
    setShowErrors(true);
    if (!audio || !name.trim() || !consent) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;
    setStep("uploading");
    setProgress(null);
    create.mutate(
      {
        input: {
          file: audio.blob,
          fileName: audio.fileName,
          name: name.trim(),
          language_hint: language,
          consent_confirmed: true,
          consent_text_version: CONSENT_TEXT_VERSION,
        },
        onProgress: setProgress,
        signal: controller.signal,
      },
      {
        onSuccess: (voice) => {
          setVoiceId(voice.id);
          setStep("processing");
        },
        onError: () => setStep("details"),
      },
    );
  };

  const cancelUpload = () => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    setStep("details");
  };

  const reset = () => {
    setStep("source");
    setSource(null);
    setAudio(null);
    setName("");
    setLanguage("auto");
    setConsent(false);
    setShowErrors(false);
    setProgress(null);
    setVoiceId(null);
    create.reset();
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[720px] px-4 py-10 sm:px-6 sm:py-14 lg:px-10">
      <div className="mb-8 flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="eyebrow">
          Step {STEP_INDEX[step]} of 5
        </p>
        {step !== "source" && step !== "uploading" && step !== "processing" && step !== "done" && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setStep(step === "capture" ? "source" : "capture");
              if (step === "capture") setAudio(null);
            }}
            className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-sm px-2 text-small font-medium text-ink-2 transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-ink"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
            Back
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {step === "source" && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <h1 className="display text-h1 text-ink sm:text-display-sm">Let&apos;s create your voice.</h1>
            <p className="text-body text-ink-2">Record a sample or upload a recording.</p>
          </div>
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <ChoiceCard
              icon={<Mic className="size-5" aria-hidden />}
              title="Record my voice"
              description="Use your microphone. About 15 seconds."
              onClick={() => {
                setSource("record");
                setStep("capture");
              }}
            />
            <ChoiceCard
              icon={<Upload className="size-5" aria-hidden />}
              title="Upload audio"
              description="WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG or WebM."
              onClick={() => {
                setSource("upload");
                setStep("capture");
              }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {step === "capture" && source === "record" && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
          <VoiceRecorder onCaptured={onCaptured} />
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button variant="primary" size="lg" disabled={!audio} onClick={() => setStep("details")}>
              Continue
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {step === "capture" && source === "upload" && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
          <AudioUploader onCaptured={onCaptured} />
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button variant="primary" size="lg" disabled={!audio} onClick={() => setStep("details")}>
              Continue
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {step === "details" && (
        <form
          className="flex flex-col gap-10"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            submit();
          }}
          noValidate
        >
          <VoiceNameField name={name} onNameChange={setName} language={language} onLanguageChange={setLanguage} nameError={nameError} />
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <p className="eyebrow">Consent</p>
            <ConsentCheckbox checked={consent} onCheckedChange={setConsent} error={consentError} />
          </div>
          {create.isError && <ErrorNote error={create.error} />}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <p className="text-small text-ink-3">
              {audio ? `${audio.source === "recording" ? "Recording" : audio.fileName} · ${formatBytes(audio.blob.size)}` : "No audio selected"}
            </p>
            <Button type="submit" variant="primary" size="lg" disabled={!audio} aria-disabled={!canSubmit || undefined}>
              Create voice
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}

      {step === "uploading" && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          <h2 className="display text-h1 text-ink">Uploading…</h2>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <ProgressBar
              fraction={progress && progress.total > 0 ? progress.loaded / progress.total : null}
              label="Upload progress"
            />
            <p className="font-mono text-micro tabular text-ink-3" aria-live="polite">
              {progress ? `${formatBytes(progress.loaded)} of ${formatBytes(progress.total)}` : "Starting upload"}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div>
            <Button onClick={cancelUpload}>Cancel</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {step === "processing" && voiceId && (
        <ProcessingScreen voiceId={voiceId} onReady={() => setStep("done")} onRetry={reset} />
      )}

      {step === "done" && voiceId && (
        <ReadyScreen
          voiceId={voiceId}
          onUse={(v) => {
            setSelected(v.id);
            router.push("/app");
          }}
          onAnother={reset}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ChoiceCard({ icon, title, description, onClick }: { icon: React.ReactNode; title: string; description: string; onClick: () => void }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      className={cn(
        "flex min-h-40 flex-col items-start justify-between gap-6 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface p-5 text-left",
        "transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv hover:border-border-strong hover:bg-surface-2 active:translate-y-px",
      )}
    >
      <span className="flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-sm border border-border text-ink">{icon}</span>
      <span className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <span className="text-h3 font-medium text-ink">{title}</span>
        <span className="text-small text-ink-2">{description}</span>
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

const STAGE_SEQUENCE = ["decode", "analyse", "vad", "trim", "transcribe", "validate", "fingerprint", "done"];

function ProcessingScreen({ voiceId, onReady, onRetry }: { voiceId: string; onReady: () => void; onRetry: () => void }) {
  const voice = useVoice(voiceId);
  const job = useJob(voice.data?.job_id ?? null);
  const status = voice.data?.status;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (status === "ready") onReady();
  }, [status, onReady]);

  const currentStage = job.data?.progress?.stage ?? null;
  const currentIdx = currentStage ? STAGE_SEQUENCE.indexOf(currentStage) : -1;
  const seen = useMemo(() => {
    const s = new Set<string>();
    if (currentIdx >= 0) for (let i = 0; i <= currentIdx; i++) s.add(STAGE_SEQUENCE[i]!);
    return s;
  }, [currentIdx]);

  if (status === "failed") {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <h2 className="display text-h1 text-ink">That didn&apos;t work.</h2>
        <ErrorNote
          message={voice.data?.error?.message ?? "We could not process this recording. Try a cleaner sample."}
          code={voice.data?.error?.code ?? job.data?.error?.code ?? null}
        />
        <div>
          <Button variant="primary" size="lg" onClick={onRetry}>
            Try again
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8" aria-busy="true">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <h2 className="display text-h1 text-ink">Listening closely…</h2>
        <p className="text-body text-ink-2">We are checking the quality, finding the speech and learning how you sound.</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <ProgressBar fraction={null} label="Processing" />
        <p className="font-mono text-small text-ink-2" aria-live="polite" role="status">
          {jobStageText(job.data, voice.data?.job_id ? "Starting" : "Queued")}…
        </p>
      </div>
      <ol className="flex flex-col gap-2" aria-label="Processing stages">
        {STAGE_SEQUENCE.filter((s) => s !== "done").map((s) => {
          const label = VOICE_STAGE_LABELS[s] ?? s;
          const done = seen.has(s) && s !== currentStage;
          const active = s === currentStage;
          return (
            <li key={s} className={cn("flex items-center gap-3 text-small", active ? "text-ink" : done ? "text-ink-2" : "text-ink-3")}>
              <span
                aria-hidden
                className={cn(
                  "flex size-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full border",
                  done ? "border-ink bg-ink text-ink-inverse" : active ? "border-accent" : "border-border",
                )}
              >
                {done && <Check className="size-2.5" strokeWidth={3} />}
                {active && <span className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-accent" />}
              </span>
              {label}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
      {voice.isError && <ErrorNote error={voice.error} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function ReadyScreen({ voiceId, onUse, onAnother }: { voiceId: string; onUse: (v: Voice) => void; onAnother: () => void }) {
  const voice = useVoice(voiceId, { poll: false });
  const update = useUpdateVoice();
  const [transcript, setTranscript] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const v = voice.data;
  const value = transcript ?? v?.transcript ?? "";
  const dirty = v != null && transcript != null && transcript.trim() !== (v.transcript ?? "").trim();

  if (!v) return null;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-10">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <h2 className="display text-display-sm text-ink">
          Your voice is <em className="italic">ready.</em>
        </h2>
        <p className="text-body text-ink-2">
          {v.name}
          {v.reference?.speech_seconds != null ? ` · ${v.reference.speech_seconds.toFixed(1)} s of clean speech` : ""}
          {v.quality?.snr_db != null ? ` · ${Math.round(v.quality.snr_db)} dB signal-to-noise` : ""}
        </p>
        {v.quality?.warnings?.length ? <p className="text-small text-ink-3">{v.quality.warnings.join(" · ")}</p> : null}
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <p className="eyebrow">We heard</p>
        <label htmlFor="transcript" className="text-small text-ink-2">
          Correct it if needed — an accurate transcript improves every generation.
        </label>
        <Textarea id="transcript" rows={4} value={value} onChange={(e) => setTranscript(e.target.value)} />
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant={dirty ? "primary" : "secondary"}
            disabled={!dirty || update.isPending}
            loading={update.isPending}
            onClick={() =>
              update.mutate(
                { id: v.id, body: { transcript: value.trim() } },
                { onSuccess: () => setTranscript(null) },
              )
            }
          >
            Save transcript
          </Button>
          {v.transcript_source && (
            <span className="font-mono text-micro text-ink-3">{v.transcript_source === "auto" ? "auto transcript" : "your transcript"}</span>
          )}
          {update.isSuccess && !dirty && <span className="text-small text-success">Saved</span>}
        </div>
        {update.isError && <ErrorNote error={update.error} />}
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Button variant="primary" size="lg" onClick={() => onUse(v)}>
          Use this voice
        </Button>
        <Button size="lg" onClick={onAnother}>
          Create another
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/voice/VoiceCard.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import * as Dropdown from "@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu";
import { Check, MoreHorizontal, Play } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { AudioPlayer } from "@/components/audio/AudioPlayer";
import { Badge, type BadgeTone } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { DialogContent, DialogRoot } from "@/components/ui/Dialog";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { IconButton } from "@/components/ui/IconButton";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import { useDeleteVoice, useGeneration, useGrantConsent, usePreviewVoice, useRevokeConsent, useUpdateVoice } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import { generations } from "@/lib/api/resources";
import { CONSENT_TEXT_VERSION, LANGUAGE_NAMES, type Voice } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { useAppStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { formatDate, formatDuration } from "@/lib/format";
import { generationStageText } from "@/lib/stages";

const STATUS: Record<Voice["status"], { label: string; tone: BadgeTone }> = {
  processing: { label: "Processing", tone: "processing" },
  ready: { label: "Ready", tone: "success" },
  failed: { label: "Failed", tone: "danger" },
  consent_revoked: { label: "Consent revoked", tone: "warning" },
};

const menuItem =
  "flex h-9 cursor-pointer select-none items-center rounded-xs px-2.5 text-small text-ink outline-none data-[highlighted]:bg-surface-2 data-[disabled]:opacity-50";

export function VoiceCard({ voice }: { voice: Voice }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const selectedId = useAppStore((s) => s.selectedVoiceId);
  const setSelected = useAppStore((s) => s.setSelectedVoiceId);
  const update = useUpdateVoice();
  const remove = useDeleteVoice();
  const preview = usePreviewVoice();
  const revoke = useRevokeConsent();
  const grant = useGrantConsent();

  const [renameOpen, setRenameOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleteOpen, setDeleteOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState(voice.name);
  const [previewId, setPreviewId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const previewGen = useGeneration(previewId, { initialData: preview.data?.id === previewId ? preview.data : undefined });

  const status = STATUS[voice.status];
  const isSelected = selectedId === voice.id;
  const lang = voice.language ?? voice.detected_language;
  const duration = voice.reference?.speech_seconds ?? voice.reference?.duration_seconds ?? null;
  const previewActive = previewGen.data && (previewGen.data.status === "queued" || previewGen.data.status === "processing");

  const select = () => {
    setSelected(voice.id);
    router.push("/app");
  };

  const startPreview = () => {
    preview.mutate(
      { id: voice.id },
      {
        onSuccess: (gen) => setPreviewId(gen.id),
        onError: (e) => toast({ title: "Preview could not start", description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined, tone: "danger" }),
      },
    );
  };

  const submitRename = () => {
    const next = name.trim();
    if (!next || next === voice.name) {
      setRenameOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    update.mutate(
      { id: voice.id, body: { name: next } },
      {
        onSuccess: () => setRenameOpen(false),
      },
    );
  };

  return (
    <li
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-md border bg-surface p-4 transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv",
        isSelected ? "border-border-strong" : "border-border",
      )}
      aria-label={voice.name}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {isSelected && <span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-accent" />}
            <h2 className="truncate text-h3 font-medium text-ink">{voice.name}</h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-small text-ink-3">
            Created {formatDate(voice.created_at)}
            {duration != null && <> · {formatDuration(duration)} of speech</>}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Dropdown.Root modal={false}>
          <Dropdown.Trigger asChild>
            <IconButton label={`More actions for ${voice.name}`} size="sm">
              <MoreHorizontal className="size-4" aria-hidden />
            </IconButton>
          </Dropdown.Trigger>
          <Dropdown.Portal>
            <Dropdown.Content
              align="end"
              sideOffset={4}
              className="z-50 w-48 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface p-1 shadow-md outline-none data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out"
            >
              <Dropdown.Item className={menuItem} onSelect={() => setRenameOpen(true)}>
                Rename
              </Dropdown.Item>
              {voice.status === "consent_revoked" ? (
                <Dropdown.Item
                  className={menuItem}
                  onSelect={() => grant.mutate({ id: voice.id, version: CONSENT_TEXT_VERSION })}
                >
                  Re-grant consent
                </Dropdown.Item>
              ) : (
                <Dropdown.Item
                  className={menuItem}
                  disabled={voice.status === "processing"}
                  onSelect={() => revoke.mutate(voice.id)}
                >
                  Revoke consent
                </Dropdown.Item>
              )}
              <Dropdown.Separator className="my-1 h-px bg-border" />
              <Dropdown.Item className={cn(menuItem, "text-danger")} onSelect={() => setDeleteOpen(true)}>
                Delete
              </Dropdown.Item>
            </Dropdown.Content>
          </Dropdown.Portal>
        </Dropdown.Root>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Badge tone={status.tone}>{status.label}</Badge>
        {lang && (
          <Badge dot={false} tone="neutral">
            {LANGUAGE_NAMES[lang]?.name ?? lang}
            {voice.detected_language && voice.detected_language !== voice.language && voice.language ? ` (heard ${LANGUAGE_NAMES[voice.detected_language]?.name ?? voice.detected_language})` : ""}
          </Badge>
        )}
        {voice.quality?.warnings?.length ? (
          <span className="text-micro text-ink-3">{voice.quality.warnings.join(" · ")}</span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {voice.status === "failed" && voice.error && <ErrorNote message={voice.error.message} code={voice.error.code} />}
      {voice.status === "consent_revoked" && (
        <p className="text-small text-ink-2">Generation is paused for this voice until consent is granted again.</p>
      )}
      {(revoke.isError || grant.isError) && <ErrorNote error={revoke.error ?? grant.error} />}

      <div className="mt-auto flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-border pt-3">
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant={isSelected ? "secondary" : "primary"}
          onClick={select}
          disabled={voice.status !== "ready"}
          leading={isSelected ? <Check className="size-3.5" aria-hidden /> : undefined}
        >
          {isSelected ? "Selected" : "Select"}
        </Button>
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="ghost"
          onClick={startPreview}
          disabled={voice.status !== "ready" || preview.isPending || Boolean(previewActive)}
          loading={preview.isPending}
          leading={<Play className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />}
        >
          {previewActive ? `${generationStageText(previewGen.data!)}…` : "Preview"}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {previewGen.data?.status === "completed" && (
        <AudioPlayer
          compact
          autoPlay
          src={generations.audioUrl(previewGen.data.id)}
          duration={previewGen.data.output?.duration_seconds}
          label={`Preview of ${voice.name}`}
        />
      )}
      {previewGen.data?.status === "failed" && (
        <ErrorNote message={previewGen.data.error?.message ?? "Preview failed."} code={previewGen.data.error?.code} />
      )}

      <DialogRoot open={renameOpen} onOpenChange={setRenameOpen}>
        <DialogContent
          title="Rename voice"
          footer={
            <>
              <Button onClick={() => setRenameOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button variant="primary" onClick={submitRename} loading={update.isPending} disabled={!name.trim()}>
                Save
              </Button>
            </>
          }
        >
          <form
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              submitRename();
            }}
            className="flex flex-col gap-3"
          >
            <Input label="Name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} maxLength={60} autoFocus />
            {update.isError && <ErrorNote error={update.error} />}
          </form>
        </DialogContent>
      </DialogRoot>

      <DialogRoot open={deleteOpen} onOpenChange={setDeleteOpen}>
        <DialogContent
          title={`Delete “${voice.name}”?`}
          description="The reference recording and voice signature are removed. Past generations keep their audio."
          footer={
            <>
              <Button onClick={() => setDeleteOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button
                variant="danger"
                loading={remove.isPending}
                onClick={() =>
                  remove.mutate(voice.id, {
                    onSuccess: () => {
                      if (isSelected) setSelected(null);
                      setDeleteOpen(false);
                      toast({ title: "Voice deleted" });
                    },
                  })
                }
              >
                Delete voice
              </Button>
            </>
          }
        >
          {remove.isError && <ErrorNote error={remove.error} />}
        </DialogContent>
      </DialogRoot>
    </li>
  );
}
```

```tsx
        }

        <ul className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2" aria-busy="true">

            <VoiceCard key={v.id} voice={v} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Select, type SelectOption } from "@/components/ui/Select";
import { useLanguages } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import { isApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { LANGUAGE_NAMES, LANGUAGE_ORDER, type LanguageCapability, type LanguageHint } from "@/lib/api/types";

export const SUGGESTED_NAME = "My voice";

/** Which languages the server can clone right now, derived from /system/languages. */
export function cloningAvailability(languages: LanguageCapability[] | undefined): Record<string, boolean> | null {
  if (!languages) return null;
  const out: Record<string, boolean> = {};
  for (const l of languages) {
    out[l.code] = l.engines.some((e) => e.cloning && e.verified !== "unavailable");
  }
  return out;
}

export function useLanguageOptions(includeAuto = true): { options: SelectOption<LanguageHint>[]; note: string | null } {
  const q = useLanguages();
  const availability = cloningAvailability(q.data);
  const unavailable503 = q.isError && isApiError(q.error) && q.error.status === 503;
  const options: SelectOption<LanguageHint>[] = [];
  if (includeAuto) options.push({ value: "auto", label: "Auto-detect", description: "We listen and work it out." });
  for (const code of LANGUAGE_ORDER) {
    const name = LANGUAGE_NAMES[code];
    const available = availability ? availability[code] !== false : true;
    options.push({
      value: code,
      label: available ? `${name.name} · ${name.native}` : `${name.name} · ${name.native} — not available on this server yet`,
      disabled: !available,
    });
  }
  const note = unavailable503 ? "Language availability could not be checked (engine unavailable). Auto-detect still works." : null;
  return { options, note };
}

export function VoiceNameField({
  name,
  onNameChange,
  language,
  onLanguageChange,
  nameError,
}: {
  name: string;
  onNameChange: (v: string) => void;
  language: LanguageHint;
  onLanguageChange: (v: LanguageHint) => void;
  nameError?: string | null;
}) {
  const { options, note } = useLanguageOptions();
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <h2 className="display text-h2 text-ink">What should we call this voice?</h2>
        <Input
          label="Voice name"
          value={name}
          onChange={(e) => onNameChange(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={SUGGESTED_NAME}
          maxLength={60}
          error={nameError}
          hint={!nameError ? `Suggestion: “${SUGGESTED_NAME}”. 1–60 characters.` : undefined}
          autoComplete="off"
        />
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <Select<LanguageHint>
          label="Language (optional)"
          value={language}
          onValueChange={onLanguageChange}
          options={options}
        />
        <p className="text-small text-ink-3">{note ?? "A hint helps transcription. Leave on Auto if unsure."}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
