## frontend/src/components/voice/VoiceRecorder.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { Mic, Pause, Play, RotateCcw, Square } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AudioPlayer } from "@/components/audio/AudioPlayer";
import { LiveLevels } from "@/components/audio/LiveLevels";
import { Waveform } from "@/components/audio/Waveform";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { ErrorNote } from "@/components/ui/ErrorNote";
import { MIN_REFERENCE_SECONDS } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { decodeAudio } from "@/lib/audio";
import { useRecorder, type Recording } from "@/lib/audio/recorder";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";
import { formatDuration } from "@/lib/format";

export const SUGGESTED_PASSAGE =
  "The morning light came in slowly, the way it always did in late autumn. I made a cup of tea, opened the window a little, and listened to the street wake up. Nothing special happened, and that was exactly the point.";

export interface CapturedAudio {
  blob: Blob;
  fileName: string;
  duration: number | null;
  peaks: Float32Array | null;
  source: "recording" | "upload";
}

export function VoiceRecorder({ onCaptured, className }: { onCaptured: (audio: CapturedAudio | null) => void; className?: string }) {
  const rec = useRecorder();
  const [peaks, setPeaks] = useState<Float32Array | null>(null);
  const [tooShort, setTooShort] = useState(false);

  // When a recording finishes, decode it for a static waveform and hand it up.
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const r: Recording | null = rec.recording;
    if (!r) {
      setPeaks(null);
      setTooShort(false);
      onCaptured(null);
      return;
    }
    if (r.duration < MIN_REFERENCE_SECONDS) {
      setTooShort(true);
      onCaptured(null);
      return;
    }
    setTooShort(false);
    (async () => {
      let decoded: { peaks: Float32Array; duration: number } | null = null;
      try {
        decoded = await decodeAudio(r.blob);
      } catch {
        decoded = null;
      }
      if (cancelled) return;
      setPeaks(decoded?.peaks ?? null);
      onCaptured({
        blob: r.blob,
        fileName: `recording.${r.extension}`,
        duration: decoded && Number.isFinite(decoded.duration) ? decoded.duration : r.duration,
        peaks: decoded?.peaks ?? null,
        source: "recording",
      });
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
    // onCaptured is intentionally excluded: parent passes a stable setter.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [rec.recording]);

  const live = rec.state === "recording";
  const statusText =
    rec.state === "requesting"
      ? "Waiting for microphone permission…"
      : rec.state === "recording"
        ? `Recording · ${formatDuration(rec.elapsed)}`
        : rec.state === "paused"
          ? `Paused · ${formatDuration(rec.elapsed)}`
          : rec.state === "stopped"
            ? `Recorded ${formatDuration(rec.recording?.duration ?? rec.elapsed)}`
            : "";

  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-6", className)}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <h2 className="display text-h2 text-ink">Record a sample.</h2>
        <p className="text-body text-ink-2">Read naturally for 10–20 seconds. Quiet room, normal speaking voice.</p>
      </div>

      <figure className="rounded-md border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4">
        <figcaption className="eyebrow mb-2">Suggested passage</figcaption>
        <blockquote className="display text-[22px] leading-[1.3] text-ink">{SUGGESTED_PASSAGE}</blockquote>
      </figure>

      {rec.state === "unsupported" ? (
        <ErrorNote message="This browser cannot record audio. Upload a recording instead." code="media_recorder_unsupported" />
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-md border border-border bg-surface p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <LiveLevels analyser={rec.analyser} active={live} size={40} />
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
              <p className="font-mono text-small tabular text-ink" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" role="status">
                {statusText || (rec.state === "idle" || rec.state === "denied" ? "Ready to record" : "")}
              </p>
              <p className="text-micro text-ink-3">
                {rec.state === "idle" && "We will ask for microphone permission when you press record."}
                {rec.state === "recording" && "Speak at a steady pace. Press stop when you are done."}
                {rec.state === "paused" && "Resume when you are ready."}
                {rec.state === "stopped" && "Listen back, then continue or record again."}
              </p>
            </div>
            {live && <span aria-hidden className="size-2.5 rounded-full bg-accent" />}
          </div>

          {rec.state === "stopped" && peaks && <Waveform peaks={peaks} height={40} />}

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {(rec.state === "idle" || rec.state === "denied") && (
              <Button variant="primary" size="lg" onClick={() => void rec.start()} leading={<Mic className="size-4" aria-hidden />}>
                Start recording
              </Button>
            )}
            {rec.state === "requesting" && (
              <Button variant="primary" size="lg" loading>
                Requesting microphone
              </Button>
            )}
            {rec.state === "recording" && (
              <>
                <Button variant="primary" size="lg" onClick={rec.stop} leading={<Square className="size-4" aria-hidden />}>
                  Stop
                </Button>
                {rec.canPause && (
                  <Button size="lg" onClick={rec.pause} leading={<Pause className="size-4" aria-hidden />}>
                    Pause
                  </Button>
                )}
              </>
            )}
            {rec.state === "paused" && (
              <>
                <Button variant="primary" size="lg" onClick={rec.resume} leading={<Play className="size-4" aria-hidden />}>
                  Resume
                </Button>
                <Button size="lg" onClick={rec.stop} leading={<Square className="size-4" aria-hidden />}>
                  Stop
                </Button>
              </>
            )}
            {rec.state === "stopped" && (
              <Button size="lg" onClick={rec.reset} leading={<RotateCcw className="size-4" aria-hidden />}>
                Record again
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>

          {rec.state === "stopped" && rec.recording && !tooShort && (
            <AudioPlayer src={rec.recording.url} duration={rec.recording.duration} label="Your recording" />
          )}

          {tooShort && (
            <ErrorNote
              message={`That was under ${MIN_REFERENCE_SECONDS} seconds. Record a little longer — aim for 10 to 20 seconds.`}
              code="reference_too_short"
            />
          )}
          {rec.error && <ErrorNote message={rec.error} code={rec.state === "denied" ? "microphone_denied" : null} />}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/voice/VoiceSelector.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { Check, ChevronDown, Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { PopoverContent, PopoverRoot, PopoverTrigger } from "@/components/ui/Popover";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { useVoices } from "@/lib/api/hooks";
import { LANGUAGE_NAMES, type Voice } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { useAppStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { cn } from "@/lib/cn";

export function useSelectedVoice(): {
  voices: Voice[];
  readyVoices: Voice[];
  selected: Voice | null;
  isPending: boolean;
  isError: boolean;
  error: unknown;
  select: (id: string | null) => void;
} {
  const q = useVoices();
  const selectedId = useAppStore((s) => s.selectedVoiceId);
  const setSelectedVoiceId = useAppStore((s) => s.setSelectedVoiceId);
  const voices = useMemo(() => q.data?.items ?? [], [q.data]);
  const readyVoices = useMemo(() => voices.filter((v) => v.status === "ready"), [voices]);
  const selected = useMemo(() => voices.find((v) => v.id === selectedId) ?? null, [voices, selectedId]);

  // Keep the persisted selection honest: drop deleted voices, pick the newest ready one when empty.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!q.isSuccess) return;
    if (selectedId && !voices.some((v) => v.id === selectedId)) {
      setSelectedVoiceId(null);
      return;
    }
    if (!selectedId && readyVoices.length > 0) {
      setSelectedVoiceId(readyVoices[0]?.id ?? null);
    }
  }, [q.isSuccess, voices, readyVoices, selectedId, setSelectedVoiceId]);

  return {
    voices,
    readyVoices,
    selected,
    isPending: q.isPending,
    isError: q.isError,
    error: q.error,
    select: setSelectedVoiceId,
  };
}

/** Compact popover listing ready voices; shows the selected voice name and "Change". */
export function VoiceSelector({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const { readyVoices, voices, selected, isPending, select } = useSelectedVoice();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const processing = voices.filter((v) => v.status === "processing").length;

  if (isPending) {
    return (
      <div className={cn("flex h-10 items-center", className)}>
        <Skeleton className="h-5 w-40" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (readyVoices.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1", className)}>
        <span className="text-h3 text-ink-3">
          {processing > 0 ? `${processing === 1 ? "A voice is" : `${processing} voices are`} still processing` : "No voice yet"}
        </span>
        <Link href="/app/voices/create" className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-1.5 text-button font-medium text-ink underline-offset-4 hover:underline">
          <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden />
          Create your voice
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <PopoverRoot open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger
        aria-label={selected ? `Selected voice: ${selected.name}. Change voice` : "Choose a voice"}
        className={cn(
          "group inline-flex h-10 max-w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-sm pr-2 text-left transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv hover:bg-surface-2",
          className,
        )}
      >
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2.5 truncate">
          <span aria-hidden className={cn("size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full", selected ? "bg-accent" : "border border-border-strong")} />
          <span className="truncate text-h3 text-ink">{selected?.name ?? "Choose a voice"}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5 text-small font-medium text-ink-3 group-hover:text-ink">
          Change
          <ChevronDown className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
        </span>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent className="w-72 p-1">
        <ul role="listbox" aria-label="Ready voices" className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
          {readyVoices.map((v) => {
            const active = v.id === selected?.id;
            const lang = v.language ? LANGUAGE_NAMES[v.language]?.name : null;
            return (
              <li key={v.id} role="option" aria-selected={active}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    select(v.id);
                    setOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex h-10 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xs px-2.5 text-left text-body transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv hover:bg-surface-2",
                    active ? "text-ink" : "text-ink-2",
                  )}
                >
                  <span aria-hidden className={cn("size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full", active ? "bg-accent" : "bg-ink-3")} />
                  <span className="flex-1 truncate">{v.name}</span>
                  {lang && <span className="text-micro text-ink-3">{lang}</span>}
                  {active && <Check className="size-4 text-ink" aria-hidden />}
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
        <div className="mt-1 border-t border-border pt-1">
          <Link
            href="/app/voices/create"
            onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
            className="flex h-10 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xs px-2.5 text-small font-medium text-ink-2 transition-colors duration-fast ease-pv hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-ink"
          >
            <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden />
            Create a new voice
          </Link>
        </div>
      </PopoverContent>
    </PopoverRoot>
  );
}
```

## frontend/src/components/voice/__tests__/CreateVoiceWizard.test.tsx

```tsx
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { CreateVoiceWizard } from "@/components/voice/CreateVoiceWizard";
import { CONSENT_TEXT } from "@/lib/api/types";

vi.mock("next/navigation", () => ({
  useRouter: () => ({ push: vi.fn(), replace: vi.fn() }),
  usePathname: () => "/app/voices/create",
}));

const mockCreate = vi.fn();
vi.mock("@/lib/api/resources", async (importOriginal) => {
  const mod = await importOriginal<typeof import("@/lib/api/resources")>();
  return {
    ...mod,
    voices: { ...mod.voices, create: (...args: unknown[]) => mockCreate(...args) },
    system: { ...mod.system, languages: () => Promise.resolve([]) },
  };
});

// AudioUploader decodes with Web Audio; jsdom has none, so the uploader keeps the file and
// defers the duration check to the server. Stub URL.createObjectURL for the preview player.
beforeEach(() => {
  mockCreate.mockReset();
  mockCreate.mockImplementation(() => new Promise(() => undefined));
  Object.defineProperty(URL, "createObjectURL", { value: () => "blob:test", writable: true });
  Object.defineProperty(URL, "revokeObjectURL", { value: () => undefined, writable: true });
});

function renderWizard() {
  const client = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false }, mutations: { retry: false } } });
  return render(
    <QueryClientProvider client={client}>
      <CreateVoiceWizard />
    </QueryClientProvider>,
  );
}

async function reachDetails(user: ReturnType<typeof userEvent.setup>) {
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /Upload audio/ }));
  const input = screen.getByLabelText(/Choose a file/);
  const file = new File([new Uint8Array(4096)], "sample.wav", { type: "audio/wav" });
  await user.upload(input, file);
  await screen.findByText("sample.wav");
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Continue" }));
  await screen.findByText("What should we call this voice?");
}

describe("CreateVoiceWizard consent gating", () => {
  it("starts with the two choices", () => {
    renderWizard();
    expect(screen.getByText("Let's create your voice.")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /Record my voice/ })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /Upload audio/ })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shows the exact consent text and refuses to submit until it is ticked", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderWizard();
    await reachDetails(user);

    expect(screen.getByText(CONSENT_TEXT)).toBeInTheDocument();
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText("Voice name"), "My voice");
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Create voice" }));

    expect(mockCreate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(await screen.findByText("You need to confirm this before we can continue.")).toBeInTheDocument();

    await user.click(screen.getByRole("checkbox"));
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Create voice" }));
    expect(mockCreate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const input = mockCreate.mock.calls[0]?.[0] as { name: string; consent_confirmed: boolean; consent_text_version: string; fileName: string };
    expect(input.name).toBe("My voice");
    expect(input.consent_confirmed).toBe(true);
    expect(input.consent_text_version).toBe("v1");
    expect(input.fileName).toBe("sample.wav");
    expect(await screen.findByText("Uploading…")).toBeInTheDocument();
```

## frontend/src/lib/format.ts

```typescript
/** Seconds → m:ss (or h:mm:ss above an hour). Non-finite values render as 0:00. */
export function formatDuration(seconds: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (seconds == null || !Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0) return "0:00";
  const total = Math.floor(seconds);
  const h = Math.floor(total / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
  const s = total % 60;
  const ss = String(s).padStart(2, "0");
  if (h > 0) return `${h}:${String(m).padStart(2, "0")}:${ss}`;
  return `${m}:${ss}`;
}

/** Seconds with one decimal, e.g. "12.4 s". */
export function formatSeconds(seconds: number | null | undefined, digits = 1): string {
  if (seconds == null || !Number.isFinite(seconds)) return "—";
  return `${seconds.toFixed(digits)} s`;
}

export function formatBytes(bytes: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (bytes == null || !Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) return "—";
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  let v = bytes / 1024;
  let i = 0;
  while (v >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) {
    v /= 1024;
    i++;
  }
  return `${v < 10 ? v.toFixed(1) : Math.round(v)} ${units[i]}`;
}

export function formatMegabytes(mb: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (mb == null || !Number.isFinite(mb)) return "—";
  if (mb >= 1024) return `${(mb / 1024).toFixed(1)} GB`;
  return `${Math.round(mb)} MB`;
}

const dateFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
const dateTimeFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
  day: "numeric",
  month: "short",
  hour: "2-digit",
  minute: "2-digit",
});

/** ISO string → "9 Nov 2026". */
export function formatDate(iso: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "—";
  return dateFmt.format(d);
}

/** ISO string → "9 Nov, 14:02". */
export function formatDateTime(iso: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "—";
  return dateTimeFmt.format(d);
}

/** Relative time for heartbeats: "just now", "42 s ago", "3 min ago". */
export function formatRelative(iso: string | null | undefined, now: number = Date.now()): string {
  if (!iso) return "never";
  const t = new Date(iso).getTime();
  if (Number.isNaN(t)) return "—";
  const diff = Math.max(0, Math.round((now - t) / 1000));
  if (diff < 5) return "just now";
  if (diff < 60) return `${diff} s ago`;
  if (diff < 3600) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)} min ago`;
  if (diff < 86400) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3600)} h ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(diff / 86400)} d ago`;
}

export function excerpt(text: string, max = 120): string {
  const t = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  if (t.length <= max) return t;
  return `${t.slice(0, max - 1).trimEnd()}…`;
}

export function formatRtf(rtf: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (rtf == null || !Number.isFinite(rtf)) return "—";
  return `${rtf.toFixed(2)}×`;
}
```

```typescript
import type { Generation, Job, Progress } from "./api/types";

/** Voice-creation job stages → human labels (docs/INTERNAL_CONTRACTS.md). */
export const VOICE_STAGE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  decode: "Decoding audio",
  analyse: "Analysing quality",
  analyze: "Analysing quality",
  vad: "Finding speech",
  trim: "Trimming silence",
  transcribe: "Transcribing",
  validate: "Validating",
  fingerprint: "Creating voice signature",
  done: "Finishing up",
};

export const VOICE_STAGE_ORDER = ["decode", "analyse", "vad", "trim", "transcribe", "validate", "fingerprint"];

/** Generation stages → human labels. */
export const GENERATION_STAGE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  prepare: "Preparing",
  load_model: "Loading model",
  synthesize: "Synthesising",
  synthesise: "Synthesising",
  encode: "Encoding",
  validate: "Validating",
  done: "Finishing up",
};

function humanise(stage: string): string {
  const s = stage.replace(/[_-]+/g, " ").trim();
  return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
}

/** Real stage text for a generation; never fabricates percentages. */
export function generationStageText(gen: Pick<Generation, "status" | "progress">): string {
  if (gen.status === "queued") return "Queued";
  if (gen.status !== "processing") return "";
  const p = gen.progress;
  if (!p) return "Processing";
  const label = GENERATION_STAGE_LABELS[p.stage] ?? humanise(p.stage);
  if (p.total > 1 && p.current >= 0) return `${label} ${Math.min(p.current, p.total)} of ${p.total}`;
  return label;
}

export function jobStageText(job: Pick<Job, "status" | "progress"> | undefined, fallback = "Processing"): string {
  if (!job) return fallback;
  if (job.status === "queued") return "Queued";
  const p = job.progress;
  if (!p) return fallback;
  return VOICE_STAGE_LABELS[p.stage] ?? humanise(p.stage);
}

/** Fraction 0–1 of real progress, or null when unknown. */
export function progressFraction(p: Progress | null | undefined): number | null {
  if (!p || !Number.isFinite(p.total) || p.total <= 0) return null;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p.current / p.total));
}
```

```typescript
import type { Theme } from "./api/types";

export const THEME_KEY = "pv-theme";

/** Inline script run before paint so the theme never flashes. Keep dependency-free. */
export const THEME_INIT_SCRIPT = `(function(){try{var t=localStorage.getItem(${JSON.stringify(THEME_KEY)});if(t==="light"||t==="dark"){document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme",t);}else{document.documentElement.removeAttribute("data-theme");}}catch(e){}})();`;

export function applyTheme(theme: Theme): void {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  const root = document.documentElement;
  if (theme === "light" || theme === "dark") root.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
  else root.removeAttribute("data-theme");
  try {
    if (theme === "system") localStorage.removeItem(THEME_KEY);
    else localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, theme);
  } catch {
    /* storage unavailable */
  }
}
```

## frontend/src/lib/api/client.ts

```typescript
import type { ApiErrorEnvelope } from "./types";

export const API_BASE = "/api/v1";
const CSRF_COOKIE = "pv_csrf";
const CSRF_HEADER = "X-CSRF-Token";
const MUTATING = new Set(["POST", "PATCH", "PUT", "DELETE"]);

export class ApiError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;
  readonly code: string;
  readonly details: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  readonly retryAfter: number | undefined;

  constructor(
    status: number,
    code: string,
    message: string,
    details?: Record<string, unknown>,
    retryAfter?: number,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
    this.status = status;
    this.code = code;
    this.details = details;
    this.retryAfter = retryAfter;
  }

  /** Field-level messages from a `validation_error` envelope, keyed by the last path segment. */
  fieldErrors(): Record<string, string> {
    const out: Record<string, string> = {};
    const fields = (this.details as ApiErrorEnvelope["error"]["details"] | undefined)?.fields;
    if (Array.isArray(fields)) {
      for (const f of fields) {
        const key = String(f.loc[f.loc.length - 1] ?? "");
        if (key && !out[key]) out[key] = f.msg;
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
}

export function isApiError(e: unknown): e is ApiError {
  return e instanceof ApiError;
}

const DEFAULT_MESSAGES: Record<number, string> = {
  400: "That request could not be understood.",
  401: "You need to sign in to continue.",
  403: "You do not have permission to do that.",
  404: "We could not find that.",
  409: "That conflicts with the current state. Refresh and try again.",
  413: "That file is too large.",
  422: "Some of the information is not valid.",
  429: "Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.",
  500: "Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.",
  502: "The service is unreachable right now. Please try again shortly.",
  503: "The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.",
};

export function readCookie(name: string): string | null {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return null;
  const match = document.cookie
    .split("; ")
    .find((row) => row.startsWith(`${encodeURIComponent(name)}=`) || row.startsWith(`${name}=`));
  if (!match) return null;
  return decodeURIComponent(match.slice(match.indexOf("=") + 1));
}

type UnauthenticatedHandler = () => void;

let onUnauthenticated: UnauthenticatedHandler = () => {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  const { pathname, search } = window.location;
  if (!pathname.startsWith("/app")) return;
  const next = encodeURIComponent(pathname + search);
  window.location.assign(`/login?next=${next}`);
};

/** Override where the client sends the user when a session cannot be recovered (tests, shells). */
export function setUnauthenticatedHandler(handler: UnauthenticatedHandler): void {
  onUnauthenticated = handler;
}

export interface RequestOptions {
  method?: "GET" | "POST" | "PATCH" | "PUT" | "DELETE";
  body?: unknown;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  query?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined | null>;
  /** Do not attempt a token refresh on 401 (used for auth routes themselves). */
  skipAuthRefresh?: boolean;
  /** Do not call the unauthenticated handler on 401 (e.g. optional "am I signed in?" probes). */
  skipAuthRedirect?: boolean;
}

export function buildQuery(query: RequestOptions["query"]): string {
  if (!query) return "";
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(query)) {
    if (v === undefined || v === null || v === "") continue;
    params.set(k, String(v));
  }
  const s = params.toString();
  return s ? `?${s}` : "";
}

let csrfPromise: Promise<string | null> | null = null;

/** Make sure a `pv_csrf` cookie exists, fetching `GET /auth/csrf` once if needed. */
export async function ensureCsrf(): Promise<string | null> {
  const existing = readCookie(CSRF_COOKIE);
  if (existing) return existing;
  if (!csrfPromise) {
    csrfPromise = fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth/csrf`, { credentials: "include" })
      .then(async (res) => {
        if (!res.ok) return null;
        const data = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { csrf_token?: string } | null;
        return readCookie(CSRF_COOKIE) ?? data?.csrf_token ?? null;
      })
      .catch(() => null)
      .finally(() => {
        csrfPromise = null;
      });
  }
  return csrfPromise;
}

async function parseError(res: Response): Promise<ApiError> {
  let envelope: ApiErrorEnvelope | null = null;
  try {
    const text = await res.text();
    if (text) envelope = JSON.parse(text) as ApiErrorEnvelope;
  } catch {
    envelope = null;
  }
  const retryAfterHeader = res.headers.get("Retry-After");
  const retryAfter = retryAfterHeader ? Number(retryAfterHeader) || undefined : undefined;
  const code = envelope?.error?.code ?? (res.status === 429 ? "rate_limited" : `http_${res.status}`);
  let message = envelope?.error?.message ?? DEFAULT_MESSAGES[res.status] ?? `Request failed (${res.status}).`;
  if (res.status === 429 && retryAfter && !envelope?.error?.message) {
    message = `Too many requests. Try again in ${retryAfter}s.`;
  }
  return new ApiError(res.status, code, message, envelope?.error?.details, retryAfter);
}

let refreshPromise: Promise<boolean> | null = null;

/** POST /auth/refresh (requires the CSRF header). Shared across concurrent 401s. */
export async function refreshSession(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!refreshPromise) {
    refreshPromise = (async () => {
      const csrf = await ensureCsrf();
      const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
      if (csrf) headers[CSRF_HEADER] = csrf;
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth/refresh`, {
          method: "POST",
          credentials: "include",
          headers,
        });
        return res.ok;
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    })().finally(() => {
      refreshPromise = null;
    });
  }
  return refreshPromise;
}

async function doFetch(path: string, opts: RequestOptions): Promise<Response> {
  const method = opts.method ?? "GET";
  const headers: Record<string, string> = { Accept: "application/json", ...opts.headers };
  let body: BodyInit | undefined;

  if (opts.body instanceof FormData) {
    body = opts.body;
  } else if (opts.body !== undefined) {
    headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
    body = JSON.stringify(opts.body);
  }

  if (MUTATING.has(method)) {
    const csrf = await ensureCsrf();
    if (csrf) headers[CSRF_HEADER] = csrf;
  }

  return fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}${buildQuery(opts.query)}`, {
    method,
    headers,
    body,
    credentials: "include",
    signal: opts.signal,
  });
}

/**
 * Typed fetch against the same-origin API. Parses the error envelope into `ApiError`; on a 401
 * attempts one refresh then retries once, otherwise hands off to the unauthenticated handler.
 */
export async function api<T>(path: string, opts: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
  let res = await doFetch(path, opts);

  if (res.status === 401 && !opts.skipAuthRefresh && !path.startsWith("/auth/")) {
    const refreshed = await refreshSession();
    if (refreshed) {
      res = await doFetch(path, opts);
    }
  }

  if (res.status === 401 && !opts.skipAuthRedirect && !path.startsWith("/auth/")) {
    onUnauthenticated();
  }

  if (!res.ok) {
    throw await parseError(res);
  }

  if (res.status === 204 || res.headers.get("content-length") === "0") {
    return undefined as T;
  }
  const text = await res.text();
  if (!text) return undefined as T;
  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

export interface UploadProgress {
  loaded: number;
  total: number;
}

/**
 * Multipart upload with real progress events (XMLHttpRequest, since fetch has no upload
 * progress). Same cookie + CSRF semantics as `api()`. One refresh-and-retry on 401.
 */
export async function upload<T>(
  path: string,
  form: FormData,
  options: { onProgress?: (p: UploadProgress) => void; signal?: AbortSignal; headers?: Record<string, string> } = {},
  attempt = 0,
): Promise<T> {
  const csrf = await ensureCsrf();
  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open("POST", `${API_BASE}${path}`);
    xhr.withCredentials = true;
    xhr.responseType = "text";
    xhr.setRequestHeader("Accept", "application/json");
    if (csrf) xhr.setRequestHeader(CSRF_HEADER, csrf);
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(options.headers ?? {})) xhr.setRequestHeader(k, v);

    const abort = () => xhr.abort();
    options.signal?.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });

    xhr.upload.onprogress = (ev) => {
      if (ev.lengthComputable) options.onProgress?.({ loaded: ev.loaded, total: ev.total });
    };
    xhr.onerror = () => reject(new ApiError(0, "network_error", "The upload failed. Check your connection and try again."));
    xhr.onabort = () => reject(new ApiError(0, "aborted", "Upload cancelled."));
    xhr.onload = async () => {
      options.signal?.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
      const status = xhr.status;
      if (status === 401 && attempt === 0) {
        const ok = await refreshSession();
        if (ok) {
          upload<T>(path, form, options, 1).then(resolve, reject);
          return;
        }
        onUnauthenticated();
      }
      if (status >= 200 && status < 300) {
        try {
          resolve(xhr.responseText ? (JSON.parse(xhr.responseText) as T) : (undefined as T));
        } catch {
          reject(new ApiError(status, "invalid_response", "The server returned an unexpected response."));
        }
        return;
      }
      const headers = new Headers();
      const ra = xhr.getResponseHeader("Retry-After");
      if (ra) headers.set("Retry-After", ra);
      const fake = new Response(xhr.responseText, { status, headers });
      reject(await parseError(fake));
    };
    xhr.send(form);
  });
}

/** Human-readable message for any thrown value. */
export function errorMessage(e: unknown, fallback = "Something went wrong. Please try again."): string {
  if (isApiError(e)) return e.message || fallback;
  if (e instanceof Error && e.message) return e.message;
  return fallback;
}

export function errorCode(e: unknown): string | null {
  return isApiError(e) ? e.code : null;
}
```

```typescript
} from "./types";

export const keys = {

  voices: ["voices"] as const,
  voice: (id: string) => ["voices", id] as const,
  generations: (params: GenerationListParams = {}) => ["generations", params] as const,
  generation: (id: string) => ["generations", "one", id] as const,

  conversationEngines: ["conversation", "engines"] as const,

const noRetryOnClientError = (failureCount: number, error: unknown) => {
  if (isApiError(error) && error.status >= 400 && error.status < 500) return false;
  return failureCount < 2;
};

// Me ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function useMe(options: { enabled?: boolean; redirect?: boolean } = {}) {
  return useQuery<User>({
    queryKey: keys.me,
    queryFn: () => users.me({ skipAuthRedirect: options.redirect === false }),
    enabled: options.enabled ?? true,
    retry: noRetryOnClientError,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useUpdateMe() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (body: UpdateMeBody) => users.update(body),
    onSuccess: (user) => qc.setQueryData(keys.me, user),
  });
}

export function useDeleteMe() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (password: string) => users.remove(password),
    onSuccess: () => qc.clear(),
  });
}

export function useLogin() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (body: LoginBody) => auth.login(body),
    onSuccess: (res) => qc.setQueryData(keys.me, res.user),
  });
}

export function useRegister() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (body: RegisterBody) => auth.register(body),
    onSuccess: (res) => qc.setQueryData(keys.me, res.user),
  });
}

export function useLogout() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => auth.logout(),
    onSettled: () => qc.clear(),
  });
}

// Voices --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function useVoices(options: { enabled?: boolean } = {}) {
  return useQuery<Paginated<Voice>>({
    queryKey: keys.voices,
    queryFn: () => voices.list({ limit: 100 }),
    enabled: options.enabled ?? true,
    retry: noRetryOnClientError,
    // Poll while any voice is still processing.
    refetchInterval: (query) =>
      query.state.data?.items.some((v) => v.status === "processing") ? 2000 : false,
  });
}

export function useVoice(id: string | null | undefined, options: { poll?: boolean } = {}) {
  return useQuery<Voice>({
    queryKey: keys.voice(id ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => voices.get(id as string),
    enabled: Boolean(id),
    retry: noRetryOnClientError,
    refetchInterval: (query) =>
      options.poll !== false && query.state.data?.status === "processing" ? 2000 : false,
  });
}

export function useCreateVoice() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ input, onProgress, signal }: { input: CreateVoiceInput; onProgress?: (p: UploadProgress) => void; signal?: AbortSignal }) =>
      voices.create(input, onProgress, signal),
    onSuccess: (voice) => {
      qc.setQueryData(keys.voice(voice.id), voice);
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.voices });
    },
  });
}

export function useUpdateVoice() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, body }: { id: string; body: UpdateVoiceBody }) => voices.update(id, body),
    onSuccess: (voice) => {
      qc.setQueryData(keys.voice(voice.id), voice);
      qc.setQueryData<Paginated<Voice>>(keys.voices, (prev) =>
        prev ? { ...prev, items: prev.items.map((v) => (v.id === voice.id ? voice : v)) } : prev,
      );
    },
  });
}

export function useDeleteVoice() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => voices.remove(id),
    onSuccess: (_void, id) => {
      qc.removeQueries({ queryKey: keys.voice(id) });
      qc.setQueryData<Paginated<Voice>>(keys.voices, (prev) =>
        prev ? { ...prev, total: Math.max(0, prev.total - 1), items: prev.items.filter((v) => v.id !== id) } : prev,
      );
    },
  });
}

export function usePreviewVoice() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, text }: { id: string; text?: string }) => voices.preview(id, text),
    onSuccess: (gen) => qc.setQueryData(keys.generation(gen.id), gen),
  });
}

export function useRevokeConsent() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => voices.revokeConsent(id),
    onSuccess: (voice) => {
      qc.setQueryData(keys.voice(voice.id), voice);
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.voices });
    },
  });
}

export function useGrantConsent() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, version }: { id: string; version: string }) => voices.grantConsent(id, version),
    onSuccess: (voice) => {
      qc.setQueryData(keys.voice(voice.id), voice);
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.voices });
    },
  });
}

// Generations ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const GENERATION_PAGE = 20;

export function useGenerations(params: Omit<GenerationListParams, "limit" | "offset"> = {}) {
  return useInfiniteQuery<Paginated<Generation>>({
    queryKey: keys.generations(params),
    queryFn: ({ pageParam }) =>
      generations.list({ ...params, limit: GENERATION_PAGE, offset: (pageParam as number) ?? 0 }),
    initialPageParam: 0,
    getNextPageParam: (last) => {
      const next = last.offset + last.items.length;
      return next < last.total && last.items.length > 0 ? next : undefined;
    },
    retry: noRetryOnClientError,
  });
}

const GENERATION_ACTIVE = new Set(["queued", "processing"]);

export function useGeneration(
  id: string | null | undefined,
  options: { poll?: boolean; initialData?: Generation } = {},
) {
  const q: UseQueryOptions<Generation> = {
    queryKey: keys.generation(id ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => generations.get(id as string),
    enabled: Boolean(id),
    retry: noRetryOnClientError,
    refetchInterval: (query) =>
      options.poll !== false && GENERATION_ACTIVE.has(query.state.data?.status ?? "") ? 1500 : false,
  };
  if (options.initialData) q.initialData = options.initialData;
  return useQuery<Generation>(q);
}

export function useCreateGeneration() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (body: GenerationCreate) => generations.create(body),
    onSuccess: (gen) => {
      qc.setQueryData(keys.generation(gen.id), gen);
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["generations"], exact: false, predicate: (q) => q.queryKey[1] !== "one" });
    },
  });
}

export function useDeleteGeneration() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => generations.remove(id),
    onSuccess: (_v, id) => {
      qc.removeQueries({ queryKey: keys.generation(id) });
      void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["generations"], predicate: (q) => q.queryKey[1] !== "one" });
    },
  });
}

// Jobs ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function useJob(id: string | null | undefined, options: { poll?: boolean } = {}) {
  return useQuery<Job>({
    queryKey: keys.job(id ?? ""),
    queryFn: () => jobs.get(id as string),
    enabled: Boolean(id),
    retry: noRetryOnClientError,
    refetchInterval: (query) => {
      const s = query.state.data?.status;
      return options.poll !== false && (s === undefined || s === "queued" || s === "running") ? 1500 : false;
    },
  });
}

// System --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function useModels(options: { refetchInterval?: number | false } = {}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: keys.models,
    queryFn: system.models,
    retry: noRetryOnClientError,
    staleTime: 10_000,
    refetchInterval: options.refetchInterval ?? false,
  });
}

export function useHardware(options: { refetchInterval?: number | false } = {}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: keys.hardware,
    queryFn: system.hardware,
    retry: false,
    refetchInterval: options.refetchInterval ?? false,
  });
}

export function useMetrics(options: { refetchInterval?: number | false } = {}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: keys.metrics,
    queryFn: system.metrics,
    retry: noRetryOnClientError,
    refetchInterval: options.refetchInterval ?? false,
  });
}

export function useLanguages() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: keys.languages,
    queryFn: system.languages,
    retry: false,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });
}

export function useHealth(options: { refetchInterval?: number | false } = {}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: keys.health,
    queryFn: system.health,
    retry: false,
    refetchInterval: options.refetchInterval ?? false,
  });
}

// API keys / audit ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function useApiKeys() {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: keys.apiKeys, queryFn: apiKeys.list, retry: noRetryOnClientError });
}

export function useCreateApiKey() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation<ApiKeyCreated, unknown, string>({
    mutationFn: (name: string) => apiKeys.create(name),
    onSuccess: () => void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.apiKeys }),
  });
}

export function useRevokeApiKey() {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => apiKeys.revoke(id),
    onSuccess: () => void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.apiKeys }),
  });
}

export function useAudit() {
  return useInfiniteQuery({
    queryKey: keys.audit,
    queryFn: ({ pageParam }) => audit.list({ limit: 20, offset: (pageParam as number) ?? 0 }),
    initialPageParam: 0,
    getNextPageParam: (last) => {
      const next = last.offset + last.items.length;
      return next < last.total && last.items.length > 0 ? next : undefined;
    },
    retry: noRetryOnClientError,
  });
}

// Conversation ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function useConversationEngines() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: keys.conversationEngines,
    queryFn: conversation.engines,
    retry: noRetryOnClientError,
    staleTime: 30_000,
  });
}
```

## frontend/src/lib/api/resources.ts

```typescript
import { api, upload, type UploadProgress } from "./client";
import type {
  ApiKey,
  ApiKeyCreated,
  AuditEntry,
  AuthResponse,
  ConversationEngine,
  CreateVoiceInput,
  Generation,
  GenerationCreate,
  GenerationListParams,
  Hardware,
  Health,
  Job,
  LanguageCapability,
  LoginBody,
  Metrics,
  ModelInfo,
  Paginated,
  RegisterBody,
  UpdateMeBody,
  UpdateVoiceBody,
  User,
  Voice,
} from "./types";

// Auth --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export const auth = {
  register: (body: RegisterBody) =>
    api<AuthResponse>("/auth/register", { method: "POST", body, skipAuthRefresh: true, skipAuthRedirect: true }),
  login: (body: LoginBody) =>
    api<AuthResponse>("/auth/login", { method: "POST", body, skipAuthRefresh: true, skipAuthRedirect: true }),
  logout: () => api<void>("/auth/logout", { method: "POST", skipAuthRefresh: true, skipAuthRedirect: true }),
  refresh: () => api<AuthResponse>("/auth/refresh", { method: "POST", skipAuthRefresh: true, skipAuthRedirect: true }),
};

// Users -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export const users = {
  me: (opts: { skipAuthRedirect?: boolean } = {}) => api<User>("/users/me", opts),
  update: (body: UpdateMeBody) => api<User>("/users/me", { method: "PATCH", body }),
  remove: (password: string) => api<void>("/users/me", { method: "DELETE", body: { password } }),
};

// Voices ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export const voices = {
  list: (params: { limit?: number; offset?: number } = {}) =>
    api<Paginated<Voice>>("/voices", { query: { limit: params.limit ?? 100, offset: params.offset ?? 0 } }),
  get: (id: string) => api<Voice>(`/voices/${id}`),
  create: (input: CreateVoiceInput, onProgress?: (p: UploadProgress) => void, signal?: AbortSignal) => {
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append("file", input.file, input.fileName);
    form.append("name", input.name);
    if (input.language_hint) form.append("language_hint", input.language_hint);
    form.append("consent_confirmed", "true");
    form.append("consent_text_version", input.consent_text_version);
    if (input.transcript) form.append("transcript", input.transcript);
    return upload<Voice>("/voices", form, {
      onProgress,
      signal,
      headers: { "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID() },
    });
  },
  update: (id: string, body: UpdateVoiceBody) => api<Voice>(`/voices/${id}`, { method: "PATCH", body }),
  remove: (id: string) => api<void>(`/voices/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
  preview: (id: string, text?: string) =>
    api<Generation>(`/voices/${id}/preview`, { method: "POST", body: text ? { text } : {} }),
  revokeConsent: (id: string) => api<Voice>(`/voices/${id}/consent/revoke`, { method: "POST" }),
  grantConsent: (id: string, consent_text_version: string) =>
    api<Voice>(`/voices/${id}/consent`, { method: "POST", body: { consent_confirmed: true, consent_text_version } }),
  referenceAudioUrl: (id: string) => `/api/v1/voices/${id}/reference-audio`,
};

// Generations -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export const generations = {
  list: (params: GenerationListParams = {}) =>
    api<Paginated<Generation>>("/generations", {
      query: {
        voice_id: params.voice_id,
        status: params.status,
        limit: params.limit ?? 20,
        offset: params.offset ?? 0,
      },
    }),
  get: (id: string) => api<Generation>(`/generations/${id}`),
  create: (body: GenerationCreate) =>
    api<Generation>("/generations", {
      method: "POST",
      body,
      headers: { "Idempotency-Key": crypto.randomUUID() },
    }),
  remove: (id: string) => api<void>(`/generations/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
  audioUrl: (id: string, download = false) =>
    `/api/v1/generations/${id}/audio${download ? "?download=1" : ""}`,
  signedUrl: (id: string) => api<{ url: string; expires_at: string }>(`/generations/${id}/audio-url`),
};

// Jobs --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export const jobs = {
  get: (id: string) => api<Job>(`/jobs/${id}`),
};

// System ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export const system = {
  health: () => api<Health>("/system/health", { skipAuthRedirect: true }),
  models: () => api<ModelInfo[]>("/system/models"),
  hardware: () => api<Hardware>("/system/hardware"),
  metrics: () => api<Metrics>("/system/metrics"),
  languages: () => api<LanguageCapability[]>("/system/languages"),
};

// API keys / audit --------------------------------------------------------------------------
export const apiKeys = {
  list: () => api<ApiKey[]>("/api-keys"),
  create: (name: string) => api<ApiKeyCreated>("/api-keys", { method: "POST", body: { name } }),
  revoke: (id: string) => api<void>(`/api-keys/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
};

export const audit = {
  list: (params: { limit?: number; offset?: number } = {}) =>
    api<Paginated<AuditEntry>>("/audit", { query: { limit: params.limit ?? 20, offset: params.offset ?? 0 } }),
};

// Conversation ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export const conversation = {
  engines: () => api<ConversationEngine[]>("/conversation/engines"),
};

export function conversationWsUrl(voiceId: string, engine: string, language?: string): string {
  const base = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_BASE;
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ voice_id: voiceId, engine });
  if (language && language !== "auto") params.set("language", language);
  const path = `/api/v1/conversation/ws?${params.toString()}`;
  if (base) return `${base.replace(/\/$/, "")}${path}`;
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return path;
  const proto = window.location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss:" : "ws:";
  return `${proto}//${window.location.host}${path}`;
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Types mirroring docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md (API v1) plus the contract clarifications in
 * backend/README.md. Keep this file in lock-step with the backend schemas.
 */

export type LanguageCode = "en" | "te" | "hi" | "kn" | "ta" | "ml" | "zh";
export type LanguageHint = "auto" | LanguageCode;
export type OutputFormat = "wav" | "mp3" | "flac";
export type Quality = "fast" | "balanced" | "high";
export type Theme = "system" | "light" | "dark";
export type Mode = "simple" | "advanced";
export type Device = "cpu" | "cuda";

export interface Paginated<T> {
  items: T[];
  total: number;
  limit: number;
  offset: number;
}

export interface ApiErrorEnvelope {
  error: {
    code: string;
    message?: string;
    details?: Record<string, unknown> & {
      fields?: { loc: (string | number)[]; msg: string; type: string }[];
      supported_engines?: string[];
    };
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Users / auth

export interface UserPreferences {
  default_language: LanguageHint;
  default_engine: string | null;
  output_format: OutputFormat;
  speed: number;
  theme: Theme;
  mode: Mode;
}

export interface User {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  display_name: string;
  created_at: string;
  preferences: UserPreferences;
}

export interface AuthResponse {
  user: User;
}

export interface RegisterBody {
  email: string;
  password: string;
  display_name: string;
}

export interface LoginBody {
  email: string;
  password: string;
}

export interface UpdateMeBody {
  display_name?: string;
  preferences?: Partial<UserPreferences>;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Voices

export type VoiceStatus = "processing" | "ready" | "failed" | "consent_revoked";

export interface ResourceError {
  code: string;
  message: string;
}

export interface VoiceReference {
  original_format: string;
  duration_seconds: number;
  sample_rate: number;
  channels: number;
  /** null while the voice is still processing (comes from VAD in the worker). */
  speech_seconds: number | null;
  size_bytes: number;
}

export interface VoiceQuality {
  snr_db: number | null;
  clipping_ratio: number;
  peak_dbfs: number;
  rms_dbfs: number;
  leading_silence_s: number;
  trailing_silence_s: number;
  warnings: string[];
}

export interface Voice {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status: VoiceStatus;
  error: ResourceError | null;
  language: LanguageCode | null;
  detected_language: LanguageCode | null;
  engine_id: string | null;
  transcript: string | null;
  transcript_source: "auto" | "user" | null;
  reference: VoiceReference | null;
  quality: VoiceQuality | null;
  consent: { given_at: string; text_version: string; revoked_at: string | null };
  preview_generation_id: string | null;
  job_id: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

export interface CreateVoiceInput {
  file: File | Blob;
  fileName: string;
  name: string;
  language_hint?: LanguageHint;
  consent_confirmed: true;
  consent_text_version: string;
  transcript?: string;
}

export interface UpdateVoiceBody {
  name?: string;
  transcript?: string;
  language?: LanguageCode;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Generations

export type GenerationStatus = "queued" | "processing" | "completed" | "failed" | "cancelled";

export interface Progress {
  stage: string;
  current: number;
  total: number;
}

export interface GenerationOutput {
  format: string;
  duration_seconds: number;
  sample_rate: number;
  size_bytes: number;
}

export interface GenerationMetrics {
  inference_seconds: number;
  total_seconds: number;
  real_time_factor: number;
  chunks: number;
  device: Device;
  peak_dbfs: number;
  clipping_ratio: number;
}

export interface Generation {
  id: string;
  voice_id: string | null;
  voice_name: string;
  text: string;
  /** May be null when "auto" was requested and the voice has no known language yet. */
  language: LanguageCode | null;
  requested_language: LanguageHint;
  engine_id: string | null;
  status: GenerationStatus;
  progress: Progress | null;
  error: ResourceError | null;
  output: GenerationOutput | null;
  metrics: GenerationMetrics | null;
  job_id: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  started_at: string | null;
  completed_at: string | null;
}

export interface GenerationCreate {
  voice_id: string;
  text: string;
  language?: LanguageHint;
  engine_id?: string;
  speed?: number;
  output_format?: OutputFormat;
  quality?: Quality;
}

export interface GenerationListParams {
  voice_id?: string;
  status?: GenerationStatus;
  limit?: number;
  offset?: number;
}

export interface AudioUrl {
  url: string;
  expires_at: string;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Jobs

export type JobKind = "voice_create" | "generation" | "preview" | "cleanup" | "conversation_turn";
export type JobStatus = "queued" | "running" | "completed" | "failed" | "cancelled";

export interface Job {
  id: string;
  kind: JobKind;
  status: JobStatus;
  progress: Progress | null;
  error: ResourceError | null;
  created_at: string;
  started_at: string | null;
  finished_at: string | null;
  resource_type: string;
  resource_id: string;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// System

export interface Health {
  status: "ok" | "degraded";
  version: string;
  checks: {
    database: unknown;
    redis: unknown;
    storage: unknown;
    worker: { status: string; last_heartbeat: string | null };
  };
}

export interface ModelInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  licence: string;
  weight_licence: string;
  available: boolean;
  unavailable_reason: string | null;
  loaded: boolean;
  device: Device | null;
  tts_languages: LanguageCode[];
  cloning_languages: LanguageCode[];
  cross_lingual: boolean;
  requires_reference_text: boolean;
  sample_rate: number;
  resource: { ram_mb: number; vram_mb: number | null };
  stats: { loads: number; inferences: number; avg_rtf: number | null; last_error: string | null };
}

export interface Hardware {
  device: Device;
  cuda_available: boolean;
  gpu: { name: string; vram_total_mb: number; vram_used_mb: number } | null;
  cpu_cores: number;
  ram_total_mb: number;
  ram_used_mb: number;
  disk_free_mb: number;
  torch_version: string | null;
  onnxruntime_version: string | null;
}

export interface Metrics {
  queues: { voice: number; generation: number };
  workers: { name: string; last_heartbeat: string; loaded_engine: string | null }[];
  generations_24h: { total: number; completed: number; failed: number; avg_rtf: number | null };
  voices_total: number;
}

export type Verified = "verified" | "unverified" | "unavailable";

export interface LanguageCapability {
  code: LanguageCode;
  name: string;
  native_name: string;
  script: string;
  engines: { engine_id: string; tts: boolean; cloning: boolean; verified: Verified; note: string }[];
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// API keys / audit

export interface ApiKey {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  prefix: string;
  created_at: string;
  last_used_at: string | null;
  revoked_at: string | null;
}

export interface ApiKeyCreated {
  api_key: ApiKey;
  secret: string;
}

export interface AuditEntry {
  id: string;
  action: string;
  resource_type: string | null;
  resource_id: string | null;
  ip: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown> | null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Conversation

export type ConversationEngineId = "mirror" | "llm";

export interface ConversationEngine {
  id: ConversationEngineId;
  available: boolean;
  reason: string | null;
}

export type ConversationState = "idle" | "listening" | "thinking" | "speaking";

export type ConversationServerMessage =
  | { type: "state"; state: ConversationState }
  | { type: "transcript"; text: string }
  | { type: "response"; text: string }
  | { type: "audio_start"; sample_rate: number }
  | { type: "audio_end" }
  | { type: "error"; code: string; message?: string };

export type ConversationClientMessage = { type: "start" } | { type: "stop" } | { type: "interrupt" };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Static language catalogue (names shown in the UI; availability comes from /system/languages).

export const LANGUAGE_NAMES: Record<LanguageCode, { name: string; native: string }> = {
  en: { name: "English", native: "English" },
  te: { name: "Telugu", native: "తెలుగు" },
  hi: { name: "Hindi", native: "हिन्दी" },
  kn: { name: "Kannada", native: "ಕನ್ನಡ" },
  ta: { name: "Tamil", native: "தமிழ்" },
  ml: { name: "Malayalam", native: "മലയാളം" },
  zh: { name: "Chinese", native: "中文" },
};

export const LANGUAGE_ORDER: LanguageCode[] = ["te", "hi", "kn", "ta", "ml", "en", "zh"];

export const CONSENT_TEXT =
  "I confirm that this is my voice or that I have explicit permission from the voice owner to create this voice clone.";
export const CONSENT_TEXT_VERSION = "v1";
export const MAX_TEXT_CHARS = 5000;
export const MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024;
export const MIN_REFERENCE_SECONDS = 3;
export const MAX_REFERENCE_SECONDS = 120;
```

```typescript
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { ApiError, api, ensureCsrf, isApiError, readCookie, setUnauthenticatedHandler } from "@/lib/api/client";

function jsonResponse(body: unknown, init: ResponseInit = {}): Response {
  return new Response(body === undefined ? null : JSON.stringify(body), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    ...init,
  });
}

function setCookie(name: string, value: string) {
  document.cookie = `${name}=${value}; path=/`;
}

function clearCookies() {
  for (const c of document.cookie.split(";")) {
    const name = c.split("=")[0]?.trim();
    if (name) document.cookie = `${name}=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; path=/`;
  }
}

describe("api client", () => {
  const fetchMock = vi.fn<typeof fetch>();

  beforeEach(() => {
    clearCookies();
    fetchMock.mockReset();
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetchMock);
    setUnauthenticatedHandler(() => undefined);
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("reads cookies", () => {
    setCookie("pv_csrf", "abc123");
    expect(readCookie("pv_csrf")).toBe("abc123");
    expect(readCookie("missing")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("sends X-CSRF-Token from the pv_csrf cookie on mutating requests only", async () => {
    setCookie("pv_csrf", "tok-1");
    fetchMock.mockImplementation(async () => jsonResponse({ ok: true }));

    await api("/voices", { method: "POST", body: { name: "x" } });
    const [url, init] = fetchMock.mock.calls[0] as [string, RequestInit];
    expect(url).toBe("/api/v1/voices");
    expect((init.headers as Record<string, string>)["X-CSRF-Token"]).toBe("tok-1");
    expect((init.headers as Record<string, string>)["Content-Type"]).toBe("application/json");
    expect(init.credentials).toBe("include");
    expect(init.body).toBe(JSON.stringify({ name: "x" }));

    fetchMock.mockClear();
    await api("/voices");
    const [, getInit] = fetchMock.mock.calls[0] as [string, RequestInit];
    expect((getInit.headers as Record<string, string>)["X-CSRF-Token"]).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("fetches /auth/csrf once when the cookie is missing", async () => {
    fetchMock.mockImplementation(async (input) => {
      const url = String(input);
      if (url.endsWith("/auth/csrf")) {
        setCookie("pv_csrf", "fresh");
        return jsonResponse({ csrf_token: "fresh" });
      }
      return jsonResponse({ ok: true });
    });
    const token = await ensureCsrf();
    expect(token).toBe("fresh");
    await api("/generations", { method: "POST", body: { text: "hi" } });
    const calls = fetchMock.mock.calls.map((c) => String(c[0]));
    expect(calls.filter((u) => u.endsWith("/auth/csrf"))).toHaveLength(1);
    const post = fetchMock.mock.calls.find((c) => String(c[0]).endsWith("/generations")) as [string, RequestInit];
    expect((post[1].headers as Record<string, string>)["X-CSRF-Token"]).toBe("fresh");
  });

  it("parses the error envelope into ApiError", async () => {
    setCookie("pv_csrf", "t");
    fetchMock.mockResolvedValue(
      jsonResponse(
        {
          error: {
            code: "validation_error",
            message: "Some of the information is not valid.",
            details: { fields: [{ loc: ["body", "password"], msg: "Use at least 10 characters.", type: "value_error" }] },
          },
        },
        { status: 422 },
      ),
    );
    const err = await api("/auth/register", { method: "POST", body: {} }).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(isApiError(err)).toBe(true);
    const apiErr = err as ApiError;
    expect(apiErr.status).toBe(422);
    expect(apiErr.code).toBe("validation_error");
    expect(apiErr.message).toBe("Some of the information is not valid.");
    expect(apiErr.fieldErrors()).toEqual({ password: "Use at least 10 characters." });
  });

  it("falls back to a human message and Retry-After for 429 without a body", async () => {
    fetchMock.mockResolvedValue(new Response(null, { status: 429, headers: { "Retry-After": "7" } }));
    const err = (await api("/voices").catch((e: unknown) => e)) as ApiError;
    expect(err.status).toBe(429);
    expect(err.code).toBe("rate_limited");
    expect(err.retryAfter).toBe(7);
    expect(err.message).toContain("7s");
  });

  it("on 401 refreshes once (with CSRF) and retries the original request", async () => {
    setCookie("pv_csrf", "csrf-x");
    let voicesCalls = 0;
    fetchMock.mockImplementation(async (input, init) => {
      const url = String(input);
      if (url.endsWith("/voices")) {
        voicesCalls += 1;
        if (voicesCalls === 1) return jsonResponse({ error: { code: "unauthenticated" } }, { status: 401 });
        return jsonResponse({ items: [], total: 0, limit: 100, offset: 0 });
      }
      if (url.endsWith("/auth/refresh")) {
        expect(init?.method).toBe("POST");
        expect((init?.headers as Record<string, string>)["X-CSRF-Token"]).toBe("csrf-x");
        return jsonResponse({ user: { id: "u1" } });
      }
      throw new Error(`unexpected ${url}`);
    });
    const result = await api<{ total: number }>("/voices");
    expect(result.total).toBe(0);
    expect(voicesCalls).toBe(2);
    expect(fetchMock.mock.calls.some((c) => String(c[0]).endsWith("/auth/refresh"))).toBe(true);
  });

  it("calls the unauthenticated handler when refresh fails", async () => {
    setCookie("pv_csrf", "c");
    const handler = vi.fn();
    setUnauthenticatedHandler(handler);
    fetchMock.mockImplementation(async (input) => {
      const url = String(input);
      if (url.endsWith("/auth/refresh")) return jsonResponse({ error: { code: "unauthenticated" } }, { status: 401 });
      return jsonResponse({ error: { code: "unauthenticated" } }, { status: 401 });
    });
    const err = (await api("/users/me").catch((e: unknown) => e)) as ApiError;
    expect(err.status).toBe(401);
    expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("returns undefined for 204 responses", async () => {
    setCookie("pv_csrf", "c");
    fetchMock.mockResolvedValue(new Response(null, { status: 204 }));
    await expect(api("/voices/1", { method: "DELETE" })).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```

```typescript
/** Browser audio helpers shared by the recorder, uploader, player and conversation mode. */

export const ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS = ["wav", "mp3", "m4a", "flac", "ogg", "webm"] as const;
export const ACCEPT_ATTR = ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS.map((e) => `.${e}`).join(",") + ",audio/*";

export function fileExtension(name: string): string {
  const i = name.lastIndexOf(".");
  return i >= 0 ? name.slice(i + 1).toLowerCase() : "";
}

export function isAcceptedExtension(name: string): boolean {
  return (ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS as readonly string[]).includes(fileExtension(name));
}

type AudioContextCtor = typeof AudioContext;

export function getAudioContextCtor(): AudioContextCtor | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  const w = window as Window & { webkitAudioContext?: AudioContextCtor };
  return window.AudioContext ?? w.webkitAudioContext ?? null;
}

export interface DecodedInfo {
  duration: number;
  sampleRate: number;
  channels: number;
  /** Normalised peak magnitudes (0–1) for a static waveform. */
  peaks: Float32Array;
}

/** Compute `buckets` normalised peaks from an AudioBuffer (mono mix). */
export function computePeaks(buffer: AudioBuffer, buckets = 160): Float32Array {
  const channels = buffer.numberOfChannels;
  const length = buffer.length;
  const out = new Float32Array(buckets);
  if (length === 0) return out;
  const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(length / buckets));
  const data: Float32Array[] = [];
  for (let c = 0; c < channels; c++) data.push(buffer.getChannelData(c));
  let max = 0;
  for (let b = 0; b < buckets; b++) {
    const start = b * step;
    const end = Math.min(length, start + step);
    let peak = 0;
    for (let i = start; i < end; i += 4) {
      let v = 0;
      for (let c = 0; c < channels; c++) v += Math.abs(data[c]?.[i] ?? 0);
      v /= channels;
      if (v > peak) peak = v;
    }
    out[b] = peak;
    if (peak > max) max = peak;
  }
  if (max > 0) for (let b = 0; b < buckets; b++) out[b] = (out[b] ?? 0) / max;
  return out;
}

/** Decode a Blob with the Web Audio API. Throws when the browser cannot decode the format. */
export async function decodeAudio(blob: Blob, buckets = 160): Promise<DecodedInfo> {
  const Ctor = getAudioContextCtor();
  if (!Ctor) throw new Error("Web Audio is not supported in this browser.");
  const ctx = new Ctor();
  try {
    const bytes = await blob.arrayBuffer();
    const buffer = await ctx.decodeAudioData(bytes.slice(0));
    return {
      duration: buffer.duration,
      sampleRate: buffer.sampleRate,
      channels: buffer.numberOfChannels,
      peaks: computePeaks(buffer, buckets),
    };
  } finally {
    void ctx.close().catch(() => undefined);
  }
}

/** Pick the best supported MediaRecorder MIME type. */
export function pickRecorderMime(): { mimeType: string | undefined; extension: string } {
  if (typeof MediaRecorder === "undefined") return { mimeType: undefined, extension: "webm" };
  const candidates: [string, string][] = [
    ["audio/webm;codecs=opus", "webm"],
    ["audio/webm", "webm"],
    ["audio/mp4", "m4a"],
    ["audio/ogg;codecs=opus", "ogg"],
  ];
  for (const [mime, ext] of candidates) {
    try {
      if (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(mime)) return { mimeType: mime, extension: ext };
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }
  return { mimeType: undefined, extension: "webm" };
}

export function extensionForMime(mime: string): string {
  if (mime.includes("mp4") || mime.includes("aac")) return "m4a";
  if (mime.includes("ogg")) return "ogg";
  if (mime.includes("wav")) return "wav";
  if (mime.includes("mpeg")) return "mp3";
  if (mime.includes("flac")) return "flac";
  return "webm";
}

// --- Conversation-mode PCM helpers -----------------------------------------------------------

/** Linear-interpolation downsample of Float32 PCM to a target rate. */
export function downsample(input: Float32Array, inputRate: number, outputRate: number): Float32Array {
  if (inputRate === outputRate) return input;
  const ratio = inputRate / outputRate;
  const outLength = Math.max(0, Math.floor(input.length / ratio));
  const out = new Float32Array(outLength);
  for (let i = 0; i < outLength; i++) {
    const pos = i * ratio;
    const i0 = Math.floor(pos);
    const i1 = Math.min(input.length - 1, i0 + 1);
    const frac = pos - i0;
    const a = input[i0] ?? 0;
    const b = input[i1] ?? a;
    out[i] = a + (b - a) * frac;
  }
  return out;
}

export function floatToPcm16(input: Float32Array): ArrayBuffer {
  const buf = new ArrayBuffer(input.length * 2);
  const view = new DataView(buf);
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
    const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, input[i] ?? 0));
    view.setInt16(i * 2, s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7fff, true);
  }
  return buf;
}

export function pcm16ToFloat(buf: ArrayBuffer): Float32Array {
  const view = new DataView(buf);
  const n = Math.floor(buf.byteLength / 2);
  const out = new Float32Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = view.getInt16(i * 2, true) / 0x8000;
  return out;
}

/** RMS level 0–1 of a Float32 block. */
export function rms(input: Float32Array): number {
  if (input.length === 0) return 0;
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
    const v = input[i] ?? 0;
    sum += v * v;
  }
  return Math.sqrt(sum / input.length);
}

/** Split analyser time-domain data into five band-ish levels for the brand bars. */
export function levelsFromAnalyser(analyser: AnalyserNode, scratch: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>): number[] {
  analyser.getByteFrequencyData(scratch);
  const bands = 5;
  const usable = Math.floor(scratch.length * 0.6);
  const per = Math.max(1, Math.floor(usable / bands));
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (let b = 0; b < bands; b++) {
    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = b * per; i < (b + 1) * per; i++) sum += scratch[i] ?? 0;
    out.push(Math.min(1, sum / per / 180));
  }
  // Symmetric arrangement: centre gets the loudest band.
  const sorted = [...out].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return [sorted[0] ?? 0, sorted[2] ?? 0, sorted[4] ?? 0, sorted[3] ?? 0, sorted[1] ?? 0];
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { getAudioContextCtor, pickRecorderMime } from "./index";

export type RecorderState = "idle" | "requesting" | "recording" | "paused" | "stopped" | "denied" | "unsupported";

export interface Recording {
  blob: Blob;
  mimeType: string;
  extension: string;
  /** Measured wall-clock seconds of recording (excluding pauses). */
  duration: number;
  url: string;
}

export interface UseRecorder {
  state: RecorderState;
  elapsed: number;
  analyser: AnalyserNode | null;
  recording: Recording | null;
  error: string | null;
  canPause: boolean;
  start: () => Promise<void>;
  pause: () => void;
  resume: () => void;
  stop: () => void;
  reset: () => void;
}

export function isRecordingSupported(): boolean {
  return (
    typeof window !== "undefined" &&
    typeof MediaRecorder !== "undefined" &&
    typeof navigator !== "undefined" &&
    Boolean(navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia)
  );
}

/** Real MediaRecorder-based capture with an AnalyserNode for the live level meter. */
export function useRecorder(): UseRecorder {
  const [state, setState] = useState<RecorderState>("idle");
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const [analyser, setAnalyser] = useState<AnalyserNode | null>(null);
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState<Recording | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const recorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const ctxRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const chunksRef = useRef<BlobPart[]>([]);
  const startedAtRef = useRef(0);
  const accumulatedRef = useRef(0);
  const timerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const mimeRef = useRef<{ mimeType: string | undefined; extension: string }>({ mimeType: undefined, extension: "webm" });
  const urlRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isRecordingSupported()) setState("unsupported");
  }, []);

  const clearTimer = useCallback(() => {
    if (timerRef.current != null) {
      window.clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  const currentElapsed = useCallback(
    () => accumulatedRef.current + (startedAtRef.current ? (performance.now() - startedAtRef.current) / 1000 : 0),
    [],
  );

  const startTimer = useCallback(() => {
    clearTimer();
    timerRef.current = window.setInterval(() => setElapsed(currentElapsed()), 200);
  }, [clearTimer, currentElapsed]);

  const teardownStream = useCallback(() => {
    clearTimer();
    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    streamRef.current = null;
    void ctxRef.current?.close().catch(() => undefined);
    ctxRef.current = null;
    setAnalyser(null);
  }, [clearTimer]);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    teardownStream();
    recorderRef.current = null;
    chunksRef.current = [];
    accumulatedRef.current = 0;
    startedAtRef.current = 0;
    if (urlRef.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(urlRef.current);
    urlRef.current = null;
    setRecording(null);
    setElapsed(0);
    setError(null);
    setState(isRecordingSupported() ? "idle" : "unsupported");
  }, [teardownStream]);

  const start = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isRecordingSupported()) {
      setState("unsupported");
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setState("requesting");
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        audio: { echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true, autoGainControl: true, channelCount: 1 },
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;

      const Ctor = getAudioContextCtor();
      if (Ctor) {
        const ctx = new Ctor();
        const source = ctx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
        const node = ctx.createAnalyser();
        node.fftSize = 256;
        node.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.6;
        source.connect(node);
        ctxRef.current = ctx;
        setAnalyser(node);
      }

      const mime = pickRecorderMime();
      mimeRef.current = mime;
      const recorder = mime.mimeType ? new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType: mime.mimeType }) : new MediaRecorder(stream);
      chunksRef.current = [];
      recorder.ondataavailable = (ev) => {
        if (ev.data && ev.data.size > 0) chunksRef.current.push(ev.data);
      };
      recorder.onstop = () => {
        const type = recorder.mimeType || mime.mimeType || "audio/webm";
        const blob = new Blob(chunksRef.current, { type });
        if (urlRef.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(urlRef.current);
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        urlRef.current = url;
        setRecording({
          blob,
          mimeType: type,
          extension: mime.extension,
          duration: currentElapsed(),
          url,
        });
        startedAtRef.current = 0;
        setState("stopped");
        teardownStream();
      };
      recorder.onerror = () => {
        setError("Recording stopped unexpectedly. Please try again.");
        setState("idle");
        teardownStream();
      };
      recorderRef.current = recorder;
      recorder.start(250);
      accumulatedRef.current = 0;
      startedAtRef.current = performance.now();
      setElapsed(0);
      startTimer();
      setState("recording");
    } catch (e) {
      teardownStream();
      const name = e instanceof Error ? e.name : "";
      if (name === "NotAllowedError" || name === "SecurityError") {
        setState("denied");
        setError("Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or upload a recording instead.");
      } else if (name === "NotFoundError" || name === "OverconstrainedError") {
        setState("idle");
        setError("No microphone was found. Connect one, or upload a recording instead.");
      } else {
        setState("idle");
        setError("We could not start recording. Please try again or upload a recording.");
      }
    }
  }, [teardownStream, startTimer, currentElapsed]);

  const canPause = typeof MediaRecorder !== "undefined" && typeof MediaRecorder.prototype.pause === "function";

  const pause = useCallback(() => {
    const r = recorderRef.current;
    if (!r || r.state !== "recording" || !canPause) return;
    r.pause();
    accumulatedRef.current = currentElapsed();
    startedAtRef.current = 0;
    clearTimer();
    setElapsed(accumulatedRef.current);
    setState("paused");
  }, [canPause, clearTimer, currentElapsed]);

  const resume = useCallback(() => {
    const r = recorderRef.current;
    if (!r || r.state !== "paused") return;
    r.resume();
    startedAtRef.current = performance.now();
    startTimer();
    setState("recording");
  }, [startTimer]);

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    const r = recorderRef.current;
    if (!r || r.state === "inactive") return;
    if (r.state === "paused") {
      // Keep accumulated time; nothing more to add.
    } else {
      accumulatedRef.current = currentElapsed();
      startedAtRef.current = 0;
    }
    clearTimer();
    setElapsed(accumulatedRef.current);
    r.stop();
  }, [clearTimer, currentElapsed]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current != null) window.clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      void ctxRef.current?.close().catch(() => undefined);
      if (urlRef.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(urlRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  return { state, elapsed, analyser, recording, error, canPause, start, pause, resume, stop, reset };
}
```
