```typescript
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { conversationWsUrl } from "@/lib/api/resources";
import type { ConversationServerMessage, ConversationState } from "@/lib/api/types";
import { downsample, floatToPcm16, getAudioContextCtor, pcm16ToFloat, rms } from "@/lib/audio";

export type SocketStatus = "disconnected" | "connecting" | "connected" | "reconnecting" | "closed";

export interface Turn {
  id: number;
  transcript: string;
  response: string;
}

export interface ConversationHandle {
  socket: SocketStatus;
  state: ConversationState;
  turns: Turn[];
  live: { transcript: string; response: string };
  error: { code: string; message: string } | null;
  micAnalyser: AnalyserNode | null;
  outAnalyser: AnalyserNode | null;
  reconnectAttempt: number;
  start: () => Promise<void>;
  stop: () => void;
  endTurn: () => void;
  interrupt: () => void;
}

const TARGET_RATE = 16_000;
const SEND_SAMPLES = Math.round(TARGET_RATE * 0.1); // 100 ms frames
const BARGE_IN_RMS = 0.06;
const BARGE_IN_BLOCKS = 4;
const MAX_RECONNECTS = 6;
const FATAL_CLOSE_CODES = new Set([1000, 4001, 4004]);

const WORKLET_SOURCE = `
class PVCapture extends AudioWorkletProcessor {
  constructor() { super(); this.buf = []; this.len = 0; }
  process(inputs) {
    const ch = inputs[0] && inputs[0][0];
    if (ch) {
      this.buf.push(ch.slice(0));
      this.len += ch.length;
      if (this.len >= 2048) {
        const out = new Float32Array(this.len);
        let o = 0;
        for (const b of this.buf) { out.set(b, o); o += b.length; }
        this.port.postMessage(out, [out.buffer]);
        this.buf = []; this.len = 0;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }
}
registerProcessor("pv-capture", PVCapture);
`;

function closeMessage(code: number): { code: string; message: string } {
  switch (code) {
    case 4001:
      return { code: "unauthenticated", message: "Your session has expired. Sign in again." };
    case 4004:
      return { code: "voice_unavailable", message: "That voice is not ready for conversation." };
    case 4008:
      return { code: "turn_timeout", message: "The turn timed out. Reconnecting." };
    case 1011:
      return { code: "engine_unavailable", message: "The conversation engine is not available on this server." };
    default:
      return { code: `ws_close_${code}`, message: "The connection closed." };
  }
}

export function useConversation(opts: { voiceId: string | null; engine: string; language?: string }): ConversationHandle {
  const [socket, setSocket] = useState<SocketStatus>("disconnected");
  const [state, setState] = useState<ConversationState>("idle");
  const [turns, setTurns] = useState<Turn[]>([]);
  const [live, setLive] = useState({ transcript: "", response: "" });
  const [error, setError] = useState<{ code: string; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [micAnalyser, setMicAnalyser] = useState<AnalyserNode | null>(null);
  const [outAnalyser, setOutAnalyser] = useState<AnalyserNode | null>(null);
  const [reconnectAttempt, setReconnectAttempt] = useState(0);

  const wsRef = useRef<WebSocket | null>(null);
  const ctxRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const captureNodeRef = useRef<AudioNode | null>(null);
  const outGainRef = useRef<GainNode | null>(null);
  const pendingRef = useRef<Float32Array[]>([]);
  const pendingLenRef = useRef(0);
  const playbackRateRef = useRef(24_000);
  const nextPlayAtRef = useRef(0);
  const sourcesRef = useRef<Set<AudioBufferSourceNode>>(new Set());
  const stateRef = useRef<ConversationState>("idle");
  const loudBlocksRef = useRef(0);
  const userStoppedRef = useRef(false);
  const reconnectTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const attemptsRef = useRef(0);
  const turnIdRef = useRef(0);
  const liveRef = useRef({ transcript: "", response: "" });
  const optsRef = useRef(opts);
  optsRef.current = opts;

  const setConvState = (s: ConversationState) => {
    stateRef.current = s;
    setState(s);
  };

  const stopPlayback = useCallback(() => {
    for (const src of sourcesRef.current) {
      try {
        src.stop();
      } catch {
        /* already stopped */
      }
    }
    sourcesRef.current.clear();
    nextPlayAtRef.current = 0;
  }, []);

  const sendJson = useCallback((msg: object) => {
    const ws = wsRef.current;
    if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) ws.send(JSON.stringify(msg));
  }, []);

  const interrupt = useCallback(() => {
    stopPlayback();
    sendJson({ type: "interrupt" });
    setConvState("listening");
  }, [stopPlayback, sendJson]);

  const playFrame = useCallback((buf: ArrayBuffer) => {
    const ctx = ctxRef.current;
    const gain = outGainRef.current;
    if (!ctx || !gain) return;
    const floats = pcm16ToFloat(buf);
    if (floats.length === 0) return;
    const rate = playbackRateRef.current;
    const audio = ctx.createBuffer(1, floats.length, rate);
    audio.copyToChannel(floats as Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>, 0);
    const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = audio;
    src.connect(gain);
    const now = ctx.currentTime;
    const startAt = Math.max(now + 0.02, nextPlayAtRef.current);
    src.start(startAt);
    nextPlayAtRef.current = startAt + audio.duration;
    sourcesRef.current.add(src);
    src.onended = () => sourcesRef.current.delete(src);
  }, []);

  const handleMessage = useCallback(
    (msg: ConversationServerMessage) => {
      switch (msg.type) {
        case "state":
          setConvState(msg.state);
          if (msg.state === "listening") {
            // A new turn begins once the previous one was spoken.
            if (liveRef.current.transcript || liveRef.current.response) {
              const t = { id: ++turnIdRef.current, ...liveRef.current };
              setTurns((prev) => [...prev, t]);
              liveRef.current = { transcript: "", response: "" };
              setLive(liveRef.current);
            }
          }
          break;
        case "transcript":
          liveRef.current = { ...liveRef.current, transcript: msg.text };
          setLive(liveRef.current);
          break;
        case "response":
          liveRef.current = { ...liveRef.current, response: msg.text };
          setLive(liveRef.current);
          break;
        case "audio_start":
          playbackRateRef.current = msg.sample_rate || 24_000;
          nextPlayAtRef.current = 0;
          break;
        case "audio_end":
          break;
        case "error":
          setError({ code: msg.code, message: msg.message ?? "Something went wrong." });
          break;
      }
    },
    [],
  );

  const flushPending = useCallback(() => {
    const ws = wsRef.current;
    if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
      pendingRef.current = [];
      pendingLenRef.current = 0;
      return;
    }
    while (pendingLenRef.current >= SEND_SAMPLES) {
      const out = new Float32Array(SEND_SAMPLES);
      let filled = 0;
      while (filled < SEND_SAMPLES && pendingRef.current.length > 0) {
        const head = pendingRef.current[0]!;
        const take = Math.min(head.length, SEND_SAMPLES - filled);
        out.set(head.subarray(0, take), filled);
        filled += take;
        if (take === head.length) pendingRef.current.shift();
        else pendingRef.current[0] = head.subarray(take);
      }
      pendingLenRef.current -= SEND_SAMPLES;
      ws.send(floatToPcm16(out));
    }
  }, []);

  const onCapture = useCallback(
    (block: Float32Array, inputRate: number) => {
      // Barge-in: sustained speech while the assistant is speaking interrupts it.
      if (stateRef.current === "speaking") {
        if (rms(block) > BARGE_IN_RMS) {
          loudBlocksRef.current += 1;
          if (loudBlocksRef.current >= BARGE_IN_BLOCKS) {
            loudBlocksRef.current = 0;
            interrupt();
          }
        } else {
          loudBlocksRef.current = 0;
        }
      } else {
        loudBlocksRef.current = 0;
      }
      const ds = downsample(block, inputRate, TARGET_RATE);
      pendingRef.current.push(ds);
      pendingLenRef.current += ds.length;
      flushPending();
    },
    [flushPending, interrupt],
  );

  const connect = useCallback(() => {
    const { voiceId, engine, language } = optsRef.current;
    if (!voiceId) return;
    if (reconnectTimerRef.current != null) {
      window.clearTimeout(reconnectTimerRef.current);
      reconnectTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    setSocket(attemptsRef.current > 0 ? "reconnecting" : "connecting");
    const ws = new WebSocket(conversationWsUrl(voiceId, engine, language));
    ws.binaryType = "arraybuffer";
    wsRef.current = ws;

    ws.onopen = () => {
      attemptsRef.current = 0;
      setReconnectAttempt(0);
      setSocket("connected");
      setError(null);
      ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: "start" }));
      setConvState("listening");
    };
    ws.onmessage = (ev) => {
      if (ev.data instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
        playFrame(ev.data);
        return;
      }
      try {
        handleMessage(JSON.parse(String(ev.data)) as ConversationServerMessage);
      } catch {
        /* ignore malformed frames */
      }
    };
    ws.onerror = () => {
      /* onclose follows with the code */
    };
    ws.onclose = (ev) => {
      if (wsRef.current !== ws) return;
      wsRef.current = null;
      stopPlayback();
      setConvState("idle");
      if (userStoppedRef.current || FATAL_CLOSE_CODES.has(ev.code)) {
        if (!userStoppedRef.current) setError(closeMessage(ev.code));
        setSocket("closed");
        return;
      }
      if (attemptsRef.current >= MAX_RECONNECTS) {
        setError({ code: "reconnect_failed", message: "Could not reconnect. Check your connection and start again." });
        setSocket("closed");
        return;
      }
      if (ev.code === 4008 || ev.code === 1011) setError(closeMessage(ev.code));
      attemptsRef.current += 1;
      setReconnectAttempt(attemptsRef.current);
      setSocket("reconnecting");
      const delay = Math.min(15_000, 1000 * 2 ** (attemptsRef.current - 1));
      reconnectTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(connect, delay);
    };
  }, [handleMessage, playFrame, stopPlayback]);

  const teardownAudio = useCallback(() => {
    captureNodeRef.current?.disconnect();
    captureNodeRef.current = null;
    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    streamRef.current = null;
    stopPlayback();
    void ctxRef.current?.close().catch(() => undefined);
    ctxRef.current = null;
    outGainRef.current = null;
    setMicAnalyser(null);
    setOutAnalyser(null);
    pendingRef.current = [];
    pendingLenRef.current = 0;
  }, [stopPlayback]);

  const start = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!optsRef.current.voiceId) return;
    userStoppedRef.current = false;
    attemptsRef.current = 0;
    setError(null);
    setTurns([]);
    liveRef.current = { transcript: "", response: "" };
    setLive(liveRef.current);

    const Ctor = getAudioContextCtor();
    if (!Ctor || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      setError({ code: "unsupported", message: "This browser does not support live audio." });
      return;
    }
    let stream: MediaStream;
    try {
      stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        audio: { echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true, autoGainControl: true, channelCount: 1 },
      });
    } catch (e) {
      const name = e instanceof Error ? e.name : "";
      setError(
        name === "NotAllowedError"
          ? { code: "microphone_denied", message: "Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser settings." }
          : { code: "microphone_unavailable", message: "No microphone could be opened." },
      );
      return;
    }
    streamRef.current = stream;
    const ctx = new Ctor();
    ctxRef.current = ctx;
    if (ctx.state === "suspended") await ctx.resume().catch(() => undefined);

    // Output chain: sources → gain → analyser → speakers.
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    const outA = ctx.createAnalyser();
    outA.fftSize = 256;
    gain.connect(outA);
    outA.connect(ctx.destination);
    outGainRef.current = gain;
    setOutAnalyser(outA);

    // Input chain: mic → analyser (meter) and → capture node (PCM frames).
    const source = ctx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    const micA = ctx.createAnalyser();
    micA.fftSize = 256;
    source.connect(micA);
    setMicAnalyser(micA);

    let captureNode: AudioNode | null = null;
    if (ctx.audioWorklet) {
      try {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([WORKLET_SOURCE], { type: "application/javascript" }));
        await ctx.audioWorklet.addModule(url);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        const node = new AudioWorkletNode(ctx, "pv-capture", { numberOfInputs: 1, numberOfOutputs: 0, channelCount: 1 });
        node.port.onmessage = (ev: MessageEvent<Float32Array>) => onCapture(ev.data, ctx.sampleRate);
        source.connect(node);
        captureNode = node;
      } catch {
        captureNode = null;
      }
    }
    if (!captureNode) {
      // Fallback: ScriptProcessor (deprecated but widely available).
      const sp = ctx.createScriptProcessor(4096, 1, 1);
      sp.onaudioprocess = (ev) => onCapture(ev.inputBuffer.getChannelData(0).slice(0), ctx.sampleRate);
      source.connect(sp);
      const mute = ctx.createGain();
      mute.gain.value = 0;
      sp.connect(mute);
      mute.connect(ctx.destination);
      captureNode = sp;
    }
    captureNodeRef.current = captureNode;

    connect();
  }, [connect, onCapture]);

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    userStoppedRef.current = true;
    if (reconnectTimerRef.current != null) {
      window.clearTimeout(reconnectTimerRef.current);
      reconnectTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    const ws = wsRef.current;
    wsRef.current = null;
    if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      try {
        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: "stop" }));
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
      ws.close(1000, "client stop");
    } else {
      ws?.close();
    }
    teardownAudio();
    setConvState("idle");
    setSocket("disconnected");
    setReconnectAttempt(0);
  }, [teardownAudio]);

  const endTurn = useCallback(() => {
    flushPending();
    sendJson({ type: "stop" });
  }, [flushPending, sendJson]);

  useEffect(() => () => stop(), [stop]);

  return { socket, state, turns, live, error, micAnalyser, outAnalyser, reconnectAttempt, start, stop, endTurn, interrupt };
}
```

## frontend/src/lib/__tests__/format.test.ts

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { excerpt, formatBytes, formatDuration, formatMegabytes, formatRelative, formatRtf, formatSeconds } from "@/lib/format";

describe("formatDuration", () => {
  it("formats seconds as m:ss", () => {
    expect(formatDuration(0)).toBe("0:00");
    expect(formatDuration(8.085)).toBe("0:08");
    expect(formatDuration(90.003)).toBe("1:30");
    expect(formatDuration(3725)).toBe("1:02:05");
  });
  it("handles bad input", () => {
    expect(formatDuration(null)).toBe("0:00");
    expect(formatDuration(Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)).toBe("0:00");
    expect(formatDuration(-5)).toBe("0:00");
  });
});

describe("formatBytes / formatMegabytes", () => {
  it("scales units", () => {
    expect(formatBytes(512)).toBe("512 B");
    expect(formatBytes(388274)).toBe("379 KB");
    expect(formatBytes(25 * 1024 * 1024)).toBe("25 MB");
    expect(formatBytes(null)).toBe("—");
    expect(formatMegabytes(2048)).toBe("2.0 GB");
    expect(formatMegabytes(512)).toBe("512 MB");
  });
});

describe("formatSeconds / formatRtf", () => {
  it("rounds to one decimal and marks unknowns", () => {
    expect(formatSeconds(11.2337)).toBe("11.2 s");
    expect(formatSeconds(null)).toBe("—");
    expect(formatRtf(1.3893)).toBe("1.39×");
    expect(formatRtf(null)).toBe("—");
  });
});

describe("formatRelative", () => {
  const now = Date.parse("2026-11-09T12:00:00Z");
  it("describes heartbeats", () => {
    expect(formatRelative("2026-11-09T11:59:58Z", now)).toBe("just now");
    expect(formatRelative("2026-11-09T11:59:18Z", now)).toBe("42 s ago");
    expect(formatRelative("2026-11-09T11:57:00Z", now)).toBe("3 min ago");
    expect(formatRelative(null, now)).toBe("never");
  });
});

describe("excerpt", () => {
  it("collapses whitespace and truncates with an ellipsis", () => {
    expect(excerpt("hello   world")).toBe("hello world");
    const long = "a".repeat(200);
    expect(excerpt(long, 50)).toHaveLength(50);
    expect(excerpt(long, 50).endsWith("…")).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

## frontend/src/lib/__tests__/stages.test.ts

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { generationStageText, jobStageText, progressFraction } from "@/lib/stages";

describe("generationStageText", () => {
  it("uses the real progress object, never a fake percentage", () => {
    expect(generationStageText({ status: "queued", progress: null })).toBe("Queued");
    expect(generationStageText({ status: "processing", progress: null })).toBe("Processing");
    expect(generationStageText({ status: "processing", progress: { stage: "load_model", current: 0, total: 1 } })).toBe("Loading model");
    expect(generationStageText({ status: "processing", progress: { stage: "synthesize", current: 2, total: 4 } })).toBe("Synthesising 2 of 4");
    expect(generationStageText({ status: "processing", progress: { stage: "encode", current: 0, total: 1 } })).toBe("Encoding");
    expect(generationStageText({ status: "completed", progress: { stage: "done", current: 1, total: 1 } })).toBe("");
  });
  it("humanises unknown stages", () => {
    expect(generationStageText({ status: "processing", progress: { stage: "post_process", current: 0, total: 1 } })).toBe("Post process");
  });
});

describe("jobStageText", () => {
  it("maps voice job stages observed in the e2e log", () => {
    expect(jobStageText({ status: "running", progress: { stage: "analyse", current: 0, total: 1 } })).toBe("Analysing quality");
    expect(jobStageText({ status: "running", progress: { stage: "transcribe", current: 0, total: 1 } })).toBe("Transcribing");
    expect(jobStageText({ status: "completed", progress: { stage: "done", current: 1, total: 1 } })).toBe("Finishing up");
    expect(jobStageText({ status: "queued", progress: null })).toBe("Queued");
    expect(jobStageText(undefined, "Starting")).toBe("Starting");
  });
});

describe("progressFraction", () => {
  it("returns current/total clamped, or null when unknown", () => {
    expect(progressFraction({ stage: "synthesize", current: 2, total: 4 })).toBe(0.5);
    expect(progressFraction({ stage: "x", current: 9, total: 4 })).toBe(1);
    expect(progressFraction({ stage: "x", current: 0, total: 0 })).toBeNull();
    expect(progressFraction(null)).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

## frontend/src/lib/__tests__/store.test.ts

```typescript
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { STORE_KEY, useAppStore } from "@/lib/store";

describe("app store", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    useAppStore.setState({ selectedVoiceId: null, mode: "simple" });
  });

  it("holds the selected voice and mode", () => {
    useAppStore.getState().setSelectedVoiceId("v1");
    useAppStore.getState().setMode("advanced");
    expect(useAppStore.getState().selectedVoiceId).toBe("v1");
    expect(useAppStore.getState().mode).toBe("advanced");
  });

  it("persists only selectedVoiceId and mode to localStorage", () => {
    useAppStore.getState().setSelectedVoiceId("v2");
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY);
    expect(raw).toBeTruthy();
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw as string) as { state: Record<string, unknown> };
    expect(parsed.state).toEqual({ selectedVoiceId: "v2", mode: "simple" });
  });
});
```

```css
/* PROJECT VOICE — design tokens (docs/DESIGN.md §1). Never hard-code hex values in components. */
:root {
  /* Surfaces — warm paper */

  --pv-surface: #FBFAF7;
  --pv-surface-2: #EEEAE2;
  --pv-border: #D9D3C8;
  --pv-border-strong: #B9B1A3;

  /* Ink */
  --pv-ink: #141414;
  --pv-ink-2: #4A4843;

  /* The single accent — signal red-orange, used sparingly */
  --pv-accent: #E4572E;
  --pv-accent-hover: #CC4A24;
  --pv-accent-soft: #F8DED3;
  --pv-on-accent: #FFF8F4;

}
```

## infra/caddy/Caddyfile

```caddyfile
# PROJECT VOICE — Caddy reverse proxy, DEVELOPMENT (docker-compose.yml).
# Plain HTTP on :80, automatic HTTPS disabled. Production uses Caddyfile.prod.
#
# Routing:  /api/*  → api:8000      (REST + the conversation WebSocket; upgrades pass through)
#           /*      → frontend:3000 (Next.js)
# The browser only talks to this origin, so auth cookies stay first-party and the API's CSRF
# double-submit cookie works unchanged. No secrets live here; every value is an env placeholder.

{
	auto_https off
	admin off
	servers {
		trusted_proxies static private_ranges
	}
}

import snippets.caddy

:80 {
	import app_routes
}

```

## infra/caddy/Caddyfile.prod

```
# PROJECT VOICE — Caddy reverse proxy, PRODUCTION (docker-compose.prod.yml).
# Automatic HTTPS (Let's Encrypt / ZeroSSL) for {$DOMAIN}; :80 redirects to HTTPS automatically.
# Required env: DOMAIN (public host name with DNS pointing at this machine), ACME_EMAIL.
# Certificates persist in the caddy_data volume.

{
	email {$ACME_EMAIL}
	admin off
	servers {
		trusted_proxies static private_ranges
	}
}

import snippets.caddy

{$DOMAIN} {
	import app_routes
	header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"
}
```

## infra/caddy/snippets.caddy

```
# Shared routing + security headers for both Caddyfiles (imported, never served directly).

(security_headers) {
	header {
		X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
		X-Frame-Options "DENY"
		Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
		Permissions-Policy "camera=(), geolocation=(), microphone=(self), payment=()"
		-Server
		-X-Powered-By
	}
}

(app_routes) {
	import security_headers

	# Reference uploads are capped by the API (PV_MAX_UPLOAD_MB, default 25 MB). Allow headroom
	# for multipart framing so the API — not the proxy — returns the size error (default 32 MB).
	request_body {
		max_size {$CADDY_MAX_BODY:32MB}
	}

	encode zstd gzip

	@api path /api/*
	handle @api {
		reverse_proxy {$API_UPSTREAM:api:8000} {
			# WebSocket upgrades are proxied transparently. Long-lived conversation sockets and
			# slow CPU synthesis need generous timeouts; streaming responses must not buffer.
			flush_interval -1
			transport http {
				dial_timeout 10s
				read_timeout 0
				write_timeout 0
				response_header_timeout 600s
			}
		}
	}

	handle {
		reverse_proxy {$FRONTEND_UPSTREAM:frontend:3000} {
			flush_interval -1
		}
	}

	log {
		output stdout
		format json
	}
}
```

## infra/scripts/backup.sh

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PROJECT VOICE — backup: PostgreSQL (pg_dump custom format) + the local storage directory.
#
# Produces  <BACKUP_ROOT>/<UTC timestamp>/
#             db.dump          pg_dump -Fc (compressed, restorable with pg_restore)
#             storage.tar.gz   PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR (only when the local backend is used)
#             manifest.json    what was backed up, sizes, sha256, row counts for verification
# and keeps the newest RETENTION snapshots (default 7), deleting older ones.
#
# Configuration (env or flags):
#   PV_DATABASE_URL   SQLAlchemy or libpq URL (postgresql+asyncpg://… is normalised)   [required]
#   PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR   directory to archive (skip with --no-storage or when backend is s3)
#   BACKUP_ROOT       where snapshots go (default ./backups)
#   RETENTION         snapshots to keep (default 7; 0 = keep everything)
#   PG_DUMP / PG_CONTAINER   pg_dump binary, or a docker compose service name to exec it in
#
# Usage:
#   infra/scripts/backup.sh [--root DIR] [--retention N] [--no-storage] [--db-only]
#   docker compose exec … is NOT required: run it from the host with the database port reachable,
#   or set PG_CONTAINER=postgres to pg_dump inside the compose Postgres container.
#
# S3 deployments: object storage is backed up by bucket versioning / replication (MinIO `mc
# mirror`), not by this script; see docs/BACKUP_AND_RECOVERY.md.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
BACKUP_ROOT="${BACKUP_ROOT:-$ROOT_DIR/backups}"
RETENTION="${RETENTION:-7}"
INCLUDE_STORAGE=1
PG_DUMP="${PG_DUMP:-pg_dump}"
PG_CONTAINER="${PG_CONTAINER:-}"

usage() { sed -n '2,25p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit "${1:-0}"; }

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --root) BACKUP_ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --retention) RETENTION="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --no-storage|--db-only) INCLUDE_STORAGE=0; shift ;;
    -h|--help) usage 0 ;;
    *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; usage 1 ;;
  esac
done

# Load .env from the repo root when present (never printed).
if [[ -f "$ROOT_DIR/.env" ]]; then
  set -a; # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  . "$ROOT_DIR/.env"; set +a
fi

: "${PV_DATABASE_URL:?PV_DATABASE_URL is required (e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db)}"
# SQLAlchemy driver suffixes are not understood by libpq.
LIBPQ_URL="${PV_DATABASE_URL/postgresql+asyncpg:\/\//postgresql://}"
LIBPQ_URL="${LIBPQ_URL/postgresql+psycopg:\/\//postgresql://}"
STORAGE_DIR="${PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR:-$ROOT_DIR/storage}"
STORAGE_BACKEND="${PV_STORAGE_BACKEND:-local}"

STAMP="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
DEST="$BACKUP_ROOT/$STAMP"
mkdir -p "$DEST"
log() { printf '[backup %s] %s\n' "$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)" "$*"; }

run_pg() {  # run a postgres client command, locally or inside the compose container
  if [[ -n "$PG_CONTAINER" ]]; then
    docker compose exec -T "$PG_CONTAINER" "$@"
  else
    "$@"
  fi
}

# ---- 1. database ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "pg_dump → $DEST/db.dump"
run_pg "$PG_DUMP" --format=custom --compress=6 --no-owner --no-privileges --dbname="$LIBPQ_URL" > "$DEST/db.dump"
DB_BYTES=$(stat -c %s "$DEST/db.dump")
[[ "$DB_BYTES" -gt 0 ]] || { echo "pg_dump produced an empty file" >&2; exit 1; }

# Row counts for the manifest (used by restore.sh --verify).
COUNTS_SQL="SELECT json_object_agg(relname, n) FROM (
  SELECT c.relname, (xpath('/row/cnt/text()', query_to_xml(format('select count(*) as cnt from %I.%I', n.nspname, c.relname), false, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint AS n
  FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE c.relkind = 'r' AND n.nspname = 'public') t;"
ROW_COUNTS=$(run_pg psql --no-psqlrc --tuples-only --no-align --dbname="$LIBPQ_URL" -c "$COUNTS_SQL" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[[ -n "$ROW_COUNTS" ]] || ROW_COUNTS='{}'

# ---- 2. storage ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
STORAGE_BYTES=0; STORAGE_FILES=0; STORAGE_NOTE="skipped"
if [[ "$INCLUDE_STORAGE" == 1 && "$STORAGE_BACKEND" == "local" ]]; then
  if [[ -d "$STORAGE_DIR" ]]; then
    log "tar → $DEST/storage.tar.gz (from $STORAGE_DIR)"
    tar --create --gzip --file "$DEST/storage.tar.gz" --directory "$STORAGE_DIR" .
    STORAGE_BYTES=$(stat -c %s "$DEST/storage.tar.gz")
    STORAGE_FILES=$(find "$STORAGE_DIR" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    STORAGE_NOTE="archived"
  else
    log "storage dir $STORAGE_DIR does not exist; skipping"
    STORAGE_NOTE="missing"
  fi
elif [[ "$STORAGE_BACKEND" != "local" ]]; then
  STORAGE_NOTE="backend=$STORAGE_BACKEND (object store is backed up separately)"
fi

# ---- 3. manifest ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sha() { sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; }
STORAGE_SHA=""; [[ -f "$DEST/storage.tar.gz" ]] && STORAGE_SHA=$(sha "$DEST/storage.tar.gz")
cat > "$DEST/manifest.json" <<JSON
{
  "created_at": "$STAMP",
  "host": "$(hostname)",
  "database": {"file": "db.dump", "bytes": $DB_BYTES, "sha256": "$(sha "$DEST/db.dump")", "format": "pg_dump custom", "row_counts": $ROW_COUNTS},
  "storage": {"file": "storage.tar.gz", "bytes": $STORAGE_BYTES, "files": $STORAGE_FILES, "sha256": "$STORAGE_SHA", "source": "$STORAGE_DIR", "status": "$STORAGE_NOTE"},
  "alembic_version": "$(run_pg psql --no-psqlrc -tA --dbname="$LIBPQ_URL" -c 'select version_num from alembic_version' | tr -d '[:space:]')"
}
JSON
log "manifest: $(tr -d '\n' < "$DEST/manifest.json" | sed 's/  */ /g' | cut -c1-400)"

# ---- 4. retention --------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ "$RETENTION" -gt 0 ]]; then
  mapfile -t SNAPSHOTS < <(find "$BACKUP_ROOT" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '20*Z' | sort)
  EXCESS=$(( ${#SNAPSHOTS[@]} - RETENTION ))
  if (( EXCESS > 0 )); then
    for old in "${SNAPSHOTS[@]:0:EXCESS}"; do
      log "retention: removing $old"
      rm -rf -- "$old"
    done
  fi
fi

log "done: $DEST (db ${DB_BYTES} B, storage ${STORAGE_BYTES} B, keeping newest ${RETENTION})"
echo "$DEST"

```

## infra/scripts/restore.sh

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PROJECT VOICE — restore a snapshot made by backup.sh (database + local storage directory).
#
# DESTRUCTIVE: the target database's public schema is dropped and recreated, and the storage
# directory is replaced. The script refuses to run without --yes.
#
# Usage:
#   infra/scripts/restore.sh <snapshot dir> --yes [--database-url URL] [--storage-dir DIR]
#                            [--db-only] [--storage-only] [--verify]
#
#   --database-url  target DB (default PV_DATABASE_URL from env/.env). Point it at a scratch
#                   database such as projectvoice_restore_test to rehearse a restore safely.
#   --storage-dir   where storage.tar.gz is unpacked (default PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR). The existing
#                   directory is moved aside to <dir>.pre-restore-<stamp> first.
#   --verify        after restoring, compare table row counts with the manifest and exit non-zero
#                   on any mismatch.
#   PG_RESTORE / PSQL / PG_CONTAINER   client binaries, or a compose service to exec them in.
#
# Procedure: stop api + worker first (docker compose stop api worker), restore, run
# `alembic upgrade head` (no-op when the snapshot is at head), start again.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
PG_RESTORE="${PG_RESTORE:-pg_restore}"
PSQL="${PSQL:-psql}"
PG_CONTAINER="${PG_CONTAINER:-}"
YES=0; DB_ONLY=0; STORAGE_ONLY=0; VERIFY=0
SNAPSHOT=""; DATABASE_URL=""; STORAGE_DIR=""

usage() { sed -n '2,22p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit "${1:-0}"; }

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --yes) YES=1; shift ;;
    --database-url) DATABASE_URL="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --storage-dir) STORAGE_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --db-only) DB_ONLY=1; shift ;;
    --storage-only) STORAGE_ONLY=1; shift ;;
    --verify) VERIFY=1; shift ;;
    -h|--help) usage 0 ;;
    -*) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; usage 1 ;;
    *) SNAPSHOT="$1"; shift ;;
  esac
done

[[ -n "$SNAPSHOT" ]] || { echo "snapshot directory required" >&2; usage 1; }
[[ -f "$SNAPSHOT/manifest.json" ]] || { echo "$SNAPSHOT has no manifest.json (not a backup.sh snapshot)" >&2; exit 1; }
if [[ "$YES" != 1 ]]; then
  echo "REFUSING: restore is destructive (drops the target schema, replaces the storage dir)." >&2
  echo "Re-run with --yes once you have checked --database-url / --storage-dir." >&2
  exit 2
fi

if [[ -f "$ROOT_DIR/.env" ]]; then
  set -a; # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  . "$ROOT_DIR/.env"; set +a
fi
DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-${PV_DATABASE_URL:-}}"
STORAGE_DIR="${STORAGE_DIR:-${PV_STORAGE_LOCAL_DIR:-$ROOT_DIR/storage}}"
LIBPQ_URL="${DATABASE_URL/postgresql+asyncpg:\/\//postgresql://}"
LIBPQ_URL="${LIBPQ_URL/postgresql+psycopg:\/\//postgresql://}"
log() { printf '[restore %s] %s\n' "$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)" "$*"; }
run_pg() { if [[ -n "$PG_CONTAINER" ]]; then docker compose exec -T "$PG_CONTAINER" "$@"; else "$@"; fi; }

# Integrity: checksums from the manifest.
manifest_get() { python3 -c "import json,sys; m=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(eval(sys.argv[2], {}, {'m': m}))" "$SNAPSHOT/manifest.json" "$1"; }
check_sha() {
  local file="$1" expected="$2"
  [[ -z "$expected" ]] && return 0
  local actual; actual=$(sha256sum "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || { echo "checksum mismatch for $file" >&2; exit 1; }
}

# ---- database --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ "$STORAGE_ONLY" != 1 ]]; then
  [[ -n "$LIBPQ_URL" ]] || { echo "no database URL (set PV_DATABASE_URL or --database-url)" >&2; exit 1; }
  check_sha "$SNAPSHOT/db.dump" "$(manifest_get "m['database']['sha256']")"
  DBNAME="${LIBPQ_URL##*/}"; DBNAME="${DBNAME%%\?*}"
  log "restoring db.dump into $DBNAME (schema public is dropped first)"
  run_pg "$PSQL" --no-psqlrc -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --quiet --dbname="$LIBPQ_URL" \
    -c "DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE;" -c "CREATE SCHEMA public;"
  # --no-owner/--no-privileges: the dump was taken that way; the connecting role owns everything.
  run_pg "$PG_RESTORE" --no-owner --no-privileges --exit-on-error --dbname="$LIBPQ_URL" < "$SNAPSHOT/db.dump"
  log "database restored (alembic_version=$(run_pg "$PSQL" --no-psqlrc -tA --dbname="$LIBPQ_URL" -c 'select version_num from alembic_version' | tr -d '[:space:]'))"
fi

# ---- storage ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ "$DB_ONLY" != 1 ]]; then
  if [[ -f "$SNAPSHOT/storage.tar.gz" ]]; then
    check_sha "$SNAPSHOT/storage.tar.gz" "$(manifest_get "m['storage']['sha256']")"
    if [[ -d "$STORAGE_DIR" ]]; then
      ASIDE="$STORAGE_DIR.pre-restore-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
      log "moving existing $STORAGE_DIR → $ASIDE"
      mv "$STORAGE_DIR" "$ASIDE"
    fi
    mkdir -p "$STORAGE_DIR"
    tar --extract --gzip --file "$SNAPSHOT/storage.tar.gz" --directory "$STORAGE_DIR"
    log "storage restored into $STORAGE_DIR ($(find "$STORAGE_DIR" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ') files)"
  else
    log "snapshot has no storage.tar.gz; storage step skipped"
  fi
fi

# ---- verification ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ "$VERIFY" == 1 && "$STORAGE_ONLY" != 1 ]]; then
  log "verifying row counts against manifest"
  EXPECTED=$(manifest_get "__import__('json').dumps(m['database']['row_counts'], sort_keys=True)")
  COUNTS_SQL="SELECT json_object_agg(relname, n) FROM (
    SELECT c.relname, (xpath('/row/cnt/text()', query_to_xml(format('select count(*) as cnt from %I.%I', n.nspname, c.relname), false, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint AS n
    FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE c.relkind = 'r' AND n.nspname = 'public') t;"
  ACTUAL_RAW=$(run_pg "$PSQL" --no-psqlrc -tA --dbname="$LIBPQ_URL" -c "$COUNTS_SQL")
  ACTUAL=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps(json.loads(sys.argv[1]), sort_keys=True))" "$ACTUAL_RAW")
  if [[ "$EXPECTED" == "$ACTUAL" ]]; then
    log "row counts match: $ACTUAL"
  else
    echo "ROW COUNT MISMATCH" >&2; echo " expected: $EXPECTED" >&2; echo " actual:   $ACTUAL" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
  if [[ "$DB_ONLY" != 1 && -f "$SNAPSHOT/storage.tar.gz" ]]; then
    EXP_FILES=$(manifest_get "m['storage']['files']")
    ACT_FILES=$(find "$STORAGE_DIR" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    [[ "$EXP_FILES" == "$ACT_FILES" ]] || { echo "storage file count mismatch: expected $EXP_FILES got $ACT_FILES" >&2; exit 3; }
    log "storage file count matches: $ACT_FILES"
  fi
fi
log "restore complete"

```

## scripts/benchmark-engines.py

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# ruff: noqa: E501  (Markdown table rows and CLI help strings are clearer on one line)
"""Benchmark every *available* speech engine on fixed sentences and print a Markdown table.

    source .venv/bin/activate
    python scripts/benchmark-engines.py                # all available engines, all quality tiers
    python scripts/benchmark-engines.py --quality fast --engine zipvoice_distill --json out.json

Nothing is estimated: load time, inference time, real-time factor (inference / audio seconds),
peak level and output duration are measured on this machine.  The reference is the bundled
``models/zipvoice-distill/test_wavs/leijun-1.wav`` (Chinese) unless ``--reference``/``--reference-text``
point at another clip.  Engines whose ``cloning_languages`` do not include a sentence's language
skip that sentence.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import platform
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT / "backend"))

import numpy as np  # noqa: E402

from app.audio.analysis import peak_dbfs  # noqa: E402
from app.audio.decode import decode_audio  # noqa: E402
from app.engine.config import get_engine_settings  # noqa: E402
from app.engine.hardware import hardware_snapshot  # noqa: E402
from app.engine.pipeline import VoicePipeline  # noqa: E402
from app.engine.text.normalize import normalize_text  # noqa: E402
from app.engine.types import Language, ReferenceAudio, SynthesisRequest  # noqa: E402

SENTENCES: dict[Language, str] = {
    Language.EN: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the sun sets behind the quiet hills.",
    Language.ZH: "今天天气很好，我们决定沿着河边散步，聊聊我们的计划。",  # noqa: RUF001
    Language.HI: "आज मौसम बहुत अच्छा है, हम नदी के किनारे टहलने का फैसला करते हैं।",
    Language.TE: "ఈ రోజు వాతావరణం చాలా బాగుంది, మేము నది ఒడ్డున నడవాలని నిర్ణయించుకున్నాము.",
    Language.KN: "ಇಂದು ಹವಾಮಾನ ತುಂಬಾ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿದೆ, ನಾವು ನದಿಯ ದಡದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯಲು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಿದ್ದೇವೆ.",
    Language.TA: "இன்று வானிலை மிகவும் நன்றாக உள்ளது, நாங்கள் ஆற்றங்கரையில் நடக்க முடிவு செய்தோம்.",
    Language.ML: "ഇന്ന് കാലാവസ്ഥ വളരെ നല്ലതാണ്, ഞങ്ങൾ നദീതീരത്ത് നടക്കാൻ തീരുമാനിച്ചു.",
}
DEFAULT_REFERENCE = REPO_ROOT / "models" / "zipvoice-distill" / "test_wavs" / "leijun-1.wav"
DEFAULT_REFERENCE_TEXT = "那还是三十六年前, 一九八七年. 我呢考上了武汉大学的计算机系."


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--engine", action="append", help="engine id(s) to benchmark (default: all available)"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--quality", action="append", choices=["fast", "balanced", "high"], help="quality tier(s)"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--language",
        action="append",
        help="language code(s) to include (default: every one an engine supports)",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--reference", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_REFERENCE)
    parser.add_argument("--reference-text", default=DEFAULT_REFERENCE_TEXT)
    parser.add_argument("--reference-language", default="zh")
    parser.add_argument("--json", type=Path, help="also write the raw measurements here")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    settings = get_engine_settings()
    pipeline = VoicePipeline(settings)
    hw = hardware_snapshot(settings)
    qualities = args.quality or ["fast", "balanced", "high"]
    wanted_langs = {Language(code) for code in args.language} if args.language else set(SENTENCES)

    print("# Engine benchmark\n")
    print(
        f"Host: {platform.node()} · {hw['cpu_cores']} CPU cores · {hw['ram_total_mb']} MB RAM · "
        f"device {hw['device']} (cuda_available={hw['cuda_available']}) · torch {hw['torch_version']} · "
        f"onnxruntime {hw['onnxruntime_version']} · threads {settings.num_threads}\n"
    )
    print(f"Reference: `{args.reference}` ({args.reference_language})\n")

    engines = [
        e for e in pipeline.registry.ordered() if (not args.engine or e.info.id in args.engine)
    ]
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    header = "| Engine | Quality | Language | Chars | Load (s) | Inference (s) | Audio (s) | RTF | Peak (dBFS) | Device | Notes |"
    print(header)
    print("|" + "---|" * (header.count("|") - 1))

    for engine in engines:
        avail = pipeline.registry.availability(engine.info.id, refresh=True)
        if not avail.available:
            print(
                f"| {engine.info.id} | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | unavailable: {avail.reason} |"
            )
            rows.append({"engine": engine.info.id, "available": False, "reason": avail.reason})
            continue
        ref_audio = decode_audio(args.reference, sample_rate=engine.info.sample_rate)
        ref_lang = Language(args.reference_language)
        reference = ReferenceAudio(
            audio=ref_audio,
            transcript=normalize_text(args.reference_text, ref_lang),
            language=ref_lang,
            path=args.reference,
        )
        started = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            loaded = pipeline.manager.ensure_loaded(engine.info.id)
        except Exception as exc:
            print(
                f"| {engine.info.id} | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | load failed: {str(exc)[:120]} |"
            )
            rows.append({"engine": engine.info.id, "available": True, "load_error": str(exc)})
            continue
        load_seconds = time.perf_counter() - started
        first = True
        for quality in qualities:
            for lang, sentence in SENTENCES.items():
                if lang not in wanted_langs or lang not in engine.info.cloning_languages:
                    continue
                if lang != ref_lang and not engine.info.cross_lingual:
                    continue
                text = normalize_text(sentence, lang)
                request = SynthesisRequest(
                    text=text, language=lang, reference=reference, speed=1.0, quality=quality
                )
                try:
                    result = pipeline.manager.synthesize(engine.info.id, request)
                except Exception as exc:
                    print(
                        f"| {engine.info.id} | {quality} | {lang.value} | {len(text)} | - | - | - | - | - | {loaded.device} | failed: {str(exc)[:100]} |"
                    )
                    rows.append(
                        {
                            "engine": engine.info.id,
                            "quality": quality,
                            "language": lang.value,
                            "error": str(exc),
                        }
                    )
                    continue
                audio_s = result.audio.duration
                rtf = result.inference_seconds / audio_s if audio_s else float("nan")
                peak = peak_dbfs(np.asarray(result.audio.samples))
                notes = ", ".join(
                    f"{k}={v}"
                    for k, v in result.details.items()
                    if k in ("variant", "num_steps", "nfe_step")
                )
                load_cell = f"{load_seconds:.2f}" if first else "(resident)"
                first = False
                print(
                    f"| {engine.info.id} | {quality} | {lang.value} | {len(text)} | {load_cell} | {result.inference_seconds:.2f} | "
                    f"{audio_s:.2f} | {rtf:.2f} | {peak:.2f} | {result.device} | {notes} |"
                )
                rows.append(
                    {
                        "engine": engine.info.id,
                        "quality": quality,
                        "language": lang.value,
                        "chars": len(text),
                        "load_seconds": round(load_seconds, 3),
                        "inference_seconds": round(result.inference_seconds, 3),
                        "audio_seconds": round(audio_s, 3),
                        "rtf": round(rtf, 3),
                        "peak_dbfs": round(peak, 2),
                        "device": result.device,
                        "details": result.details,
                    }
                )
        pipeline.manager.unload(engine.info.id)

    print(
        "\nRTF = inference seconds / audio seconds (lower is better; < 1 is faster than real time). "
        "Peak is the raw engine output before the pipeline's -1 dBFS limiter."
    )
    if args.json:
        args.json.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "hardware": hw,
                    "rows": rows,
                    "generated_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
                },
                indent=2,
                default=str,
            )
        )
        print(f"\nraw measurements written to {args.json}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.environ.setdefault("PYTHONWARNINGS", "ignore")
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

## scripts/download-models.py

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# ruff: noqa: E501  (Markdown table rows and CLI help strings are clearer on one line)
"""Download model weights for PROJECT VOICE into ``PV_MODELS_DIR`` (default ``<repo>/models``).

Core set (GitHub releases, no account needed; idempotent — existing files are kept):

    python scripts/download-models.py                 # ZipVoice int8 + fp32, Vocos, lexicon, whisper-base, Silero VAD
    python scripts/download-models.py --skip-fp32     # smaller: int8 only (no "high" quality tier)
    python scripts/download-models.py --only vad whisper

Optional engines hosted on Hugging Face (need network access to huggingface.co):

    python scripts/download-models.py --f5tts openf5    # mrfakename/OpenF5-TTS-Base  (Apache-2.0, en)
    python scripts/download-models.py --f5tts v1-base   # SWivid/F5-TTS F5TTS_v1_Base  (CC-BY-NC-4.0, en+zh)
    python scripts/download-models.py --f5tts hindi     # SPRINGLab/F5-Hindi-24KHz     (CC-BY-4.0, hi)
    python scripts/download-models.py --indicf5         # ai4bharat/IndicF5 (gated: accept terms + HF token)

Each Hugging Face download prints the exact ``PV_*`` lines to put in ``.env``.  Every file's
SHA-256 is printed so operators can pin what they deployed.

Resulting layout::

    models/
      zipvoice-distill/  tokens.txt lexicon.txt lexicon-en-us.txt vocos_24khz.onnx
                         encoder.int8.onnx decoder.int8.onnx encoder.fp32.onnx decoder.fp32.onnx test_wavs/
      whisper-base/      base-encoder.int8.onnx base-decoder.int8.onnx base-tokens.txt
      silero_vad.onnx
      f5tts/<variant>/   (optional)   indicf5/ (optional)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import os
import shutil
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RELEASES = "https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download"

ZIPVOICE_INT8 = f"{RELEASES}/tts-models/sherpa-onnx-zipvoice-distill-int8-zh-en-emilia.tar.bz2"
ZIPVOICE_FP32 = f"{RELEASES}/tts-models/sherpa-onnx-zipvoice-distill-zh-en-emilia.tar.bz2"
VOCOS = f"{RELEASES}/vocoder-models/vocos_24khz.onnx"
LEXICON_EN = f"{RELEASES}/tts-models/lexicon-en-us.txt"
WHISPER_BASE = f"{RELEASES}/asr-models/sherpa-onnx-whisper-base.tar.bz2"
SILERO_VAD = f"{RELEASES}/asr-models/silero_vad.onnx"

# Member names inside the ZipVoice archives → files in our layout (old and new upstream layouts).
ZIPVOICE_RENAMES = {
    "encoder.int8.onnx": "encoder.int8.onnx",
    "decoder.int8.onnx": "decoder.int8.onnx",
    "text_encoder.int8.onnx": "encoder.int8.onnx",
    "fm_decoder.int8.onnx": "decoder.int8.onnx",
    "encoder.onnx": "encoder.fp32.onnx",
    "decoder.onnx": "decoder.fp32.onnx",
    "text_encoder.onnx": "encoder.fp32.onnx",
    "fm_decoder.onnx": "decoder.fp32.onnx",
    "encoder.fp32.onnx": "encoder.fp32.onnx",
    "decoder.fp32.onnx": "decoder.fp32.onnx",
    "tokens.txt": "tokens.txt",
    "lexicon.txt": "lexicon.txt",
    "vocos_24khz.onnx": "vocos_24khz.onnx",
}
WHISPER_KEEP = ("base-encoder.int8.onnx", "base-decoder.int8.onnx", "base-tokens.txt")

F5_VARIANTS = {
    "openf5": {
        "repo": "mrfakename/OpenF5-TTS-Base",
        "licence": "Apache-2.0 (OpenF5-TTS-Base)",
        "languages": "en",
        "model_cfg": "F5TTS_Base",
        "ckpt_patterns": ("model.pt", "model.safetensors", "*.pt", "*.safetensors"),
    },
    "v1-base": {
        "repo": "SWivid/F5-TTS",
        "subfolder": "F5TTS_v1_Base",
        "licence": "CC-BY-NC-4.0 (SWivid/F5-TTS v1 Base) — non-commercial",
        "languages": "en,zh",
        "model_cfg": "F5TTS_v1_Base",
        "ckpt_patterns": ("F5TTS_v1_Base/model_1250000.safetensors", "F5TTS_v1_Base/*.safetensors"),
    },
    "hindi": {
        "repo": "SPRINGLab/F5-Hindi-24KHz",
        "licence": "CC-BY-4.0 (SPRINGLab/F5-Hindi-24KHz)",
        "languages": "hi",
        "model_cfg": "F5TTS_Small",  # dim 768, depth 18, heads 12 — matches the packaged F5TTS_Small config
        "ckpt_patterns": ("model_2500000.safetensors", "*.safetensors", "*.pt"),
    },
}
VOCOS_HF = "charactr/vocos-mel-24khz"
INDICF5_REPO = "ai4bharat/IndicF5"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def log(msg: str) -> None:
    print(msg, flush=True)


def sha256_of(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def human(n: int) -> str:
    for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB"):
        if n < 1024:
            return f"{n:.0f} {unit}"
        n //= 1024
    return f"{n} TB"


def download(url: str, dest: Path) -> Path:
    """Stream ``url`` to ``dest`` via a temp file; raises SystemExit with a clear message on failure."""
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = dest.with_suffix(dest.suffix + ".part")
    log(f"  downloading {url}")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=120) as resp, open(tmp, "wb") as out:  # noqa: S310 — https URLs only
            total = int(resp.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
            done = 0
            next_report = 0.0
            while True:
                chunk = resp.read(1 << 20)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                out.write(chunk)
                done += len(chunk)
                if total and sys.stdout.isatty():
                    sys.stdout.write(f"\r    {human(done)} / {human(total)}")
                    sys.stdout.flush()
                elif total and done / total >= next_report:
                    log(f"    {human(done)} / {human(total)}")
                    next_report += 0.25
            if total and sys.stdout.isatty():
                sys.stdout.write("\n")
    except (urllib.error.URLError, urllib.error.HTTPError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
        tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise SystemExit(f"download failed for {url}: {exc}") from exc
    os.replace(tmp, dest)
    log(f"  sha256 {sha256_of(dest)}  {dest.name} ({human(dest.stat().st_size)})")
    return dest


def safe_extract(archive: Path, into: Path) -> Path:
    with tarfile.open(archive, "r:bz2") as tar:
        if hasattr(tarfile, "data_filter"):
            tar.extractall(into, filter="data")
        else:  # Python < 3.12: manual path check
            for member in tar.getmembers():
                target = (into / member.name).resolve()
                if not str(target).startswith(str(into.resolve())):
                    raise SystemExit(f"unsafe path in archive: {member.name}")
            tar.extractall(into)  # noqa: S202 — members validated above
    roots = [p for p in into.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]
    return roots[0] if len(roots) == 1 else into


def place(src: Path, dest: Path) -> None:
    if dest.exists():
        log(f"  keep     {dest} (exists)")
        return
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(src), str(dest))
    log(f"  placed   {dest}  sha256 {sha256_of(dest)}")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# core set
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def zipvoice_complete(zv: Path, *, fp32: bool) -> bool:
    needed = [
        "tokens.txt",
        "lexicon.txt",
        "lexicon-en-us.txt",
        "vocos_24khz.onnx",
        "encoder.int8.onnx",
        "decoder.int8.onnx",
    ]
    if fp32:
        needed += ["encoder.fp32.onnx", "decoder.fp32.onnx"]
    return all((zv / n).is_file() for n in needed)


def fetch_zipvoice(models_dir: Path, *, fp32: bool, work: Path) -> None:
    zv = models_dir / "zipvoice-distill"
    log(f"[zipvoice] -> {zv}")
    if zipvoice_complete(zv, fp32=fp32):
        log("  complete, nothing to do")
        return
    archives = [("int8", ZIPVOICE_INT8)]
    if fp32:
        archives.append(("fp32", ZIPVOICE_FP32))
    for variant, url in archives:
        if (zv / f"encoder.{variant}.onnx").is_file() and (
            zv / f"decoder.{variant}.onnx"
        ).is_file():
            log(f"  {variant} encoder/decoder present, skipping archive")
            continue
        archive = download(url, work / Path(url).name)
        root = safe_extract(archive, work / f"zipvoice-{variant}")
        for member, target in ZIPVOICE_RENAMES.items():
            src = root / member
            if src.is_file():
                if variant == "fp32" and target.endswith(".int8.onnx"):
                    continue
                place(src, zv / target)
        test_wavs = root / "test_wavs"
        if test_wavs.is_dir() and not (zv / "test_wavs").exists():
            shutil.move(str(test_wavs), str(zv / "test_wavs"))
            log(f"  placed   {zv / 'test_wavs'}")
        archive.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        shutil.rmtree(work / f"zipvoice-{variant}", ignore_errors=True)
    if not (zv / "vocos_24khz.onnx").is_file():
        download(VOCOS, zv / "vocos_24khz.onnx")
    if not (zv / "lexicon-en-us.txt").is_file():
        download(LEXICON_EN, zv / "lexicon-en-us.txt")
    missing = [
        n
        for n in ("tokens.txt", "lexicon.txt", "encoder.int8.onnx", "decoder.int8.onnx")
        if not (zv / n).is_file()
    ]
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"ZipVoice archive did not provide {missing}; upstream layout changed — please report"
        )


def fetch_whisper(models_dir: Path, *, work: Path) -> None:
    wd = models_dir / "whisper-base"
    log(f"[whisper-base] -> {wd}")
    if all((wd / n).is_file() for n in WHISPER_KEEP):
        log("  complete, nothing to do")
        return
    archive = download(WHISPER_BASE, work / Path(WHISPER_BASE).name)
    root = safe_extract(archive, work / "whisper")
    for name in WHISPER_KEEP:
        src = root / name
        if not src.is_file():
            raise SystemExit(
                f"whisper archive lacks {name}; upstream layout changed — please report"
            )
        place(src, wd / name)
    archive.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    shutil.rmtree(work / "whisper", ignore_errors=True)


def fetch_vad(models_dir: Path) -> None:
    dest = models_dir / "silero_vad.onnx"
    log(f"[silero-vad] -> {dest}")
    if dest.is_file():
        log("  complete, nothing to do")
        return
    download(SILERO_VAD, dest)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hugging Face hosted engines
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

HF_BLOCKED_HINT = (
    "Hugging Face is not reachable from this host (or the repository is gated and the token is "
    "missing). Run this command on a machine with access to huggingface.co, then copy the "
    "directory to the worker and set the PV_* variables documented in docs/MODEL_SETUP.md."
)


def _hf_api():  # type: ignore[no-untyped-def]
    try:
        from huggingface_hub import HfApi, hf_hub_download
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise SystemExit("huggingface_hub is not installed: pip install huggingface_hub") from exc
    return HfApi(), hf_hub_download


def _pick(files: list[str], patterns: tuple[str, ...]) -> str | None:
    import fnmatch

    for pattern in patterns:
        for f in files:
            if fnmatch.fnmatch(f, pattern):
                return f
    return None


def fetch_f5tts(models_dir: Path, variant: str, token: str | None) -> None:
    spec = F5_VARIANTS[variant]
    dest = models_dir / "f5tts" / variant
    log(f"[f5tts/{variant}] {spec['repo']} -> {dest}")
    api, hf_hub_download = _hf_api()
    try:
        files = api.list_repo_files(spec["repo"], token=token)
        ckpt_name = _pick(files, spec["ckpt_patterns"])
        vocab_name = _pick(
            files,
            (f"{spec.get('subfolder', '')}/vocab.txt".lstrip("/"), "vocab.txt", "*/vocab.txt"),
        )
        if not ckpt_name or not vocab_name:
            raise SystemExit(f"could not find checkpoint/vocab in {spec['repo']}: files={files}")
        dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        ckpt = Path(hf_hub_download(spec["repo"], ckpt_name, local_dir=str(dest), token=token))
        vocab = Path(hf_hub_download(spec["repo"], vocab_name, local_dir=str(dest), token=token))
        vocoder_dir = models_dir / "f5tts" / "vocos-mel-24khz"
        vocoder_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for name in ("config.yaml", "pytorch_model.bin"):
            hf_hub_download(VOCOS_HF, name, local_dir=str(vocoder_dir), token=token)
    except SystemExit:
        raise
    except Exception as exc:
        raise SystemExit(f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:300]}\n{HF_BLOCKED_HINT}") from exc
    for path in (ckpt, vocab):
        log(f"  sha256 {sha256_of(path)}  {path}")
    log("\nAdd to .env:")
    log(f"PV_F5TTS_CKPT={ckpt}")
    log(f"PV_F5TTS_VOCAB={vocab}")
    log(f"PV_F5TTS_MODEL_CFG={spec['model_cfg']}")
    log(f"PV_F5TTS_VOCODER_DIR={vocoder_dir}")
    log(f"PV_F5TTS_WEIGHT_LICENCE={spec['licence']}")
    log(f"PV_F5TTS_LANGUAGES={spec['languages']}")


def fetch_indicf5(models_dir: Path, token: str | None) -> None:
    dest = models_dir / "indicf5"
    log(f"[indicf5] {INDICF5_REPO} -> {dest}")
    if not token:
        log(
            "  note: ai4bharat/IndicF5 is gated — accept the terms on huggingface.co/ai4bharat/IndicF5 and pass --hf-token / PV_HF_TOKEN"
        )
    try:
        from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise SystemExit("huggingface_hub is not installed: pip install huggingface_hub") from exc
    try:
        path = snapshot_download(INDICF5_REPO, local_dir=str(dest), token=token)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise SystemExit(f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:300]}\n{HF_BLOCKED_HINT}") from exc
    for f in sorted(Path(path).rglob("*")):
        if f.is_file() and f.suffix in (".safetensors", ".pt", ".bin", ".json", ".txt"):
            log(f"  sha256 {sha256_of(f)}  {f.relative_to(path)}")
    log("\nAdd to .env:")
    log(f"PV_INDICF5_MODEL={path}")
    log("# plus the IndicF5 runtime: pip install git+https://github.com/ai4bharat/IndicF5.git")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# main
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--models-dir", default=os.environ.get("PV_MODELS_DIR") or str(REPO_ROOT / "models")
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--only", nargs="*", choices=["zipvoice", "whisper", "vad"], help="subset of the core set"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--skip-fp32",
        action="store_true",
        help="do not download the fp32 ZipVoice variant (~500 MB)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--f5tts",
        choices=sorted(F5_VARIANTS),
        help="download an F5-TTS checkpoint from Hugging Face",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--indicf5",
        action="store_true",
        help="download ai4bharat/IndicF5 (gated) from Hugging Face",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--hf-token", default=os.environ.get("PV_HF_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("HF_TOKEN")
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    models_dir = Path(args.models_dir).expanduser().resolve()
    models_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log(f"models dir: {models_dir}")

    if args.f5tts or args.indicf5:
        if args.f5tts:
            fetch_f5tts(models_dir, args.f5tts, args.hf_token)
        if args.indicf5:
            fetch_indicf5(models_dir, args.hf_token)
        return 0

    wanted = set(args.only or ["zipvoice", "whisper", "vad"])
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="pv-download-", dir=str(models_dir)) as tmp:
        work = Path(tmp)
        if "zipvoice" in wanted:
            fetch_zipvoice(models_dir, fp32=not args.skip_fp32, work=work)
        if "whisper" in wanted:
            fetch_whisper(models_dir, work=work)
        if "vad" in wanted:
            fetch_vad(models_dir)
    log("done")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```
